entry.title: gencat: Generative computerized adaptive testing

author.name: Wanyong Feng, Andrew Lan

entry.summary: Proposes GENCAT, a computerized adaptive testing framework using LLMs for knowledge estimation and question selection, with a Generative Item Response Theory model that handles open-ended responses.

entry.title: Scaling Ultrasound Volumetric Reconstruction via Mobile Augmented Reality

author.name: Kian Wei Ng, Yujia Gao, Deborah Khoo, Ying Zhen Tan, Chengzheng Mao, Haojie Cheng, Andrew Makmur, Kee Yuan Ngiam, Serene Goh, Eng Tat Khoo

entry.summary: Presents MARVUS, a mobile augmented reality system for 3D ultrasound volumetric reconstruction that uses smartphone AR capabilities to track probe position, enabling low-cost 3D imaging without specialized hardware. Addresses high inter-user variability in 2D ultrasound volume estimation.

entry.title: MaskDiME: Adaptive Masked Diffusion for Precise and Efficient Visual Counterfactual Explanations

author.name: Changlu Guo, Anders Nymark Christensen, Anders Bjorholm Dahl, Morten Rieger Hannemose

entry.summary: Proposes MaskDiME, a training-free diffusion framework for visual counterfactual explanations that adaptively focuses on decision-relevant regions for localized, semantically consistent counterfactual generation while preserving image fidelity.

entry.title: Learning Multi-Modal Prototypes for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Object Detection

author.name: Wanqi Wang, Jingcai Guo, Yuxiang Cai, Zhi Chen

entry.summary: Proposes LMP, a dual-branch detector for cross-domain few-shot object detection that couples textual guidance from VLMs with visual exemplar prototypes from the target domain. Includes hard-negative prototype generation and training-free prototype calibration.

entry.title: CRAFT-LoRA: Content-Style Personalization via Rank-Constrained Adaptation and Training-Free Fusion

author.name: Yu Li, Yujun Cai, Chi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes CRAFT-LoRA for content-style personalization in image generation through rank-constrained backbone fine-tuning and training-free LoRA fusion. Addresses entanglement between content and style in LoRA combination.

entry.title: Global Commander and Local Operative: A Dual-Agent Framework for Scene Navigation

author.name: Kaiming Jin, Yuefan Wu, Shengqiong Wu, Bobo Li, Shuicheng Yan, Tat-Seng Chua

entry.summary: Introduces DACo, a dual-agent framework for vision-and-language navigation that decouples global planning (Global Commander) from local grounding (Local Operative), addressing the overloading problem of single-agent approaches.

entry.title: TeFlow: Enabling Multi-frame Supervision for Self-Supervised Feed-forward Scene Flow Estimation

author.name: Qingwen Zhang, Chenhan Jiang, Xiaomeng Zhu, Yunqi Miao, Yushan Zhang, Olov Andersson, Patric Jensfelt

entry.summary: Presents TeFlow, enabling multi-frame supervision for self-supervised feed-forward scene flow estimation by mining temporally consistent supervision signals through temporal ensembling, overcoming the limitations of two-frame correspondence.

entry.title: Prompt Tuning for CLIP on the Pretrained Manifold

author.name: Xi Yang, Yuanrong Xu, Weigang Zhang, Guangming Lu, David Zhang, Jie Wen

entry.summary: Proposes ManiPT for prompt tuning of CLIP on the pretrained manifold, using cosine consistency constraints to prevent learned representations from drifting away from the pretrained geometric neighborhood.

entry.title: GS-CLIP: Zero-shot 3D Anomaly Detection by Geometry-Aware Prompt and Synergistic View Representation Learning

author.name: Zehao Deng, An Liu, Yan Wang

entry.summary: Proposes GS-CLIP for zero-shot 3D anomaly detection using geometry-aware prompts and synergistic view representation learning. Addresses geometric detail loss from 3D-to-2D projection and limited visual understanding from single modality.

entry.title: MRI Contrast Enhancement Kinetics World Model

author.name: Jindi Kong, Yuting He, Cong Xia, Rongjun Ge, Shuo Li

entry.summary: Proposes a world model approach for simulating MRI contrast enhancement kinetics, addressing the challenge of low temporal resolution in MRI acquisition. Tackles content distortion and temporal inconsistency through a novel training strategy.

entry.title: Exploiting Label-Independent Regularization from Spatial Dependencies for Whole Slide Image Analysis

author.name: Weiyi Wu, Xinwen Xu, Chongyang Gao, Xingjian Diao, Siting Li, Jiang Gui

entry.summary: Proposes a spatially regularized MIL framework for whole slide image analysis that leverages spatial relationships among patches as label-independent regularization, addressing the sparse supervision problem in gigapixel pathology images.

entry.title: RAP: Fast Feedforward Rendering-Free Attribute-Guided Primitive Importance Score Prediction for Efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting Processing

author.name: Kaifa Yang, Qi Yang, Yiling Xu, Zhu Li

entry.summary: Proposes RAP, a fast feedforward method for predicting 3D Gaussian primitive importance scores directly from attributes without rendering, enabling efficient pruning and compression of 3DGS scenes.

entry.title: ExpPortrait: Expressive Portrait Generation via Personalized Representation

author.name: Junyi Wang, Yudong Guo, Boyang Guo, Shengming Yang, Juyong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes ExpPortrait, a method for generating expressive portrait videos using a personalized head representation that better disentangles expression from identity, enabling coherent and controllable cinematic portrait generation.

entry.title: Do Large Language Models Understand Data Visualization Rules?

author.name: Martin Sinnona, Valentin Bonas, Emmanuel Iarussi, Viviana Siless

entry.summary: A related/companion paper to item 68, also evaluating LLMs on visualization rules but using Draco's ASP-derived constraints as ground truth. Tests LLM ability to enforce visualization rules.

entry.title: WildOS: Open-Vocabulary Object Search in the Wild

author.name: Hardik Shah, Erica Tevere, Deegan Atha, Marcel Kaufmann, Shehryar Khattak, Manthan Patel, Marco Hutter, Jonas Frey, Patrick Spieler

entry.summary: Presents WildOS, a system for long-range open-vocabulary object search in unstructured outdoor environments. Combines safe geometric exploration with semantic visual reasoning using foundation models to score frontier nodes in a sparse navigation graph.

entry.title: Anticipate, Adapt, Act: A Hybrid Framework for Task Planning

author.name: Nabanita Dash, Ayush Kaura, Shivam Singh, Ramandeep Singh, Snehasis Banerjee, Mohan Sridharan, K. Madhava Krishna

entry.summary: Presents a hybrid task planning framework integrating LLM prediction capabilities with probabilistic decision-making (RDIDL) for anticipating and adapting to task failures in human-robot collaboration.

entry.title: Self-Configurable Mesh-Networks for Scalable Distributed Submodular Bandit Optimization

author.name: Zirui Xu, Vasileios Tzoumas

entry.summary: Studies distributed bandit submodular coordination with realistic communication constraints, achieving near-optimal coordination through self-configurable mesh networks with only one-hop communication and minimal message sizes.

entry.title: Which questions can’t we punt?

author.name: Lizka

entry.summary: Argues AI strategy researchers should prioritize questions about the early AI transition period, since later AI capabilities will provide much more capacity for strategy work. Sketches priority questions about early-period dynamics.

entry.title: Was It Owl a Dream?

author.name: Yovel Rom

entry.summary: This post applies logit lens interpretability techniques to investigate 'subliminal learning' — where models gain knowledge through fine-tuning on seemingly unrelated tokens. The author finds evidence that 'entangled tokens' identified in prior work may not actually be the mechanism, as all numeric tokens show similar logit changes while the actual learned concept's logits increase throughout the model.

entry.title: Discover, Segment, and Select: A Progressive Mechanism for Zero-shot Camouflaged Object Segmentation

author.name: Yilong Yang, Jianxin Tian, Shengchuan Zhang, Liujuan Cao

entry.summary: Proposes DSS (Discover-Segment-Select), a progressive mechanism for zero-shot camouflaged object segmentation that improves upon the standard discover-then-segment pipeline by adding feature-coherent discovery and selection stages.

entry.title: Token-UNet: A New Case for Transformers Integration in Efficient and Interpretable 3D UNets for Brain Imaging Segmentation

author.name: Louis Fabrice Tshimanga, Andrea Zanola, Federico Del Pup, Manfredo Atzori

entry.summary: Presents Token-UNet, which integrates TokenLearner/TokenFuser modules to efficiently incorporate Transformers into 3D UNets for brain imaging segmentation, reducing computational costs compared to standard Transformer-based approaches.

entry.title: Modularity is the Bedrock of Natural and Artificial Intelligence

author.name: Alessandro Salatiello

entry.summary: Argues that modularity is foundational to both natural and artificial intelligence, aligning with the No Free Lunch Theorem. Reviews evidence from neuroscience and proposes modularity as a guiding principle for more efficient AI architectures.

entry.title: Agentic Problem Frames: A Systematic Approach to Engineering Reliable Domain Agents

author.name: Chanjin Park (Seoul National University)

entry.summary: Proposes Agentic Problem Frames (APF), a systematic engineering framework that shifts focus from internal model intelligence to structured agent-environment interaction. Introduces Act-Verify-Refine closed-loop control for industrial-grade agent reliability.

entry.title: Human-Guided Agentic AI for Multimodal Clinical Prediction: Lessons from the AgentDS Healthcare Benchmark

author.name: Lalitha Pranathi Pulavarthy, Raajitha Muthyala, Aravind V Kuruvikkattil, Zhenan Yin, Rashmita Kudamala, Saptarshi Purkayastha

entry.summary: Investigates human-guided agentic AI for clinical prediction across three AgentDS Healthcare benchmark tasks. Shows human-directed workflows improve multimodal clinical prediction through strategic feature engineering and model selection.

entry.title: AgentCAT: An LLM Agent for Extracting and Analyzing Catalytic Reaction Data from Chemical Engineering Literature

author.name: Wei Yang, Zihao Liu, Tao Tan, Xiao Hu, Hong Xie, Lulu Li Xin Li, Jianyu Han, Defu Lian, Mao Ye

entry.summary: AgentCAT is an LLM agent for extracting and analyzing catalytic reaction data from chemical engineering papers, providing interactive natural language analysis to address data bottlenecks in chemical engineering.

entry.title: NutriOrion: A Hierarchical Multi-Agent Framework for Personalized Nutrition Intervention Grounded in Clinical Guidelines

author.name: Junwei Wu, Runze Yan, Hanqi Luo, Darren Liu, Minxiao Wang, Kimberly L. Townsend, Lydia S. Hartwig, Derek Milketinas, Xiao Hu, Carl Yang

entry.summary: NutriOrion is a hierarchical multi-agent LLM framework for personalized nutrition planning for patients with multimorbidity, using parallel-then-sequential reasoning to decompose complex dietary constraints across specialized domain agents.

entry.title: Learning from Complexity: Exploring Dynamic Sample Pruning of Spatio-Temporal Training

author.name: Wei Chen, Junle Chen, Yuqian Wu, Yuxuan Liang, Xiaofang Zhou

entry.summary: ST-Prune dynamically prunes training samples for spatio-temporal forecasting based on complexity, avoiding wasted computation on easy or repetitive samples while maintaining performance.

entry.title: MultiDiffSense: Diffusion-Based Multi-Modal Visuo-Tactile Image Generation Conditioned on Object Shape and Contact Pose

author.name: Sirine Bhouri, Lan Wei, Jian-Qing Zheng, Dandan Zhang

entry.summary: MultiDiffSense is a unified diffusion model that synthesizes images for multiple vision-based tactile sensors with dual conditioning on depth maps and structured prompts encoding sensor type and contact pose.

entry.title: Hilbert-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Scalable Multi-Robot Coverage and Exploration

author.name: Tamil Selvan Gurunathan, Aryya Gangopadhyay

entry.summary: Augments DQN and PPO with Hilbert space-filling curve priors for multi-robot coverage, converting orderings into feasible SE(2) trajectories and demonstrating on a Boston Dynamics Spot robot.

entry.title: Fore-Mamba3D: Mamba-based Foreground-Enhanced Encoding for 3D Object Detection

author.name: Zhiwei Ning, Xuanang Gao, Jiaxi Cao, Runze Yang, Huiying Xu, Xinzhong Zhu, Jie Yang, Wei Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Fore-Mamba3D, a Mamba-based backbone for 3D object detection that focuses on foreground enhancement by addressing response attenuation and restricted context in foreground-only voxel sequences.

entry.title: DICArt: Advancing Category-level Articulated Object Pose Estimation in Discrete State-Spaces

author.name: Li Zhang, Mingyu Mei, Ailing Wang, Xianhui Meng, Yan Zhong, Xinyuan Song, Liu Liu, Rujing Wang, Zaixing He, Cewu Lu

entry.summary: DICArt formulates articulated object pose estimation as a conditional discrete diffusion process, using a flow decider to dynamically determine denoising operations per token.

entry.title: Satellite-Based Detection of Looted Archaeological Sites Using Machine Learning

author.name: Girmaw Abebe Tadesse, Titien Bartette, Andrew Hassanali, Allen Kim, Jonathan Chemla, Andrew Zolli, Yves Ubelmann, Caleb Robinson, Inbal Becker-Reshef, Juan Lavista Ferres

entry.summary: Presents a satellite-based ML pipeline for detecting looted archaeological sites in Afghanistan using PlanetScope imagery (2016-2023), comparing CNNs with handcrafted features and foundation model embeddings.

entry.title: Continuous Telemonitoring of Heart Failure using Personalised Speech Dynamics

author.name: Yue Pan, Xingyao Wang, Hanyue Zhang, Liwei Liu, Changxin Li, Gang Yang, Rong Sheng, Yili Xia, Ming Chu

entry.summary: Proposes a Longitudinal Intra-Patient Tracking scheme for heart failure monitoring via speech signals, using a Personalized Sequential Encoder to capture within-patient symptom changes over time.

entry.title: Make Some Noise: Unsupervised Remote Sensing Change Detection Using Latent Space Perturbations

author.name: Bla\v{z} Rolih, Matic Fu\v{c}ka, Filip Wolf, Luka \v{C}ehovin Zajc

entry.summary: MaSoN proposes an unsupervised change detection framework for remote sensing that generates synthetic changes in latent space rather than pixel space, avoiding handcrafted assumptions about change types.

entry.title: A Secure and Private Distributed Bayesian Federated Learning Design

author.name: Nuocheng Yang, Sihua Wang, Zhaohui Yang, Mingzhe Chen, Changchuan Yin, Kaibin Huang

entry.summary: Proposes a distributed federated learning framework integrating Byzantine robustness, privacy preservation via Bayesian approaches, and convergence acceleration through optimal neighbor selection.

entry.title: Agentic AI for Scalable and Robust Optical Systems Control

author.name: Zehao Wang, Mingzhe Han, Wei Cheng, Yue-Kai Huang, Philip Ji, Denton Wu, Mahdi Safari, Flemming Holtorf, Kenaish AlQubaisi, Norbert M. Linke, Danyang Zhuo, Yiran Chen, Ting Wang, Dirk Englund, Tingjun Chen

entry.summary: AgentOptics is an agentic AI framework for autonomous optical system control using the Model Context Protocol (MCP). It implements 64 standardized tools across 8 optical devices with a 410-task benchmark, achieving 87.7-96% accuracy across configurations.

entry.title: Audio-Visual Continual Test-Time Adaptation without Forgetting

author.name: Sarthak Kumar Maharana, Akshay Mehra, Bhavya Ramakrishna, Yunhui Guo, Guan-Ming Su

entry.summary: Addresses catastrophic forgetting in audio-visual continual test-time adaptation by showing that adapting only the modality fusion layer improves both current and subsequent domain performance, leveraging cross-task transfer.

entry.title: In Defense of Cosine Similarity: Normalization Eliminates the Gauge Freedom

author.name: Taha Bouhsine

entry.summary: Proves that when embeddings are constrained to the unit sphere (during or after training), the gauge ambiguity identified by Steck et al. vanishes, defending the use of cosine similarity under appropriate conditions.

entry.title: Leap+Verify: Regime-Adaptive Speculative Weight Prediction for Accelerating Neural Network Training

author.name: Jeremy McEntire

entry.summary: Leap+Verify applies speculative execution to neural network training, predicting future weights using analytic extrapolators in dynamically detected training regimes (chaotic, transition, stable) and validating before acceptance.

entry.title: PaReGTA: An LLM-based EHR Data Encoding Approach to Capture Temporal Information

author.name: Kihyuk Yoon, Lingchao Mao, Catherine Chong, Todd J. Schwedt, Chia-Chun Chiang, Jing Li

entry.summary: Proposes PaReGTA, an LLM-based framework for encoding temporal EHR data that converts longitudinal events into templated text, learns domain-adapted visit embeddings via contrastive fine-tuning, and aggregates them with temporal pooling. Works well with limited data.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Aware Rank-One MIMO Q Network Framework for Accelerated Offline Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Thanh Nguyen, Tung Luu, Tri Ton, Sungwoong Kim, Chang D. Yoo

entry.summary: Introduces an uncertainty-aware rank-one MIMO Q-network for offline reinforcement learning that efficiently characterizes OOD data while reducing computational overhead compared to ensemble methods.

entry.title: Counterfactual Understanding via Retrieval-aware Multimodal Modeling for Time-to-Event Survival Prediction

author.name: Ha-Anh Hoang Nguyen, Tri-Duc Phan Le, Duc-Hoang Pham, Huy-Son Nguyen, Cam-Van Thi Nguyen, Duc-Trong Le, Hoang-Quynh Le

entry.summary: Proposes CURE, a framework for counterfactual survival prediction that integrates multimodal clinical data through cross-attention and mixture-of-experts, with latent subgroup retrieval for personalized treatment effect estimation.

entry.title: Do Generative Metrics Predict YOLO Performance? An Evaluation Across Models, Augmentation Ratios, and Dataset Complexity

author.name: Vasile Marian, Yong-Bin Kang, Alexander Buddery

entry.summary: Evaluates whether standard generative metrics (FID etc.) predict downstream YOLO detection performance when using synthetic augmentation data. Tests across multiple generators, augmentation ratios, and dataset complexities.

entry.title: Could Large Language Models work as Post-hoc Explainability Tools in Credit Risk Models?

author.name: Wenxi Geng, Dingyuan Liu, Liya Li, Yiqing Wang

entry.summary: Evaluates whether LLMs can serve as post-hoc explainability tools for credit risk models, testing GPT-4-turbo, Claude Sonnet 4, and Gemini-2.0-Flash as translators vs autonomous explainers. Finds LLMs good as translators but poor as autonomous explainers.

entry.title: Implicit Bias and Convergence of Matrix Stochastic Mirror Descent

author.name: Danil Akhtiamov, Reza Ghane, Babak Hassibi

entry.summary: Proves convergence and characterizes implicit bias of stochastic mirror descent with matrix parameters, showing the algorithm converges to the minimum Bregman divergence interpolator from initialization.

entry.title: CaReFlow: Cyclic Adaptive Rectified Flow for Multimodal Fusion

author.name: Sijie Mai, Shiqin Han

entry.summary: Proposes CaReFlow, extending rectified flow for modality distribution mapping in multimodal fusion, using one-to-many mapping to expose source modality data points to the global target distribution.

entry.title: Orthogonal Uplift Learning with Permutation-Invariant Representations for Combinatorial Treatments

author.name: Xinyan Su, Jiacan Gao, Mingyuan Ma, Xiao Xu, Xinrui Wan, Tianqi Gu, Enyun Yu, Jiecheng Guo, Zhiheng Zhang

entry.summary: Studies uplift estimation for combinatorial treatments where a treatment is a context-dependent action distribution. Proposes permutation-invariant representations and orthogonal uplift learning to handle combinatorial treatment spaces in causal inference.

entry.title: SAMAS: A Spectrum-Guided Multi-Agent System for Achieving Style Fidelity in Literary Translation

author.name: Jingzhuo Wu, Jiajun Zhang, Keyan Jin, Dehua Ma, Junbo Wang

entry.summary: Introduces SAMAS, a multi-agent system for literary translation that treats style preservation as a signal processing task. Uses wavelet packet transform to quantify literary style into a Stylistic Feature Spectrum for dynamic agent workflow assembly.

entry.title: SHIELD: Semantic Heterogeneity Integrated Embedding for Latent Discovery in Clinical Trial Safety Signals

author.name: Francois Vandenhende, Anna Georgiou, Theodoros Psaras, Ellie Karekla

entry.summary: Presents SHIELD for automated safety signal detection in clinical trials, combining disproportionality analysis with semantic clustering of adverse events using MedDRA embeddings and LLM-based annotation.

entry.title: QUIETT: Query-Independent Table Transformation for Robust Reasoning

author.name: Gaurav Najpande, Tampu Ravi Kumar, Manan Roy Choudhury, Neha Valeti, Yanjie Fu, Vivek Gupta

entry.summary: Introduces QuIeTT, a query-independent table transformation framework that preprocesses raw tables into SQL-ready canonical form before queries are observed. Performs lossless schema normalization and exposes implicit relations.

entry.title: Nacrith: Neural Lossless Compression via Ensemble Context Modeling and High-Precision CDF Coding

author.name: Roberto Tacconelli

entry.summary: Presents Nacrith, a lossless compression system combining a 135M transformer LM with ensemble predictors and 32-bit arithmetic coder. Introduces CDF precision upgrade from 2^16 to 2^24 and several practical optimizations for neural compression.

entry.title: A Patient-Specific Digital Twin for Adaptive Radiotherapy of Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

author.name: Anvi Sud, Jialu Huang, Gregory R. Hart, Keshav Saxena, John Kim, Lauren Tressel, Jun Deng

entry.summary: Develops COMPASS, a patient-specific digital twin system for adaptive radiotherapy in non-small cell lung cancer that uses temporal modeling to track how tissues evolve during treatment. It moves beyond static population-based models to personalized, sequential data-driven clinical decision making.

entry.title: A high-resolution nationwide urban village mapping product for 342 Chinese cities based on foundation models

author.name: Lubin Bai, Sheng Xiao, Ziyu Yin, Haoyu Wang, Siyang Wu, Xiuyuan Zhang, Shihong Du

entry.summary: Presents GeoLink-UV, a high-resolution nationwide urban village mapping product covering 342 Chinese cities, using foundation model-driven mapping from multisource geospatial data. First consistent nationwide dataset of urban villages in China.

entry.title: Learning Cross-View Object Correspondence via Cycle-Consistent Mask Prediction

author.name: Shannan Yan, Leqi Zheng, Keyu Lv, Jingchen Ni, Hongyang Wei, Jiajun Zhang, Guangting Wang, Jing Lyu, Chun Yuan, Fengyun Rao

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for cross-view object correspondence in videos using conditional binary segmentation with cycle-consistency training. Focuses on challenging egocentric-to-exocentric scenarios without requiring ground-truth masks.

entry.title: VLM-Guided Group Preference Alignment for Diffusion-based Human Mesh Recovery

author.name: Wenhao Shen, Hao Wang, Wanqi Yin, Fayao Liu, Xulei Yang, Chao Liang, Zhongang Cai, Guosheng Lin

entry.summary: Introduces VLM-guided group preference alignment for diffusion-based human mesh recovery, using a dual-memory critique agent with self-reflection to produce quality scores that guide preference-based training.

entry.title: DD-CAM: Minimal Sufficient Explanations for Vision Models Using Delta Debugging

author.name: Krishna Khadka, Yu Lei, Raghu N. Kacker, D. Richard Kuhn

entry.summary: Introduces DD-CAM, a gradient-free explainability framework that adapts delta debugging from software engineering to find minimal sufficient subsets of representational units that preserve vision model predictions. Produces cleaner explanations than standard CAM approaches.

entry.title: TherA: Thermal-Aware Visual-Language Prompting for Controllable RGB-to-Thermal Infrared Translation

author.name: Dong-Guw Lee, Tai Hyoung Rhee, Hyunsoo Jang, Young-Sik Shin, Ukcheol Shin, Ayoung Kim

entry.summary: Proposes TherA, a controllable RGB-to-thermal infrared translation framework that uses visual-language prompting to generate thermally plausible images. Addresses the data bottleneck for thermal imaging by synthesizing pseudo TIR data with proper thermal physics.

entry.title: Learning Mutual View Information Graph for Adaptive Adversarial Collaborative Perception

author.name: Yihang Tao, Senkang Hu, Haonan An, Zhengru Fang, Hangcheng Cao, Yuguang Fang

entry.summary: Proposes a mutual view information graph approach for adversarial-robust collaborative perception in autonomous vehicles, addressing vulnerabilities in current threshold-based consensus verification through adaptive defense.

entry.title: InfScene-SR: Spatially Continuous Inference for Arbitrary-Size Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Shoukun Sun, Zhe Wang, Xiang Que, Jiyin Zhang, Xiaogang Ma

entry.summary: Proposes InfScene-SR, a framework enabling spatially continuous super-resolution for arbitrarily-sized images using diffusion models, solving the seam/inconsistency problems of independent patch processing.

entry.title: Open-vocabulary 3D scene perception in industrial environments

author.name: Keno Moenck, Adrian Philip Florea, Julian Koch, Thorsten Sch\"uppstuhl

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free open-vocabulary 3D perception pipeline for industrial environments, overcoming the failure of pre-trained segmentation models on non-household industrial objects by using superpoint merging instead.

entry.title: BigMaQ: A Big Macaque Motion and Animation Dataset Bridging Image and 3D Pose Representations

author.name: Lucas Martini, Alexander Lappe, Anna Bogn\'ar, Rufin Vogels, Martin A. Giese

entry.summary: Introduces BigMaQ, a large-scale macaque 3D motion and animation dataset with 750+ scenes of interacting animals, bridging image and 3D pose representations for non-human primate behavior analysis.

entry.title: Multi-Modal Representation Learning via Semi-Supervised Rate Reduction for Generalized Category Discovery

author.name: Wei He, Xianghan Meng, Zhiyuan Huang, Xianbiao Qi, Rong Xiao, Chun-Guang Li

entry.summary: Proposes SSR²-GCD, a multi-modal representation learning framework for Generalized Category Discovery using semi-supervised rate reduction to learn cross-modality representations with desired structural properties.

entry.title: Scout-Rover cooperation: online terrain strength mapping and traversal risk estimation for planetary-analog explorations

author.name: Shipeng Liu, J. Diego Caporale, Yifeng Zhang, Xingjue Liao, William Hoganson, Wilson Hu, Shivangi Misra, Neha Peddinti, Rachel Holladay, Ethan Fulcher, Akshay Ram Panyam, Andrik Puentes, Jordan M. Bretzfelder, Michael Zanetti, Uland Wong, Daniel E. Koditschek, Mark Yim, Douglas Jerolmack, Cynthia Sung, Feifei Qian

entry.summary: Presents a scout-rover cooperation framework where a legged robot scouts terrain strength via proprioceptive sensing and creates maps for wheeled rover path planning. Validated in planetary analog environments.

entry.title: Human-to-Robot Interaction: Learning from Video Demonstration for Robot Imitation

author.name: Thanh Nguyen Canh, Thanh-Tuan Tran, Haolan Zhang, Ziyan Gao, Nak Young Chong, Xiem HoangVan

entry.summary: Proposes a Human-to-Robot imitation learning pipeline enabling robots to acquire manipulation skills from unstructured video demonstrations, addressing limitations of general video captioning for robotic execution.

entry.title: Claude Sonnet 4.6 Gives You Flexibility

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Zvi's analysis of Claude Sonnet 4.6 release, noting it's a full Sonnet upgrade with 1M context window, strong coding/computer use capabilities, free tier availability, and positioning relative to Opus 4.6.

entry.title: Towards Personalized Multi-Modal MRI Synthesis across Heterogeneous Datasets

author.name: Yue Zhang, Zhizheng Zhuo, Siyao Xu, Shan Lv, Zhaoxi Liu, Jun Qiu, Qiuli Wang, Yaou Liu, S. Kevin Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes PMM-Synth, a personalized MRI synthesis framework that generalizes across heterogeneous datasets, supporting various synthesis tasks beyond single-dataset training and evaluation limitations.

entry.title: Beyond Description: A Multimodal Agent Framework for Insightful Chart Summarization

author.name: Yuhang Bai, Yujuan Ding, Shanru Lin, Wenqi Fan

entry.summary: Proposes Chart Insight Agent Flow, a multi-agent framework using MLLMs to uncover deeper insights from chart images beyond surface-level descriptions. Introduces ChartSummInsights benchmark with real-world charts paired with insight-rich summaries.

entry.title: Robust Exploration in Directed Controller Synthesis via Reinforcement Learning with Soft Mixture-of-Experts

author.name: Toshihide Ubukata, Zhiyao Wang, Enhong Mu, Jialong Li, Kenji Tei

entry.summary: Proposes a Soft Mixture-of-Experts framework combining multiple RL experts for directed controller synthesis, addressing anisotropic generalization where single RL policies perform well only in specific regions of the domain-parameter space.

entry.title: Rules or Weights? Comparing User Understanding of Explainable AI Techniques with the Cognitive XAI-Adaptive Model

author.name: Louth Bin Rawshan, Zhuoyu Wang, Brian Y Lim

entry.summary: Proposes CoXAM, a Cognitive XAI-Adaptive Model comparing rules vs. weights for explaining AI decisions. User study identifies 7 reasoning strategies and models the trade-off between utility and reasoning time for forward and counterfactual tasks.

entry.title: Sketch2Feedback: Grammar-in-the-Loop Framework for Rubric-Aligned Feedback on Student STEM Diagrams

author.name: Aayam Bansal

entry.summary: Sketch2Feedback is a grammar-in-the-loop framework for providing rubric-aligned feedback on student STEM diagrams. It decomposes the task into perception, symbolic graph construction, constraint checking, and constrained VLM feedback to avoid hallucination.

entry.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Optimizing Energy Consumption in Smart Grid Systems

author.name: Abeer Alsheikhi, Amirfarhad Farhadi, Azadeh Zamanifar

entry.summary: Uses Physics-Informed Neural Networks as surrogate simulators for smart grid environments to accelerate deep RL training for optimal power flow problems, reducing sample inefficiency of conventional approaches.

entry.title: Rodent-Bench

author.name: Thomas Heap, Laurence Aitchison, Emma Cahill, Adriana Casado Rodriguez

entry.summary: Rodent-Bench evaluates multimodal LLMs (Gemini-2.5-Pro, Qwen-VL-Max) on annotating rodent behavior footage across multiple behavioral paradigms. Finds current models perform inadequately for this task.

entry.title: Towards Reliable Negative Sampling for Recommendation with Implicit Feedback via In-Community Popularity

author.name: Chen Chen, Haobo Lin, Yuanbo Xu

entry.summary: ICPNS proposes community-structure-based negative sampling for recommendation systems, using in-community popularity to identify reliable and informative negative samples from implicit feedback.

entry.title: Chat-Based Support Alone May Not Be Enough: Comparing Conversational and Embedded LLM Feedback for Mathematical Proof Learning

author.name: Eason Chen, Sophia Judicke, Kayla Beigh, Xinyi Tang, Isabel Wang, Nina Yuan, Zimo Xiao, Chuangji Li, Shizhuo Li, Reed Luttmer, Shreya Singh, Maria Yampolsky, Naman Parikh, Yvonne Zhao, Meiyi Chen, Scarlett Huang, Anishka Mohanty, Gregory Johnson, John Mackey, Jionghao Lin, Ken Koedinger

entry.summary: Evaluates GPTutor, an LLM tutoring system for discrete math, finding that earlier access improves homework performance but not exam scores. Lower-self-efficacy students use both tools more frequently.

entry.title: Structure-Level Disentangled Diffusion for Few-Shot Chinese Font Generation

author.name: Jie Li, Suorong Yang, Jian Zhao, Furao Shen

entry.summary: Proposes SLD-Font for few-shot Chinese font generation using a diffusion model with structure-level disentanglement of content and style via separate input channels, using SimSun templates for content and CLIP features for style.

entry.title: CosyAccent: Duration-Controllable Accent Normalization Using Source-Synthesis Training Data

author.name: Qibing Bai, Shuhao Shi, Shuai Wang, Yukai Ju, Yannan Wang, Haizhou Li

entry.summary: CosyAccent proposes a non-autoregressive accent normalization model using 'source-synthesis' training methodology that generates L2 speech as source while using authentic native speech as target, requiring no real L2 data.

entry.title: Visual Prompt Guided Unified Pushing Policy

author.name: Hieu Bui, Ziyan Gao, Yuya Hosoda, Joo-Ho Lee

entry.summary: Proposes a unified pushing policy using visual prompts with flow matching that enables reactive, multimodal pushing actions reusable across different planning problems.

entry.title: Can Large Language Models Replace Human Coders? Introducing ContentBench

author.name: Michael Haman

entry.summary: Introduces ContentBench, a benchmark suite for evaluating whether low-cost LLMs can replace human coders in content analysis tasks. Initial results use 1,000 synthetic social-media posts labeled into five categories with consensus from SOTA models.

entry.title: TeHOR: Text-Guided 3D Human and Object Reconstruction with Textures

author.name: Hyeongjin Nam, Daniel Sungho Jung, Kyoung Mu Lee

entry.summary: TeHOR reconstructs 3D humans and objects from single images using text guidance, going beyond physical contact to capture non-contact interactions like gazing and pointing.

entry.title: ReAttn: Improving Attention-based Re-ranking via Attention Re-weighting

author.name: Yuxing Tian, Fengran Mo, Weixu Zhang, Yiyan Qi, Jian-Yun Nie

entry.summary: ReAttn proposes a post-hoc re-weighting strategy for attention-based LLM re-ranking that addresses over-concentration on few tokens and lexical bias in attention signals.

entry.title: Learning Discriminative and Generalizable Anomaly Detector for Dynamic Graph with Limited Supervision

author.name: Yuxing Tian, Yiyan Qi, Fengran Mo, Weixu Zhang, Jian Guo, Jian-Yun Nie

entry.summary: Proposes a generalizable dynamic graph anomaly detection method that learns discriminative boundaries from normal data while leveraging limited labeled anomalies without overfitting to seen anomaly types.

entry.title: SEAL-pose: Enhancing 3D Human Pose Estimation via a Learned Loss for Structural Consistency

author.name: Yeonsung Kim, Junggeun Do, Seunguk Do, Sangmin Kim, Jaesik Park, Jay-Yoon Lee

entry.summary: SEAL-pose uses a learnable loss network to train 3D human pose estimators by evaluating structural plausibility through a joint-graph-based design, replacing hand-crafted structural priors.

entry.title: StructXLIP: Enhancing Vision-language Models with Multimodal Structural Cues

author.name: Zanxi Ruan, Qiuyu Kong, Songqun Gao, Yiming Wang, Marco Cristani

entry.summary: StructXLIP enhances vision-language alignment by explicitly extracting and aligning structural cues (edge maps) across modalities, improving cross-modal retrieval on detail-rich captions.

entry.title: KNIGHT: Knowledge Graph-Driven Multiple-Choice Question Generation with Adaptive Hardness Calibration

author.name: Mohammad Amanlou, Erfan Shafiee Moghaddam, Yasaman Amou Jafari, Mahdi Noori, Farhan Farsi, Behnam Bahrak

entry.summary: KNIGHT uses knowledge graphs to generate multiple-choice questions with controllable difficulty for evaluating RAG systems. The knowledge graph serves as a compressed, reusable state enabling multi-hop question generation without re-feeding source text.

entry.title: Online decoding of rat self-paced locomotion speed from EEG using recurrent neural networks

author.name: Alejandro de Miguel, Nelson Totah, Uri Maoz

entry.summary: Demonstrates online decoding of self-paced rat locomotion speed from 32-electrode EEG using recurrent neural networks, creating a non-invasive asynchronous brain-computer interface.

entry.title: Robustness of Deep ReLU Networks to Misclassification of High-Dimensional Data

author.name: V\v{e}ra K\r{u}rkov\'a

entry.summary: Derives lower bounds on local robustness of deep ReLU networks to random input perturbations, quantifying misclassification probability in terms of input dimensionality and network size.

entry.title: CaliCausalRank: Calibrated Multi-Objective Ad Ranking with Robust Counterfactual Utility Optimization

author.name: Xikai Yang, Sebastian Sun, Yilin Li, Yue Xing, Ming Wang, Yang Wang

entry.summary: CaliCausalRank integrates training-time score calibration, Lagrangian multi-objective optimization, and counterfactual utility estimation for ad ranking, treating calibration as a first-class training objective rather than post-hoc processing.

entry.title: The Power of Decaying Steps: Enhancing Attack Stability and Transferability for Sign-based Optimizers

author.name: Wei Tao, Yang Dai, Jincai Huang, Qing Tao

entry.summary: Studies sign-based adversarial optimizers (I-FGSM, MI-FGSM) from an optimization perspective, explaining non-convergence and proposing decaying step sizes to improve attack stability and transferability.

entry.title: Sparse Masked Attention Policies for Reliable Generalization

author.name: Caroline Horsch, Laurens Engwegen, Max Weltevrede, Matthijs T. J. Spaan, Wendelin B\"ohmer

entry.summary: Proposes sparse masked attention policies for RL that learn masking functions integrated with attention weights to remove unnecessary observation information, improving generalization to unseen tasks more reliably.

entry.title: Multiclass Calibration Assessment and Recalibration of Probability Predictions via the Linear Log Odds Calibration Function

author.name: Amy Vennos, Xin Xing, Christopher T. Franck

entry.summary: Proposes MCLLO (Multicategory Linear Log Odds) recalibration for multiclass probability predictions that works without model access, provides interpretable output, and directly assesses single-model calibration.

entry.title: WiCompass: Oracle-driven Data Scaling for mmWave Human Pose Estimation

author.name: Bo Liang, Chen Gong, Haobo Wang, Qirui Liu, Rungui Zhou, Fengzhi Shao, Yubo Wang, Wei Gao, Kaichen Zhou, Guolong Cui, Chenren Xu

entry.summary: Presents WiCompass, a coverage-aware data collection framework for mmWave human pose estimation that uses motion-capture corpora to build a pose space oracle, guiding efficient data collection for better OOD robustness.

entry.title: Ani3DHuman: Photorealistic 3D Human Animation with Self-guided Stochastic Sampling

author.name: Qi Sun, Can Wang, Jiaxiang Shang, Yingchun Liu, Jing Liao

entry.summary: Presents Ani3DHuman, a framework combining kinematic animation with video diffusion priors for photorealistic 3D human animation, using a layered motion representation that disentangles rigid and non-rigid motion.

entry.title: Prognostics of Multisensor Systems with Unknown and Unlabeled Failure Modes via Bayesian Nonparametric Process Mixtures

author.name: Kani Fu, Sanduni S Disanayaka Mudiyanselage, Chunli Dai, Minhee Kim

entry.summary: Proposes a Bayesian nonparametric framework combining Dirichlet process mixtures for unsupervised failure mode discovery with neural network-based prognostics, using an iterative feedback mechanism for joint learning.

entry.title: Adaptive Data Augmentation with Multi-armed Bandit: Sample-Efficient Embedding Calibration for Implicit Pattern Recognition

author.name: Minxue Tang, Yangyang Yu, Aolin Ding, Maziyar Baran Pouyan, Taha Belkhouja Yujia Bao

entry.summary: Proposes ADAMAB, an adaptive data augmentation framework using multi-armed bandits for few-shot pattern recognition that trains lightweight calibrators on top of fixed embeddings without model parameter access.

entry.title: Janus-Q: End-to-End Event-Driven Trading via Hierarchical-Gated Reward Modeling

author.name: Xiang Li, Zikai Wei, Yiyan Qi, Wanyun Zhou, Xiang Liu, Penglei Sun, Yongqi Zhang, Xiaowen Chu

entry.summary: Proposes Janus-Q, an end-to-end event-driven trading system that uses hierarchical-gated reward modeling to bridge LLM reasoning and financially valid trading behavior. Addresses the gap between news semantics and market reaction modeling.

entry.title: FairFS: Addressing Deep Feature Selection Biases for Recommender System

author.name: Xianquan Wang, Zhaocheng Du, Jieming Zhu, Qinglin Jia, Zhenhua Dong, Kai Zhang

entry.summary: Identifies three bias issues in deep feature selection for recommender systems and proposes FairFS to address them. Targets industrial recommender systems where accurate feature importance estimation is critical for online performance.

entry.title: BURMESE-SAN: Burmese NLP Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models

author.name: Thura Aung, Jann Railey Montalan, Jian Gang Ngui, Peerat Limkonchotiwat

entry.summary: Introduces BURMESE-SAN, the first holistic benchmark for evaluating LLMs on Burmese across understanding, reasoning, and generation tasks. Covers seven subtasks constructed through native-speaker-driven processes.

entry.title: EvalSense: A Framework for Domain-Specific LLM (Meta-)Evaluation

author.name: Adam Dejl, Jonathan Pearson

entry.summary: Presents EvalSense, a framework for constructing domain-specific evaluation suites for LLMs, addressing the complexity of LLM-based evaluation methods that depend on carefully chosen models, prompts, and strategies.

entry.title: Depth from Defocus via Direct Optimization

author.name: Holly Jackson, Caleb Adams, Ignacio Lopez-Francos, Benjamin Recht

entry.summary: Demonstrates that depth-from-defocus can be solved via direct global optimization using alternating minimization, without deep learning. Shows that combining convex optimization and parallel grid search produces competitive results with contemporary methods.

entry.title: Benchmarking Computational Pathology Foundation Models For Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Lavish Ramchandani, Aashay Tinaikar, Dev Kumar Das, Rohit Garg, Tijo Thomas

entry.summary: Benchmarks 10 foundation models (CLIP, DINO, CONCH, etc.) for semantic segmentation in computational pathology using attention maps as features classified by XGBoost. Provides systematic evaluation across four histopathological datasets.

entry.title: IDperturb: Enhancing Variation in Synthetic Face Generation via Angular Perturbation

author.name: Fadi Boutros, Eduarda Caldeira, Tahar Chettaoui, Naser Damer

entry.summary: Proposes IDPERTURB, a geometric-driven sampling strategy for enhancing intra-class variation in synthetic face generation by perturbing identity embeddings within constrained angular regions on the unit hypersphere.

entry.title: Enhancing 3D LiDAR Segmentation by Shaping Dense and Accurate 2D Semantic Predictions

author.name: Xiaoyu Dong, Tiankui Xian, Wanshui Gan, Naoto Yokoya

entry.summary: Proposes MM2D3D for enhanced 3D LiDAR semantic segmentation by shaping dense and accurate 2D predictions through cross-modal guided filtering with camera images, overcoming the sparsity limitation of projected LiDAR data.

entry.title: BriMA: Bridged Modality Adaptation for Multi-Modal Continual Action Quality Assessment

author.name: Kanglei Zhou, Chang Li, Qingyi Pan, Liyuan Wang

entry.summary: Proposes BriMA for multi-modal continual action quality assessment that handles non-stationary modality imbalance where sensors may fail or annotations become unavailable during training.

entry.title: Physics-informed Active Polarimetric 3D Imaging for Specular Surfaces

author.name: Jiazhang Wang, Hyelim Yang, Tianyi Wang, Florian Willomitzer

entry.summary: Presents a physics-informed active polarimetric 3D imaging method for specular surfaces that combines deflectometry accuracy with polarimetric robustness, fusing both modalities through physics-based perspective projection.

entry.title: BayesFusion-SDF: Probabilistic Signed Distance Fusion with View Planning on CPU

author.name: Soumya Mazumdar, Vineet Kumar Rakesh, Tapas Samanta

entry.summary: Proposes BayesFusion-SDF, a CPU-centric probabilistic signed distance fusion framework that models geometry as a sparse Gaussian random field, enabling uncertainty-aware 3D reconstruction with view planning on CPU.

entry.title: DerMAE: Improving skin lesion classification through conditioned latent diffusion and MAE distillation

author.name: Francisco Filho, Kelvin Cunha, F\'abio Papais, Emanoel dos Santos, Rodrigo Mota, Thales Bezerra, Erico Medeiros, Paulo Borba, Tsang Ing Ren

entry.summary: Uses class-conditioned diffusion models to generate synthetic dermatological images for addressing class imbalance, followed by MAE pretraining and knowledge distillation to create lightweight models for mobile clinical deployment.

entry.title: Automated Disentangling Analysis of Skin Colour for Lesion Images

author.name: Wenbo Yang, Eman Rezk, Walaa M. Moursi, Zhou Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a skin-colour disentangling framework that separates environmental factors (illumination, camera) from intrinsic factors (skin tone) in dermatology images using unsupervised disentanglement. Introduces a randomized decolourization mapping to prevent information leakage.

entry.title: Linear Reservoir: A Diagonalization-Based Optimization

author.name: Romain de Coudenhove (Mnemosyne, DI-ENS), Yannis Bendi-Ouis (Mnemosyne), Anthony Strock (Mnemosyne), Xavier Hinaut (Mnemosyne)

entry.summary: Introduces a diagonalization-based optimization for Linear Echo State Networks that reduces per-step complexity from O(N²) to O(N) by reformulating reservoir dynamics in the eigenbasis. Proposes three methods for different use cases.

entry.title: TactEx: An Explainable Multimodal Robotic Interaction Framework for Human-Like Touch and Hardness Estimation

author.name: Felix Verstraete, Lan Wei, Wen Fan, Dandan Zhang

entry.summary: Presents TactEx, an explainable multimodal framework combining vision, touch (GelSight), and language (LLM) for human-like hardness estimation in robotic manipulation, demonstrated on fruit ripeness assessment.

entry.title: Distributional Stability of Tangent-Linearized Gaussian Inference on Smooth Manifolds

author.name: Junghoon Seo, Hakjin Lee, Jaehoon Sim

entry.summary: Derives non-asymptotic stability bounds for tangent-linearized Gaussian inference on smooth manifolds, separating geometric distortion from tail leakage effects and providing closed-form diagnostics.

entry.title: CACTO-BIC: Scalable Actor-Critic Learning via Biased Sampling and GPU-Accelerated Trajectory Optimization

author.name: Elisa Alboni, Pietro Noah Crestaz, Elias Fontanari, Andrea Del Prete

entry.summary: Introduces CACTO-BIC, improving the CACTO framework that combines trajectory optimization with RL by using biased sampling and GPU-accelerated optimization to address scalability limitations.

entry.title: A World Without Violet: Peculiar Consequences of Granting Moral Status to Artificial Intelligences

author.name: Sever Topan

entry.summary: This blog summarizes a published paper (AI & Society, Jan 2026) that draws an analogy between breeding brachycephalic dogs and creating AIs: both create entities whose existence generates moral obligations that wouldn't otherwise exist. It explores the philosophical implications of granting moral status to artificial intelligences.

entry.title: Revisiting the Seasonal Trend Decomposition for Enhanced Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Sanjeev Panta, Xu Yuan, Li Chen, Nian-Feng Tzeng

entry.summary: Revisits seasonal-trend decomposition for time series forecasting, finding that reversible instance normalization is effective only for the trend component while seasonal components benefit from direct backbone model application without normalization.

entry.title: HDR Reconstruction Boosting with Training-Free and Exposure-Consistent Diffusion

author.name: Yo-Tin Lin, Su-Kai Chen, Hou-Ning Hu, Yen-Yu Lin, Yu-Lun Liu

entry.summary: Presents a training-free approach for HDR reconstruction that enhances existing methods through diffusion-based inpainting of over-exposed regions, using SDEdit refinement with iterative compensation for luminance coherence.

entry.title: Learning Positive-Incentive Point Sampling in Neural Implicit Fields for Object Pose Estimation

author.name: Yifei Shi, Boyan Wan, Xin Xu, Kai Xu

entry.summary: Proposes learning positive-incentive point sampling in neural implicit fields for object pose estimation, improving canonical coordinate prediction for unobserved camera-space regions.

entry.title: Forgetting-Resistant and Lesion-Aware Source-Free Domain Adaptive Fundus Image Analysis with Vision-Language Model

author.name: Zheang Huai, Hui Tang, Hualiang Wang, Xiaomeng Li

entry.summary: Proposes a source-free domain adaptation method for fundus image analysis using vision-language models, addressing forgetting of superior target model predictions and improving lesion-level awareness through foundation model assistance.

entry.title: GenPlanner: From Noise to Plans -- Emergent Reasoning in Flow Matching and Diffusion Models

author.name: Agnieszka Polowczyk, Alicja Polowczyk, Micha{\l} Wieczorek

entry.summary: Proposes GenPlanner, using diffusion models and flow matching for path planning in mazes, demonstrating that generative models can serve as planning and reasoning mechanisms. Introduces DiffPlanner and FlowPlanner variants.

entry.title: Characterizing MARL for Energy Control: A Multi-KPI Benchmark on the CityLearn Environment

author.name: Aymen Khouja, Imen Jendoubi, Oumayma Mahjoub, Oussama Mahfoudhi, Claude Formanek, Siddarth Singh, Ruan De Kock

entry.summary: Benchmarks multiple MARL algorithms on CityLearn for urban energy management, establishing comprehensive multi-KPI evaluation across energy systems with multiple storage and renewable sources.

entry.title: Beyond Mimicry: Toward Lifelong Adaptability in Imitation Learning

author.name: Nathan Gavenski, Felipe Meneguzzi, Odinaldo Rodrigues

entry.summary: Argues imitation learning has been optimized for the wrong objective (perfect replay vs. compositional adaptability) and proposes a research agenda centered on learning behavioral primitives that can be recombined in novel contexts.

entry.title: NI-Tex: Non-isometric Image-based Garment Texture Generation

author.name: Hui Shan, Ming Li, Haitao Yang, Kai Zheng, Sizhe Zheng, Yanwei Fu, Xiangru Huang

entry.summary: Addresses non-isometric garment texture generation from images, constructing a method that doesn't require strict topological consistency between input image and 3D mesh. Enables more flexible texture extraction from wild images.

entry.title: From "Help" to Helpful: A Hierarchical Assessment of LLMs in Mental e-Health Applications

author.name: Philipp Steigerwald, Jens Albrecht

entry.summary: Evaluates 11 LLMs on generating German counselling email subject lines for mental health e-health, comparing proprietary and privacy-preserving open-source models. Finds trade-offs between performance and privacy.

entry.title: Can Multimodal LLMs See Science Instruction? Benchmarking Pedagogical Reasoning in K-12 Classroom Videos

author.name: Yixuan Shen, Peng He, Honglu Liu, Yuyang Ji, Tingting Li, Tianlong Chen, Kaidi Xu, Feng Liu

entry.summary: Introduces SciIBI, the first video benchmark for analyzing science classroom discourse aligned with NGSS standards, featuring 113 annotated clips. Evaluates eight LLMs and multimodal LLMs, revealing fundamental limitations in understanding pedagogical reasoning.

entry.title: Heterogeneity-agnostic AI/ML-assisted beam selection for multi-panel arrays

author.name: Ibrahim Kilinc, Robert W. Heath Jr

entry.summary: Proposes a heterogeneity-agnostic AI/ML beam selection algorithm for multi-panel arrays that predicts wireless propagation characteristics independent of antenna configuration, deriving an RSRP model decoupling antenna effects.

entry.title: HONEST-CAV: Hierarchical Optimization of Network Signals and Trajectories for Connected and Automated Vehicles with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ziyan Zhang, Changxin Wan, Peng Hao, Kanok Boriboonsomsin, Matthew J. Barth, Yongkang Liu, Seyhan Ucar, Guoyuan Wu

entry.summary: HONEST-CAV presents a hierarchical framework for network-level traffic flow control in mixed human-CAV traffic, combining MARL-based signal control with ML-based trajectory planning for eco-driving.

entry.title: ArabicNumBench: Evaluating Arabic Number Reading in Large Language Models

author.name: Anas Alhumud, Abdulaziz Alhammadi, Muhammad Badruddin Khan

entry.summary: ArabicNumBench evaluates 71 LLMs on Arabic number reading across Eastern Arabic-Indic and Western Arabic numerals, finding wide accuracy variation (14-99%) across models and revealing that few-shot CoT works best.

entry.title: Routing-Aware Explanations for Mixture of Experts Graph Models in Malware Detection

author.name: Hossein Shokouhinejad, Roozbeh Razavi-Far, Griffin Higgins, Ali. A Ghorbani

entry.summary: Investigates routing-aware explanations for Mixture-of-Experts graph models applied to malware detection using control flow graphs, building diversity at both node and readout levels.

entry.title: A Statistical Approach for Modeling Irregular Multivariate Time Series with Missing Observations

author.name: Dingyi Nie, Yixing Wu, C. -C. Jay Kuo

entry.summary: Proposes extracting simple time-agnostic summary statistics from irregular multivariate time series to create fixed-dimensional representations, then using standard classifiers like XGBoost. Evaluated on four biomedical datasets.

entry.title: Temporal-Aware Heterogeneous Graph Reasoning with Multi-View Fusion for Temporal Question Answering

author.name: Wuzhenghong Wen, Bowen Zhou, Jinwen Huang, Xianjie Wu, Yuwei Sun, Su Pan, Liang Li, Jianting Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a temporal-aware heterogeneous graph reasoning framework for question answering over temporal knowledge graphs, with multi-hop reasoning and multi-view fusion of language and graph representations.

entry.title: Tri-Subspaces Disentanglement for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis

author.name: Chunlei Meng, Jiabin Luo, Zhenglin Yan, Zhenyu Yu, Rong Fu, Zhongxue Gan, Chun Ouyang

entry.summary: Proposes Tri-Subspace Disentanglement for multimodal sentiment analysis, factoring features into common, pairwise-shared, and private subspaces across language, visual, and acoustic modalities.

entry.title: Cooperation After the Algorithm: Designing Human-AI Coexistence Beyond the Illusion of Collaboration

author.name: Tatia Codreanu

entry.summary: Argues that stable human-AI coexistence requires institutional governance infrastructure, introducing a formal inequality for when AI reliance yields positive expected value. Draws on institutional analysis and evolutionary cooperation theory.

entry.title: The Confusion is Real: GRAPHIC - A Network Science Approach to Confusion Matrices in Deep Learning

author.name: Johanna S. Fr\"ohlich, Bastian Heinlein, Jan U. Claar, Hans Rosenberger, Vasileios Belagiannis, Ralf R. M\"uller

entry.summary: GRAPHIC uses network science to analyze confusion matrices from intermediate layers of neural networks, treating them as adjacency matrices of directed graphs to visualize and quantify learning dynamics.

entry.title: Depth-Structured Music Recurrence: Budgeted Recurrent Attention for Full-Piece Symbolic Music Modeling

author.name: Yungang Yi

entry.summary: DSMR introduces depth-structured recurrence for full-piece symbolic music generation, using segment-level recurrence with layer-wise memory budgets to model long contexts efficiently.

entry.title: Efficient endometrial carcinoma screening via cross-modal synthesis and gradient distillation

author.name: Dongjing Shan, Yamei Luo, Jiqing Xuan, Lu Huang, Jin Li, Mengchu Yang, Zeyu Chen, Fajin Lv, Yong Tang, Chunxiang Zhang

entry.summary: Presents an efficient two-stage deep learning framework for endometrial carcinoma screening from ultrasound, using cross-modal synthesis and gradient distillation to handle class imbalance.

entry.title: HeatPrompt: Zero-Shot Vision-Language Modeling of Urban Heat Demand from Satellite Images

author.name: Kundan Thota, Xuanhao Mu, Thorsten Schlachter, Veit Hagenmeyer

entry.summary: HeatPrompt uses VLMs in zero-shot fashion to estimate building heat demand from satellite images by extracting visual attributes like roof age and building density through domain-specific prompts.

entry.title: Robust Taylor-Lagrange Control for Safety-Critical Systems

author.name: Wei Xiao, Christos Cassandras, Anni Li

entry.summary: Proposes robust Taylor-Lagrange Control (rTLC) that addresses feasibility preservation in safety-critical control by expanding the safety function at higher order than the relative degree.

entry.title: Transcending the Annotation Bottleneck: AI-Powered Discovery in Biology and Medicine

author.name: Soumick Chatterjee

entry.summary: Reviews the paradigm shift from supervised to self-supervised learning in biomedicine, showing how SSL unlocks biobank-scale datasets for novel phenotype discovery, morphology-genetics linkage, and anomaly detection.

entry.title: Modeling Epidemiological Dynamics Under Adversarial Data and User Deception

author.name: Yiqi Su, Christo Kurisummoottil Thomas, Walid Saad, Bud Mishra, Naren Ramakrishnan

entry.summary: Introduces a game-theoretic framework modeling strategic misreporting of health behaviors (vaccination, masking) as a signaling game between population and public health authorities. Addresses how adversarial/deceptive self-reported data undermines epidemiological models.

entry.title: Learning Beyond Optimization: Stress-Gated Dynamical Regime Regulation in Autonomous Systems

author.name: Sheng Ran

entry.summary: Proposes a stress-gated dynamical regime regulation mechanism for autonomous systems that can determine if internal dynamics are productive without an explicit objective function, inspired by biological stress responses.

entry.title: Diagnosing LLM Reranker Behavior Under Fixed Evidence Pools

author.name: Baris Arat, Emre Sefer

entry.summary: Introduces a controlled diagnostic for LLM rerankers using fixed evidence pools from Multi-News clusters, isolating ranking behavior from retrieval quality. Finds divergent redundancy patterns across LLM rerankers.

entry.title: Phase-Consistent Magnetic Spectral Learning for Multi-View Clustering

author.name: Mingdong Lu, Zhikui Chen, Meng Liu, Shubin Ma, Liang Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes Phase-Consistent Magnetic Spectral Learning for multi-view clustering, using magnetic Laplacian spectral methods to model directional agreement across views and resolve contradictory cross-view relations.

entry.title: DeepInterestGR: Mining Deep Multi-Interest Using Multi-Modal LLMs for Generative Recommendation

author.name: Yangchen Zeng

entry.summary: DeepInterestGR uses multiple LLMs including multi-modal variants to extract deep semantic interests from user interactions for generative recommendation, going beyond shallow textual features like titles.

entry.title: Spiking Graph Predictive Coding for Reliable OOD Generalization

author.name: Jing Ren, Jiapeng Du, Bowen Li, Ziqi Xu, Xin Zheng, Hong Jia, Suyu Ma, Xiwei Xu, Feng Xia

entry.summary: Combines spiking neural networks with graph predictive coding for OOD generalization in GNNs, targeting reliable uncertainty estimation for web-based applications.

entry.title: Advantage-based Temporal Attack in Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Shenghong He

entry.summary: Proposes an Advantage-based Adversarial Transformer (AAT) for temporally correlated adversarial attacks on deep RL, using advantage functions to capture dependencies between perturbations across time steps.

entry.title: A Computationally Efficient Multidimensional Vision Transformer

author.name: Alaa El Ichi, Khalide Jbilou

entry.summary: Introduces TCP-ViT, a tensor-based Vision Transformer using the Tensor Cosine Product to reduce computational and memory costs by exploiting multilinear structure in image data.

entry.title: Bounds and Identification of Joint Probabilities of Potential Outcomes and Observed Variables under Monotonicity Assumptions

author.name: Naoya Hashimoto, Yuta Kawakami, Jin Tian

entry.summary: Proposes new monotonicity assumptions and linear programming formulations for bounding and identifying joint probabilities of potential outcomes in causal inference with discrete treatment and ordinal outcomes.

entry.title: An Interpretable Data-Driven Model of the Flight Dynamics of Hawks

author.name: Lydia France, Karl Lapo, J. Nathan Kutz

entry.summary: Uses dynamic mode decomposition on motion capture data of hawks to identify interpretable behavioral states (flapping, turning, gliding) as simple modal structures that can be linearly combined to reproduce flight observations.

entry.title: Controlled Face Manipulation and Synthesis for Data Augmentation

author.name: Joris Kirchner, Amogh Gudi, Marian Bittner, Chirag Raman

entry.summary: Studies controlled face manipulation and synthesis for data augmentation in facial expression analysis, using diffusion autoencoder latent space with dependency-aware conditioning and orthogonal projection to reduce entanglement.

entry.title: SplitLight: An Exploratory Toolkit for Recommender Systems Datasets and Splits

author.name: Anna Volodkevich, Dmitry Anikin, Danil Gusak, Anton Klenitskiy, Evgeny Frolov, Alexey Vasilev

entry.summary: Introduces SplitLight, an open-source toolkit for analyzing and comparing data preprocessing and splitting pipelines in recommender systems, making hidden data preparation choices measurable and reportable.

entry.title: Gradient based Severity Labeling for Biomarker Classification in OCT

author.name: Kiran Kokilepersaud, Mohit Prabhushankar, Ghassan AlRegib, Stephanie Trejo Corona, Charles Wykoff

entry.summary: Proposes a gradient-based selection strategy for contrastive learning in medical images, generating disease severity labels for unlabeled OCT scans using gradient responses from anomaly detection. Enables more clinically meaningful positive/negative pair selection.

entry.title: INSURE-Dial: A Phase-Aware Conversational Dataset \& Benchmark for Compliance Verification and Phase Detection

author.name: Shubham Kulkarni, Alexander Lyzhov, Preetam Joshi, Shiva Chaitanya

entry.summary: Introduces INSURE-Dial, the first public benchmark for compliance-aware voice agents handling insurance benefit verification calls. Includes 50 real AI-initiated calls and 1000 synthetic calls with phase-structured annotations.

entry.title: From Trial by Fire To Sleep Like a Baby: A Lexicon of Anxiety Associations for 20k English Multiword Expressions

author.name: Saif M. Mohammad

entry.summary: Introduces the first large-scale lexicon of anxiety associations for 20k+ English multiword expressions. Studies prevalence of anxiety/calmness-associated MWEs and their properties across different expression lengths.

entry.title: Contradiction to Consensus: Dual Perspective, Multi Source Retrieval Based Claim Verification with Source Level Disagreement using LLM

author.name: Md Badsha Biswas, Ozlem Uzuner

entry.summary: Presents a claim verification system using LLMs with multi-perspective evidence retrieval and cross-source disagreement analysis. Leverages multiple knowledge sources rather than a single source to improve fact-checking coverage and transparency.

entry.title: Personalized Prediction of Perceived Message Effectiveness Using Large Language Model Based Digital Twins

author.name: Jasmin Han (Department of Mental Health, Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health, Baltimore, MD, USA), Janardan Devkota (Department of Mental Health, Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health, Baltimore, MD, USA), Joseph Waring (Department of Mental Health, Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health, Baltimore, MD, USA), Amanda Luken (Department of Health Sciences, Towson University, Towson, USA), Felix Naughton (Addiction Research Group, University of East Anglia, Norwich, UK), Roger Vilardaga (Department of Implementation Science, Wake Forest University School of Medicine, Winston-Salem, USA), Jonathan Bricker (Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center, Seattle, USA, Department of Psychology, University of Washington, Seattle, USA), Carl Latkin (Department of Health, Behavior and Society, Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health, Baltimore, USA), Meghan Moran (Department of Health, Behavior and Society, Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health, Baltimore, USA), Yiqun Chen (Department of Biostatistics, Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health, Baltimore, USA, Department of Computer Science, Johns Hopkins Whiting School of Engineering, Baltimore, USA), Johannes Thrul (Department of Mental Health, Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health, Baltimore, MD, USA, Sidney Kimmel Comprehensive Cancer Center at Johns Hopkins, Baltimore, USA, Centre for Alcohol Policy Research, La Trobe University, Melbourne, Australia)

entry.summary: Evaluates whether LLMs can predict Perceived Message Effectiveness for smoking cessation messages, comparing supervised models, zero/few-shot LLMs, and LLM-based digital twins that incorporate individual user profiles.

entry.title: Hyper-KGGen: A Skill-Driven Knowledge Extractor for High-Quality Knowledge Hypergraph Generation

author.name: Rizhuo Huang, Yifan Feng, Rundong Xue, Shihui Ying, Jun-Hai Yong, Chuan Shi, Shaoyi Du, Yue Gao

entry.summary: Proposes Hyper-KGGen, a skill-driven framework for constructing knowledge hypergraphs that captures n-ary relationships. Uses coarse-to-fine document decomposition and dynamic skill evolution to bridge domain-specific extraction gaps.

entry.title: The Algorithmic Unconscious: Structural Mechanisms and Implicit Biases in Large Language Models

author.name: Philippe Boisnard

entry.summary: Introduces the concept of 'algorithmic unconscious' to describe structural biases in LLMs that emerge from technical mechanisms (tokenization, attention, optimization) rather than dataset composition or human intentionality.

entry.title: VIGiA: Instructional Video Guidance via Dialogue Reasoning and Retrieval

author.name: Diogo Gl\'oria-Silva, David Semedo, Jo\~ao Maglh\~aes

entry.summary: Introduces VIGiA, a multimodal dialogue model for instructional video guidance that supports plan-aware reasoning over visual inputs, instructional plans, and user interactions, with both multimodal plan reasoning and plan-based retrieval capabilities.

entry.title: NILE: Formalizing Natural-Language Descriptions of Formal Languages

author.name: Tristan Kneisel, Marko Schmellenkamp, Fabian Vehlken, Thomas Zeume

entry.summary: Introduces NILE, a representation language for formal languages designed to bridge natural-language descriptions and formal representations (automata, grammars, etc.). The system judges whether NL descriptions accurately match formal languages and explains discrepancies, motivated by educational applications.

entry.title: Effect of Patch Size on Fine-Tuning Vision Transformers in Two-Dimensional and Three-Dimensional Medical Image Classification

author.name: Massoud Dehghan, Ramona Woitek, Amirreza Mahbod

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates how patch size affects Vision Transformer classification performance across 12 medical imaging datasets (7 2D and 5 3D). Finds that optimal patch size varies by modality and provides practical guidance for ViT configuration in medical domains.

entry.title: NeXt2Former-CD: Efficient Remote Sensing Change Detection with Modern Vision Architectures

author.name: Yufan Wang, Sokratis Makrogiannis, Chandra Kambhamettu

entry.summary: Introduces NeXt2Former-CD for remote sensing change detection, combining a Siamese ConvNeXt encoder with DINOv3 weights, deformable attention fusion, and Mask2Former decoder. Achieves best results on LEVIR-CD, WHU-CD, and CDD datasets.

entry.title: Optimizing ID Consistency in Multimodal Large Models: Facial Restoration via Alignment, Entanglement, and Disentanglement

author.name: Yuran Dong, Hang Dai, Mang Ye

entry.summary: Proposes EditedID, an Alignment-Disentanglement-Entanglement framework for preserving facial identity consistency during portrait editing with multimodal large models. Addresses cross-source distribution bias and feature contamination.

entry.title: IDSelect: A RL-Based Cost-Aware Selection Agent for Video-based Multi-Modal Person Recognition

author.name: Yuyang Ji, Yixuan Shen, Kien Nguyen, Lifeng Zhou, Feng Liu

entry.summary: Proposes IDSelect, a reinforcement learning-based cost-aware agent that selects one pre-trained model per modality per sequence for video-based person recognition, optimizing the accuracy-efficiency trade-off.

entry.title: PositionOCR: Augmenting Positional Awareness in Multi-Modal Models via Hybrid Specialist Integration

author.name: Chen Duan, Zhentao Guo, Pei Fu, Zining Wang, Kai Zhou, Pengfei Yan

entry.summary: Proposes PositionOCR, integrating OCR specialist models with MLLMs to improve positional reasoning for text spotting and grounding tasks, combining the strengths of both approaches.

entry.title: Prefer-DAS: Learning from Local Preferences and Sparse Prompts for Domain Adaptive Segmentation of Electron Microscopy

author.name: Jiabao Chen, Shan Xiong, Jialin Peng

entry.summary: Proposes Prefer-DAS for domain adaptive segmentation of electron microscopy images, using sparse points and local human preferences as weak labels for the target domain. Combines self-training with prompt-guided learning and preference alignment.

entry.title: RADE-Net: Robust Attention Network for Radar-Only Object Detection in Adverse Weather

author.name: Christof Leitgeb, Thomas Puchleitner, Max Peter Ronecker, Daniel Watzenig

entry.summary: Proposes RADE-Net for radar-only object detection in adverse weather, using a 3D projection method for 4D RADE tensors and robust attention mechanisms to extract dense features from low-level radar data.

entry.title: Compact Hadamard Latent Codes for Efficient Spectral Rendering

author.name: Jiaqi Yu, Dar'ya Guarnera, Giuseppe Claudio Guarnera

entry.summary: Proposes Hadamard spectral codes, a compact latent representation enabling spectral rendering using standard RGB rendering operations. This reduces computational cost by approximating spectral images with a small number of RGB rendering passes while preserving linearity properties for reflectance and illumination.

entry.title: Using Unsupervised Domain Adaptation Semantic Segmentation for Pulmonary Embolism Detection in Computed Tomography Pulmonary Angiogram (CTPA) Images

author.name: Wen-Liang Lin, Yun-Chien Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes an unsupervised domain adaptation framework for pulmonary embolism detection in CTPA images, using a Transformer backbone with Mean-Teacher architecture and three modules for improving pseudo-label reliability across medical centers.

entry.title: Musical Training, but not Mere Exposure to Music, Drives the Emergence of Chroma Equivalence in Artificial Neural Networks

author.name: Lukas Grasse, Matthew S. Tata

entry.summary: Uses artificial neural networks to investigate whether chroma equivalence (octave similarity in music) emerges from musical training or mere exposure. Finds that musical training, not just exposure, drives this perceptual phenomenon in ANNs.

entry.title: Temporal-Logic-Aware Frontier-Based Exploration

author.name: Azizollah Taheri, Derya Aksaray

entry.summary: Proposes a frontier-based exploration algorithm incorporating temporal logic specifications (scLTL) for robots in unknown environments. Introduces 'commit states' to track irreversible task progress.

entry.title: Understanding Fire Through Thermal Radiation Fields for Mobile Robots

author.name: Anton R. Wagner, Madhan Balaji Rao, Xuesu Xiao, S\"oren Pirk

entry.summary: Presents a novel approach for mobile robots to understand fire by building real-time thermal radiation fields from registered depth and thermal images, using Stefan-Boltzmann law for thermally safe path planning.

entry.title: Distributed and Consistent Multi-Robot Visual-Inertial-Ranging Odometry on Lie Groups

author.name: Ziwei Kang, Yizhi Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes DC-VIRO, a distributed collaborative visual-inertial-ranging odometry framework tightly fusing VIO and UWB measurements across multiple robots without pre-calibrated anchors.

entry.title: Fact-checking an AI optimist article in The Economist

author.name: ToSummarise

entry.summary: Fact-checks an Economist article claiming AI won't displace white-collar jobs, finding the article lacked baselines, cherry-picked roles, and used unreliable data for its claims about paralegal and other job growth.

entry.title: Why I Think Pause is Impossible

author.name: E.G. Blee-Goldman

entry.summary: Argues that pausing AI development is impossible because it's a dominated strategy in game-theoretic terms: requires indefinite commitment, verifiable compliance, simultaneous action, and no alternative paths to power - none of which hold.

entry.title: RKHS Representation of Algebraic Convolutional Filters with Integral Operators

author.name: Alejandro Parada-Mayorga, Alejandro Ribeiro, Juan Bazerque

entry.summary: Develops comprehensive RKHS theory showing that integral operators naturally induce reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces for convolutional signal processing, connecting algebraic signal processing with kernel methods.

entry.title: PIS: A Physics-Informed System for Accurate State Partitioning of $A\beta_{42}$ Protein Trajectories

author.name: Qianfeng Yu, Ningkang Peng, Yanhui Gu

entry.summary: PIS integrates physics priors (radius of gyration, SASA) into feature extraction for metastable state partitioning of Aβ42 protein trajectories relevant to Alzheimer's disease.

entry.title: OSInsert: Towards High-authenticity and High-fidelity Image Composition

author.name: Jingyuan Wang, Li Niu

entry.summary: Proposes OSInsert, a two-stage strategy for image composition that first generates compatible foreground shape using high-authenticity methods, then preserves foreground details using high-fidelity methods. Bridges the authenticity-fidelity trade-off.

entry.title: Contrastive meta-domain adaptation for robust skin lesion classification across clinical and acquisition conditions

author.name: Rodrigo Mota, Kelvin Cunha, Emanoel dos Santos, F\'abio Papais, Francisco Filho, Thales Bezerra, Erico Medeiros, Paulo Borba, Tsang Ing Ren

entry.summary: Investigates domain adaptation for skin lesion classification using visual meta-domains to transfer representations from dermoscopic to clinical image domains, showing consistent gains across datasets.

entry.title: TactiVerse: Generalizing Multi-Point Tactile Sensing in Soft Robotics Using Single-Point Data

author.name: Junhui Lee, Hyosung Kim, Saekwang Nam

entry.summary: Introduces TactiVerse, a U-Net framework for tactile contact geometry estimation that generalizes from single-point training data to multi-point sensing scenarios, achieving 0.0589mm mean absolute error.

entry.title: Automated Generation of Microfluidic Netlists using Large Language Models

author.name: Jasper Davidson, Skylar Stockham, Allen Boston, Ashton Snelgrove. Valerio Tenace, Pierre-Emmanuel Gaillardon

entry.summary: Demonstrates the first practical application of LLMs for generating microfluidic device netlists from natural language specifications, converting device descriptions to system-level structural Verilog. Builds on prior HDL code generation work.

entry.title: Finding the Signal in the Noise: An Exploratory Study on Assessing the Effectiveness of AI and Accessibility Forums for Blind Users' Support Needs

author.name: Satwik Ram Kodandaram, Jiawei Zhou, Xiaojun Bi, IV Ramakrishnan, Vikas Ashok

entry.summary: Interviews 14 blind users about their experiences with accessibility forums and generative AI tools, finding that forums overwhelm with redundant content while GenAI tools introduce hallucination risks and poor source attribution.

entry.title: UniRank: A Multi-Agent Calibration Pipeline for Estimating University Rankings from Anonymized Bibliometric Signals

author.name: Pedram Riyazimehr, Seyyed Ehsan Mahmoudi

entry.summary: UniRank uses a multi-agent LLM pipeline to estimate university rankings from anonymized bibliometric data, employing zero-shot estimation, tool-augmented calibration, and synthesis while preventing LLM memorization.

entry.title: CORVET: A CORDIC-Powered, Resource-Frugal Mixed-Precision Vector Processing Engine for High-Throughput AIoT applications

author.name: Sonu Kumar, Mohd Faisal Khan, Mukul Lokhande, Santosh Kumar Vishvakarma

entry.summary: CORVET presents a CORDIC-based mixed-precision vector processing engine for edge AI with runtime-adaptive accuracy/latency tradeoffs and up to 4x throughput improvement through vectorized execution.

entry.title: FinSight-Net:A Physics-Aware Decoupled Network with Frequency-Domain Compensation for Underwater Fish Detection in Smart Aquaculture

author.name: Jinsong Yang, Zeyuan Hu, Yichen Li, Hong Yu

entry.summary: FinSight-Net proposes a physics-aware detection framework for underwater fish detection that models wavelength-dependent absorption and turbidity-induced scattering with frequency-domain compensation.

entry.title: CLCR: Cross-Level Semantic Collaborative Representation for Multimodal Learning

author.name: Chunlei Meng, Guanhong Huang, Rong Fu, Runmin Jian, Zhongxue Gan, Chun Ouyang

entry.summary: CLCR organizes multimodal features into three semantic levels and specifies level-wise constraints for cross-modal interactions to address semantic misalignment in multimodal fusion.

entry.title: NEXUS : A compact neural architecture for high-resolution spatiotemporal air quality forecasting in Delhi Nationa Capital Region

author.name: Rampunit Kumar, Aditya Maheshwari

entry.summary: NEXUS is a compact neural architecture for spatiotemporal air quality forecasting in Delhi, achieving R² > 0.91-0.95 for multiple pollutants with only 18K parameters, far fewer than competing architectures.

entry.title: Vectorized Bayesian Inference for Latent Dirichlet-Tree Allocation

author.name: Zheng Wang, Nizar Bouguila

entry.summary: Introduces Latent Dirichlet-Tree Allocation (LDTA), generalizing LDA by replacing the Dirichlet prior with a Dirichlet-Tree distribution. Develops vectorized variational inference and expectation propagation methods.

entry.title: Beyond Accuracy: A Unified Random Matrix Theory Diagnostic Framework for Crash Classification Models

author.name: Ibne Farabi Shihab, Sanjeda Akter, Anuj Sharma

entry.summary: Introduces a spectral diagnostic framework based on Random Matrix Theory for evaluating crash classification models, finding that power-law exponents of weight matrices provide structural quality signals beyond accuracy.

entry.title: Event-Triggered Gossip for Distributed Learning

author.name: Zhiyuan Zhai, Xiaojun Yuan, Wei Ni, Xin Wang, Rui Zhang, Geoffrey Ye Li

entry.summary: Develops an event-triggered gossip framework for distributed learning that reduces inter-node communication by letting nodes autonomously decide when to exchange model information based on local model deviations.

entry.title: TriTopic: Tri-Modal Graph-Based Topic Modeling with Iterative Refinement and Archetypes
