author.name: Roman Egger

entry.summary: Presents TriTopic, a topic modeling framework using tri-modal graph fusion of embeddings, TF-IDF, and metadata with consensus clustering and iterative refinement. Addresses BERTopic's instability and embedding blur limitations.

entry.title: TurkicNLP: An NLP Toolkit for Turkic Languages

author.name: Sherzod Hakimov

entry.summary: Presents TurkicNLP, an open-source Python library providing unified NLP pipelines for Turkic languages across four script families, covering tokenization, morphological analysis, NER, translation, and more.

entry.title: Subtle Motion Blur Detection and Segmentation from Static Image Artworks

author.name: Ganesh Samarth, Sibendu Paul, Solale Tabarestani, Caren Chen

entry.summary: Proposes SMBlurDetect for detecting and segmenting subtle motion blur in static images, motivated by streaming service visual asset quality. Creates new annotated datasets for fine-grained blur detection surpassing existing benchmarks.

entry.title: Detector-in-the-Loop Tracking: Active Memory Rectification for Stable Glottic Opening Localization

author.name: Huayu Wang, Bahaa Alattar, Cheng-Yen Yang, Hsiang-Wei Huang, Jung Heon Kim, Linda Shapiro, Nathan White, Jenq-Neng Hwang

entry.summary: Proposes Closed-Loop Memory Correction (CL-MC) for stable glottic opening localization in video laryngoscopy, combining single-frame detectors with SAM2 tracking through confidence-aligned state decisions and active memory rectification.

entry.title: 4D-UNet improves clutter rejection in human transcranial contrast enhanced ultrasound

author.name: Tristan Beruard, Armand Delbos, Arthur Chavignon, Maxence Reberol, Vincent Hingot

entry.summary: Presents a 4D U-Net approach for clutter filtering in transcranial 3D contrast-enhanced ultrasound, exploiting spatial and temporal information to improve microbubble detection through skull in human adults.

entry.title: Soft Surfaced Vision-Based Tactile Sensing for Bipedal Robot Applications

author.name: Jaeeun Kim, Junhee Lim, Yu She

entry.summary: Presents a soft-surfaced, vision-based tactile foot sensor for bipedal robots that captures contact deformations optically, enabling contact pose estimation, terrain classification, and balance control improvement.

entry.title: 3D Shape Control of Extensible Multi-Section Soft Continuum Robots via Visual Servoing

author.name: Abhinav Gandhi, Shou-Shan Chiang, Cagdas D. Onal, Berk Calli

entry.summary: Proposes a 2.5D visual servoing algorithm for controlling the entire body shape of extensible multi-section soft continuum manipulators, achieving globally stable convergence without proprioceptive sensors.

entry.title: On the Dynamics of Observation and Semantics

author.name: Xiu Li

entry.summary: Proposes a fiber bundle formalism for visual intelligence, arguing semantics arise from the interaction of bounded agents with high-entropy environments rather than being static properties of embeddings. The work formalizes observation-semantics coupling through differential geometry.

entry.title: How Far Can We Go with Pixels Alone? A Pilot Study on Screen-Only Navigation in Commercial 3D ARPGs

author.name: Kaijie Xu, Mustafa Bugti, Clark Verbrugge

entry.summary: Builds a screen-only navigation agent for commercial 3D ARPGs (Dark Souls-style) that operates purely from visual affordances without game state access. Demonstrates feasibility and limitations of pixel-based exploration in complex game environments.

entry.title: Defining Explainable AI for Requirements Analysis

author.name: Raymond Sheh, Isaac Monteath

entry.summary: Proposes a three-dimensional framework for defining explainability requirements in AI systems, aimed at supporting requirements analysis for XAI. Helps practitioners systematically determine what explanations are needed for different applications.

entry.title: Meta-Learning and Meta-Reinforcement Learning - Tracing the Path towards DeepMind's Adaptive Agent

author.name: Bj\"orn Hoppmann, Christoph Scholz

entry.summary: Survey tracing the evolution from meta-learning and meta-RL to DeepMind's Adaptive Agent, providing task-based formalization and chronicling landmark algorithms.

entry.title: DEFNet: Multitasks-based Deep Evidential Fusion Network for Blind Image Quality Assessment

author.name: Yiwei Lou, Yuanpeng He, Rongchao Zhang, Yongzhi Cao, Hanpin Wang, Yu Huang

entry.summary: Proposes DEFNet for blind image quality assessment using deep evidential fusion with multitask optimization (scene classification, distortion type classification) and a trustworthy information fusion strategy.

entry.title: Developing a Multi-Agent System to Generate Next Generation Science Assessments with Evidence-Centered Design

author.name: Yaxuan Yang, Jongchan Park, Yifan Zhou, Xiaoming Zhai

entry.summary: Develops a multi-agent LLM system to automate the generation of science assessments using Evidence-Centered Design (ECD) framework, targeting NGSS-aligned educational assessments. Addresses the high cost and expertise requirements of assessment development.

entry.title: PIPE-RDF: An LLM-Assisted Pipeline for Enterprise RDF Benchmarking

author.name: Suraj Ranganath

entry.summary: PIPE-RDF is a pipeline for constructing schema-specific natural language-to-SPARQL benchmarks for enterprise RDF knowledge graphs, using reverse querying, template generation, and retrieval-augmented prompting.

entry.title: AdaptStress: Online Adaptive Learning for Interpretable and Personalized Stress Prediction Using Multivariate and Sparse Physiological Signals

author.name: Xueyi Wang, Claudine J. C. Lamoth, Elisabeth Wilhelm

entry.summary: AdaptStress presents an explainable, personalized stress prediction approach using smartwatch physiological data, comparing against modern time series models across 16 temporal horizons for 16 participants.

entry.title: Lost in Instructions: Study of Blind Users' Experiences with DIY Manuals and AI-Rewritten Instructions for Assembly, Operation, and Troubleshooting of Tangible Products

author.name: Monalika Padma Reddy, Aruna Balasubramanian, Jiawei Zhou, Xiaojun Bi, IV Ramakrishnan, Vikas Ashok

entry.summary: Studies how blind individuals use AI tools and product manuals for DIY assembly, operation, and troubleshooting of physical products. Finds product manuals are essential but inadequate, while AI tools struggle with spatial reasoning for physical tasks.

entry.title: EDU-MATRIX: A Society-Centric Generative Cognitive Digital Twin Architecture for Secondary Education

author.name: Wenjing Zhai, Jianbin Zhang, Tao Liu

entry.summary: EDU-MATRIX proposes a 'society-centric' digital twin architecture for educational simulation that shifts from agent-centric to social-space modeling, using environment context injection and modular logic evolution.

entry.title: Carbon-aware decentralized dynamic task offloading in MIMO-MEC networks via multi-agent reinforcement learning

author.name: Mubshra Zulfiqar, Muhammad Ayzed Mirza, Basit Qureshi

entry.summary: CADDTO-PPO is a carbon-aware decentralized task offloading framework for MIMO-MEC networks using multi-agent PPO, integrating renewable energy harvesting considerations.

entry.title: When the Inference Meets the Explicitness or Why Multimodality Can Make Us Forget About the Perfect Predictor

author.name: J. E. Dom\'inguez-Vidal, Alberto Sanfeliu

entry.summary: Compares intention prediction models vs. explicit communication methods (button/voice) for human-robot collaborative object transportation, finding that explicit communication outperforms inference-based approaches for predicting human intent.

entry.title: Orchestrating LLM Agents for Scientific Research: A Pilot Study of Multiple Choice Question (MCQ) Generation and Evaluation

author.name: Yuan An

entry.summary: Reports a pilot study of an AI-orchestrated research workflow where a human researcher coordinated multiple LLM agents for MCQ generation and evaluation, collecting 1,071 SAT Math MCQs and assessing quality through mixed methods.

entry.title: IPv2: An Improved Image Purification Strategy for Real-World Ultra-Low-Dose Lung CT Denoising

author.name: Guoliang Gong, Man Yu

entry.summary: IPv2 improves upon image purification strategies for ultra-low-dose lung CT denoising by adding background treatment and lung parenchyma-specific denoising mechanisms.

entry.title: Large Language Model-Assisted UAV Operations and Communications: A Multifaceted Survey and Tutorial

author.name: Yousef Emami, Hao Zhou, Radha Reddy, Atefeh Hajijamali Arani, Biliang Wang, Kai Li, Luis Almeida, Zhu Han

entry.summary: A comprehensive survey on integrating LLMs with UAV systems for enhanced environmental understanding, swarm coordination, mobility optimization, and task reasoning, proposing a unified framework.

entry.title: A Green Learning Approach to LDCT Image Restoration

author.name: Wei Wang, Yixing Wu, C. -C. Jay Kuo

entry.summary: Proposes a Green Learning approach for low-dose CT image restoration that achieves state-of-the-art performance with smaller model size and lower computational cost compared to deep learning methods.

entry.title: PedaCo-Gen: Scaffolding Pedagogical Agency in Human-AI Collaborative Video Authoring

author.name: Injun Baek, Yearim Kim, Nojun Kwak

entry.summary: PedaCo-Gen is a human-AI collaborative system for generating instructional videos based on Mayer's cognitive theory of multimedia learning, with an intermediate representation phase for educator review.

entry.title: DReX: An Explainable Deep Learning-based Multimodal Recommendation Framework

author.name: Adamya Shyam, Venkateswara Rao Kagita, Bharti Rana, Vikas Kumar

entry.summary: DReX is an explainable multimodal recommendation framework that incrementally refines user and item representations from interaction-level features across multiple modalities.

entry.title: Carbon-Aware Governance Gates: An Architecture for Sustainable GenAI Development

author.name: Mateen A. Abbasi, Tommi J. Mikkonen, Petri J. Ihantola, Muhammad Waseem, Pekka Abrahamsson, Niko K. M\"akitalo

entry.summary: Proposes Carbon-Aware Governance Gates (CAGG), an architecture that embeds carbon budgets and energy provenance into GenAI governance mechanisms in the software development lifecycle.

entry.title: Sub-City Real Estate Price Index Forecasting at Weekly Horizons Using Satellite Radar and News Sentiment

author.name: Baris Arat, Hasan Fehmi Ates, Emre Sefer

entry.summary: Combines Sentinel-1 SAR satellite radar backscatter with news sentiment to forecast sub-city real estate price indices at weekly frequency for 19 Dubai regions. Results are horizon-dependent with satellite data improving long-horizon forecasts.

entry.title: Issues with Measuring Task Complexity via Random Policies in Robotic Tasks

author.name: Reabetswe M. Nkhumise, Mohamed S. Talamali, Aditya Gilra

entry.summary: Evaluates metrics for measuring RL task complexity (Random Weight Guessing, PIC, POIC) on progressively difficult robotic tasks and identifies issues with these approaches in non-tabular domains.

entry.title: Alternating Bi-Objective Optimization for Explainable Neuro-Fuzzy Systems

author.name: Qusai Khaled, Uzay Kaymak, Laura Genga

entry.summary: X-ANFIS proposes an alternating bi-objective gradient-based optimization for neuro-fuzzy systems, using Cauchy membership functions and differentiable explainability objectives to navigate the accuracy-explainability Pareto front.

entry.title: RAmmStein: Regime Adaptation in Mean-reverting Markets with Stein Thresholds -- Optimal Impulse Control in Concentrated AMMs

author.name: Pranay Anchuri

entry.summary: RAmmStein formulates concentrated liquidity provision in decentralized exchanges as optimal impulse control, using deep RL with Ornstein-Uhlenbeck mean-reversion modeling for automated market maker rebalancing.

entry.title: Evaluating the Impact of Data Anonymization on Image Retrieval

author.name: Marvin Chen, Manuel Eberhardinger, Johannes Maucher

entry.summary: Studies the impact of data anonymization on content-based image retrieval systems, motivated by GDPR compliance in a real police document verification system. Proposes an evaluation framework comparing retrieval before and after anonymization.

entry.title: Generalized Random Direction Newton Algorithms for Stochastic Optimization

author.name: Soumen Pachal, Prashanth L. A., Shalabh Bhatnagar, Avinash Achar

entry.summary: Presents a family of generalized Hessian estimators using random direction stochastic approximation with only noisy function measurements. Shows estimators with more measurements have lower bias, with convergence analysis for stochastic Newton methods.

entry.title: Fully Convolutional Spatiotemporal Learning for Microstructure Evolution Prediction

author.name: Michael Trimboli, Mohammed Alsubaie, Sirani M. Perera, Ke-Gang Wang, Xianqi Li

entry.summary: Proposes a fully convolutional spatiotemporal deep learning framework for predicting microstructure evolution in materials science, trained self-supervised on simulation data. Aims to accelerate phase-field simulations.

entry.title: A Data-Driven Method to Map the Functional Organisation of Human Brain White Matter

author.name: Yifei Sun, James M. Shine, Robert D. Sanders, Robin F. H. Cash, Sharon L. Naismith, Fernando Calamante, Jinglei Lv

entry.summary: Develops a data-driven framework integrating diffusion MRI and functional MRI to map functional organization of brain white matter through track dynamic functional connectivity analysis.

entry.title: Metasurfaces-Integrated Wireless Neural Networks for Lightweight Over-The-Air Edge Inference

author.name: Kyriakos Stylianopoulos, Mario Edoardo Pandolfo, Paolo Di Lorenzo, George C. Alexandropoulos

entry.summary: Introduces Metasurfaces-Integrated Neural Networks (MINNs) for over-the-air edge inference, using programmable metasurface structures and MIMO channels to perform computation at the physical layer.

entry.title: Workflow-Level Design Principles for Trustworthy GenAI in Automotive System Engineering

author.name: Chih-Hong Cheng, Brian Hsuan-Cheng Liao, Adam Molin, Hasan Esen

entry.summary: Proposes workflow-level design principles for integrating generative AI in automotive system engineering, demonstrating an end-to-end pipeline from requirement identification to SysML v2 architecture updates. Shows that section-wise decomposition outperforms monolithic prompting for large specifications.

entry.title: Ensemble Machine Learning and Statistical Procedures for Dynamic Predictions of Time-to-Event Outcomes

author.name: Nina van Gerwen, Sten Willemsen, Bettina E. Hansen, Christophe Corpechot, Marco Carbone, Cynthia Levy, Maria-Carlota Lond\~ono, Atsushi Tanaka, Palak Trivedi, Alejandra Villamil, Gideon Hirschfield, Dimitris Rizopoulos

entry.summary: Compares ensemble machine learning and statistical procedures (joint modeling, landmarking) for dynamic predictions of time-to-event outcomes in precision medicine, specifically for primary biliary cholangitis patients.

entry.title: Yor-Sarc: A gold-standard dataset for sarcasm detection in a low-resource African language

author.name: Toheeb Aduramomi Jimoh, Tabea De Wille, Nikola S. Nikolov

entry.summary: Presents Yor-Sarc, the first gold-standard sarcasm detection dataset for Yorùbá with 436 instances annotated by native speakers. Includes culture-informed annotation protocol for this tonal Niger-Congo language.

entry.title: Whisper: Courtside Edition Enhancing ASR Performance Through LLM-Driven Context Generation

author.name: Yonathan Ron, Shiri Gilboa, Tammuz Dubnov

entry.summary: Introduces Whisper: Courtside Edition, a multi-agent LLM pipeline that enhances Whisper transcriptions for NBA basketball commentary without retraining, achieving 17% WER reduction through domain context generation.

entry.title: Entropy in Large Language Models

author.name: Marco Scharringhausen

entry.summary: Studies entropy of LLM output as an information source, comparing word entropy to natural language from the Open American National Corpus. Finds LLM word entropy is lower than natural speech.

entry.title: Initialization matters in few-shot adaptation of vision-language models for histopathological image classification

author.name: Pablo Meseguer, Roc\'io del Amor, Valery Naranjo

entry.summary: Studies how classifier weight initialization affects few-shot fine-tuning of vision-language models for histopathological whole-slide image classification. Shows initialization strategy significantly impacts linear probing performance in efficient transfer learning.

entry.title: SCHEMA for Gemini 3 Pro Image: A Structured Methodology for Controlled AI Image Generation on Google's Native Multimodal Model

author.name: Luca Cazzaniga

entry.summary: Presents SCHEMA, a structured prompt engineering methodology specifically for Gemini 3 Pro Image, built on 850 verified API predictions across ~4800 images spanning six professional domains. Introduces a three-tier progressive system.

entry.title: Face Presentation Attack Detection via Content-Adaptive Spatial Operators

author.name: Shujaat Khan

entry.summary: Proposes CASO-PAD for face presentation attack detection using content-adaptive spatial operators (involution) added to MobileNetV3. Lightweight model (3.6M params) achieves strong performance across multiple anti-spoofing benchmarks.

entry.title: Questions beyond Pixels: Integrating Commonsense Knowledge in Visual Question Generation for Remote Sensing

author.name: Siran Li, Li Mi, Javiera Castillo-Navarro, Devis Tuia

entry.summary: Shares a financial analyst's speculative vignette about a 2028 economic crisis driven by AI-induced unemployment, with S&P down 38% and 10.2% unemployment despite booming productivity.

entry.title: The Landscape of AI in Science Education: What is Changing and How to Respond

author.name: Xiaoming Zhai, Kent Crippen

entry.summary: Introductory book chapter exploring AI's transformative role in science education, covering intelligent tutoring systems, adaptive platforms, automated feedback, and generative content creation. Discusses ethical and pedagogical challenges.

entry.title: Transforming Science Learning Materials in the Era of Artificial Intelligence

author.name: Xiaoming Zhai, Kent Crippen

entry.summary: Book chapter examining how AI transforms science learning materials across six domains including adaptive instruction, interactive simulations, and multimodal content generation.

entry.title: Charting the Future of AI-supported Science Education: A Human-Centered Vision

author.name: Xiaoming Zhai, Kent Crippen

entry.summary: Concluding book chapter proposing a human-centered framework (REP) for responsible AI integration in science education, synthesizing developments across educational goals, instructional procedures, and assessment.

entry.title: Descriptor: Dataset of Parasitoid Wasps and Associated Hymenoptera (DAPWH)

author.name: Joao Manoel Herrera Pinheiro, Gabriela Do Nascimento Herrera, Luciana Bueno Dos Reis Fernandes, Alvaro Doria Dos Santos, Ricardo V. Godoy, Eduardo A. B. Almeida, Helena Carolina Onody, Marcelo Andrade Da Costa Vieira, Angelica Maria Penteado-Dias, Marcelo Becker

entry.summary: Presents a curated image dataset of 3,556 high-resolution images of parasitoid wasps for automated taxonomic identification, primarily focused on Neotropical species.

entry.title: Multivariate time-series forecasting of ASTRI-Horn monitoring data: A Normal Behavior Model

author.name: Federico Incardona, Alessandro Costa, Farida Farsian, Francesco Franchina, Giuseppe Leto, Emilio Mastriani, Kevin Munari, Giovanni Pareschi, Salvatore Scuderi, Sebastiano Spinello, Gino Tosti

entry.summary: Develops a Normal Behavior Model for forecasting monitoring time-series from the ASTRI-Horn Cherenkov telescope using multivariate time-series methods on sensor measurements from telescope motors.

entry.title: DEEP: Docker-based Execution and Evaluation Platform

author.name: Sergio G\'omez Gonz\'alez, Miguel Domingo, Francisco Casacuberta

entry.summary: Presents DEEP, a Docker-based platform for automated execution and scoring of machine translation and OCR models, enabling standardized comparative evaluation of dockerized systems.

entry.title: Keyboards for the Endangered Idu Mishmi Language

author.name: Akhilesh Kakolu Ramarao

entry.summary: Presents mobile and desktop keyboards for Idu Mishmi, an endangered language with ~11,000 speakers. The Android keyboard is published on Google Play Store and used in teacher training programs.

entry.title: Axis Decomposition for ODRL: Resolving Dimensional Ambiguity in Policy Constraints through Interval Semantics

author.name: Daham Mustafa, Diego Collarana, Yixin Peng, Rafiqul Haque, Christoph Lange-Bever, Christoph Quix, Stephan Decker

entry.summary: Addresses dimensional ambiguity in ODRL 2.2 constraints where multi-dimensional quantities create non-deterministic policy evaluation. Proposes axis-decomposition framework to refine dimensional operands into axis-specific sub-constraints.

entry.title: Denotational Semantics for ODRL: Knowledge-Based Constraint Conflict Detection

author.name: Daham Mustafa, Diego Collarana, Yixin Peng, Rafiqul Haque, Christoph Lange-Bever, Christoph Quix, Stephan Decker

entry.summary: Presents denotational semantics for ODRL's set-based operators, mapping constraints to knowledge-base concept sets. Enables conflict detection via denotation intersection under three-valued verdicts.

entry.title: BabyLM Turns 4: Call for Papers for the 2026 BabyLM Workshop

author.name: Leshem Choshen, Ryan Cotterell, Mustafa Omer Gul, Jaap Jumelet, Tal Linzen, Aaron Mueller, Suchir Salhan, Raj Sanjay Shah, Alex Warstadt, Ethan Gotlieb Wilcox

entry.summary: Call for papers for the 2026 BabyLM Workshop, now in its 4th edition. Introduces a new multilingual track alongside the data-efficient pretraining challenge.

entry.title: CLAP Convolutional Lightweight Autoencoder for Plant Disease Classification

author.name: Asish Bera, Subhajit Roy, Sudiptendu Banerjee

entry.summary: Proposes CLAP, a lightweight convolutional autoencoder for plant disease classification designed for realistic field conditions. Uses feature extraction via autoencoder to handle subtle variations in leaf subcategories.

entry.title: AI Impact Summit 2026 : A Field Report

author.name: Aditya

entry.summary: Field report from the AI Impact Summit 2026 in Delhi, covering governance and policy tracks, AI Safety Connect side event, and an independent safety mixer. Critiques lack of technical depth and meaningful discourse.

entry.title: Image-Based Classification of Olive Varieties Native to Turkiye Using Multiple Deep Learning Architectures: Analysis of Performance, Complexity, and Generalization

author.name: Hatice Karatas, Irfan Atabas

entry.summary: Compares 10 deep learning architectures for classifying five Turkish olive varieties from images using transfer learning on 2500 images. EfficientNetV2-S achieves highest accuracy at 95.8%.

entry.title: Review: "We can't disagree forever"

author.name: Martin Randall

entry.summary: Reviews Geanakoplos and Polemarchakis (1982) on achieving Bayesian agreement through finite communication rounds, with toy examples illustrating the indirect vs direct communication equilibrium.

entry.title: The map of the map is not the map

author.name: jimmy

entry.summary: Explores the concept 'the map of the map is not the map' - distinguishing between beliefs about reality and beliefs about beliefs. Uses concrete examples like fear of bears and flight anxiety to illustrate meta-cognitive distinctions.

entry.title: Metal Detector for Life

author.name: Davey Morse

entry.summary: Philosophical post arguing AI systems need 'life detectors' to identify and preserve living things, analogizing to metal detectors. Discusses tradeoffs between detection enabling both protection and targeting.

entry.title: Innate Immunity

author.name: joec

entry.summary: A LessWrong post summarizing key concepts from Parham's Immunology textbook, framing the immune system as a defense against rapidly evolving pathogens. It covers innate immune system strategies including ferocity, cooperation, and specialized cells.

entry.title: Using fiction to imagine a pathway to friendlyAGI

author.name: Rick Moss

entry.summary: A sci-fi author shares ideas about friendly AGI from their novel, seeking feedback from the AI safety community on whether 'growing' rather than 'constructing' AI could address alignment.

entry.title: Why I Transitioned: A Third (FtM) Perspective

author.name: Character#2736

entry.summary: A personal essay offering an FtM (female-to-male) transgender perspective on gender dysphoria, responding to two prior LessWrong posts about MtF experiences. The author shares their transition story and speculates on biological bases for gender dysphoria.

entry.title: The power of a simple 3-way truth scale

author.name: Bruce Lewis

entry.summary: A blog post describing a simple decision-making technique using a notebook with a 3-way truth scale (true/false/undecided circles) to structure pro/con debates with yourself. The key insight is that an 'undecided' marker reduces writer's block when evaluating uncertain claims.

entry.title: Storing Food

author.name: jefftk

entry.summary: Jeff Kaufman argues more people should store substantial amounts of food as low-cost insurance against potential supply disruptions. He discusses the context of global famines being driven by systemic failures and provides practical preparedness advice.

entry.title: Old SUNY Dorm Logic is not helping rural population collapse in NY.

author.name: Edd Schneider

entry.summary: A commentary on rural population decline in New York's North Country, using SUNY Potsdam's enrollment collapse (from ~4,500 to ~1,800 students) as a case study. The author argues outdated higher education models are failing to address demographic challenges in rural areas.

entry.title: Secrets of the LessWrong RSS Feed

author.name: Brendan Long

entry.summary: Documents undocumented features of LessWrong's RSS feed including karma filtering, user filtering, view types, and comment feeds.

entry.title: Research Summary: February 23, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research centers on foundational AI evaluation frameworks, alignment theory, and theoretical insights into core architectures.

  • Capabilities Ain't All You Need introduces a bilogistic IRT formalism distinguishing AI *propensities* from capabilities—potentially reshaping evaluation methodology
  • Epistemic Traps unifies sycophancy, hallucination, and deception as mathematically rational behaviors arising from model misspecification, offering a new alignment-theoretic lens
  • Gradient regularization provides a principled fix for reward hacking in RLHF/RLVR by biasing updates toward regions of higher reward accuracy
  • Scaling laws for shallow networks in the feature-learning regime receive rigorous treatment from the Krzakala/Zdeborová group using statistical physics

In interdisciplinary and applied work, FlyGM demonstrates whole-body locomotion control using an architecture identical to the adult fruit fly's complete connectome. Turn amplification identifies a new conversational LLM failure mode with mechanistic root causes. Clever Materials reveals that ML models for materials discovery exploit bibliographic confounds rather than learning true chemistry.

  • Marginal Energy theory explains why diffusion models can succeed without noise conditioning
  • Information-theoretic analysis of Chain-of-Thought monitorability formalizes when CoT is sufficient for safety oversight
  • Statistical physics analysis proves softmax attention has a fundamental statistical advantage over linear attention in structured retrieval tasks

entry.title: Scaling Laws and Spectra of Shallow Neural Networks in the Feature Learning Regime

author.name: Leonardo Defilippis, Yizhou Xu, Julius Girardin, Emanuele Troiani, Vittorio Erba, Lenka Zdeborov\'a, Bruno Loureiro and Florent Krzakala

entry.summary: Provides a systematic theoretical analysis of neural scaling laws for shallow networks (quadratic and diagonal) in the feature learning regime, deriving phase diagrams for scaling exponents and connecting them to spectral properties of trained weights. Bridges theory and empirical observations of scaling behavior in deep learning.

entry.title: Clever Materials: When Models Identify Good Materials for the Wrong Reasons

author.name: Kevin Maik Jablonka

entry.summary: Demonstrates that ML models for materials discovery can exploit bibliographic confounds (author, journal, publication year) rather than learning chemistry. Across five tasks spanning MOFs, perovskites, batteries, and emitters, models trained solely on predicted metadata 'bibliographic fingerprints' sometimes match conventional descriptor-based predictors.

entry.title: Capabilities Ain't All You Need: Measuring Propensities in AI

author.name: Daniel Romero-Alvarado, Fernando Mart\'inez-Plumed, Lorenzo Pacchiardi, Hugo Save, Siddhesh Milind Pawar, Behzad Mehrbakhsh, Pablo Antonio Moreno Casares, Ben Slater, Paolo Bova, Peter Romero, Zachary R. Tyler, Jonathan Prunty, Luning Sun, Jose Hernandez-Orallo

entry.summary: Introduces the first formal framework for measuring AI propensities (behavioral tendencies) as distinct from capabilities, using a bilogistic IRT formulation where both excess and deficiency of a propensity can be problematic. Estimates ideal bands for propensities and connects to safety outcomes.

entry.title: Epistemic Traps: Rational Misalignment Driven by Model Misspecification

author.name: Xingcheng Xu, Jingjing Qu, Qiaosheng Zhang, Chaochao Lu, Yanqing Yang, Na Zou, Xia Hu

entry.summary: Proposes 'epistemic traps' framework showing that LLM pathologies (sycophancy, hallucination, deception) are mathematically rationalizable behaviors arising from model misspecification, adapting Berk-Nash Rationalizability from economics to explain why these behaviors are stable equilibria resistant to RL mitigation.

entry.title: Statistical Advantage of Softmax Attention: Insights from Single-Location Regression

author.name: O. Duranthon, P. Marion, C. Boyer, B. Loureiro, L. Zdeborov\'a

entry.summary: Studies the statistical advantage of softmax attention over linear attention through a single-location regression task, using statistical physics to show softmax achieves Bayes risk while linear attention fundamentally falls short.

entry.title: Asking Forever: Universal Activations Behind Turn Amplification in Conversational LLMs

author.name: Zachary Coalson, Bo Fang, Sanghyun Hong

entry.summary: Discovers 'turn amplification' - a new failure mode where conversational LLMs systematically prolong multi-turn interactions without completing tasks. Identifies a universal activation subspace associated with clarification-seeking behavior that can be exploited to inflate operational costs.

entry.title: Whole-Brain Connectomic Graph Model Enables Whole-Body Locomotion Control in Fruit Fly

author.name: Zehao Jin, Yaoye Zhu, Chen Zhang, Yanan Sui

entry.summary: Develops FlyGM, a graph model whose architecture is identical to the complete connectome of an adult fruit fly brain, for whole-body locomotion control in a biomechanical simulation. Achieves stable control across walking, turning, and climbing.

entry.title: Gradient Regularization Prevents Reward Hacking in Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback and Verifiable Rewards

author.name: Johannes Ackermann, Michael Noukhovitch, Takashi Ishida, Masashi Sugiyama

entry.summary: Proposes gradient regularization to prevent reward hacking in RLHF/RLVR by biasing policy updates toward regions where the reward is more accurate (flatter optima). Provides theoretical connection between reward accuracy and loss flatness.

entry.title: Analyzing and Improving Chain-of-Thought Monitorability Through Information Theory

author.name: Usman Anwar, Tim Bakker, Dana Kianfar, Cristina Pinneri, Christos Louizos

entry.summary: Uses information theory to analyze Chain-of-Thought monitorability, showing mutual information between CoT and output is necessary but not sufficient. Identifies information gap and elicitation error as sources of monitor failure, and proposes improvements.

entry.title: The Geometry of Noise: Why Diffusion Models Don't Need Noise Conditioning

author.name: Mojtaba Sahraee-Ardakan, Mauricio Delbracio, Peyman Milanfar

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of why diffusion models don't need noise conditioning, introducing the concept of Marginal Energy that resolves the paradox of noise-agnostic models remaining stable near data manifolds where gradients typically diverge.

entry.title: Topological Exploration of High-Dimensional Empirical Risk Landscapes: general approach, and applications to phase retrieval

author.name: Antoine Maillard, Tony Bonnaire, Giulio Biroli

entry.summary: Uses the Kac-Rice formula to analyze the topological landscape of empirical risk minimization for high-dimensional Gaussian single-index models, studying critical point complexity and providing new variational characterizations. Applied to phase retrieval as a case study.

entry.title: The 2025 AI Agent Index: Documenting Technical and Safety Features of Deployed Agentic AI Systems

author.name: Leon Staufer, Kevin Feng, Kevin Wei, Luke Bailey, Yawen Duan, Mick Yang, A. Pinar Ozisik, Stephen Casper, Noam Kolt

entry.summary: Presents the 2025 AI Agent Index documenting technical and safety features of 30 state-of-the-art AI agents. Catalogs origins, design, capabilities, ecosystem, and safety features based on public information and developer correspondence, illuminating transparency trends.

entry.title: Two Calm Ends and the Wild Middle: A Geometric Picture of Memorization in Diffusion Models

author.name: Nick Dodson, Xinyu Gao, Qingsong Wang, Yusu Wang, Zhengchao Wan

entry.summary: Introduces a geometric framework for understanding memorization in diffusion models, partitioning the noise schedule into three regimes based on Gaussian shell coverage and posterior concentration. Reveals that memorization risk is highly non-uniform across the noise schedule.

entry.title: RAT+: Train Dense, Infer Sparse -- Recurrence Augmented Attention for Dilated Inference

author.name: Xiuying Wei, Caglar Gulcehre

entry.summary: Introduces RAT+, an architecture that trains with dense attention augmented by full-sequence recurrence, then switches to dilated attention at inference for efficiency. Achieves flexible inference-time sparsification with minimal accuracy loss after short adaptation.

entry.title: Decoding as Optimisation on the Probability Simplex: From Top-K to Top-P (Nucleus) to Best-of-K Samplers

author.name: Xiaotong Ji, Rasul Tutunov, Matthieu Zimmer, Haitham Bou-Ammar

entry.summary: Provides a principled optimization framework unifying LLM decoding methods (greedy, top-K, top-P, Sparsemax) as regularized optimization on the probability simplex. Derives new Best-of-K decoder from the framework.

entry.title: Bayesian Optimality of In-Context Learning with Selective State Spaces

author.name: Di Zhang, Jiaqi Xing

entry.summary: Formalizes in-context learning as Bayesian optimal sequential prediction and proves that meta-trained selective state space models asymptotically implement the Bayes-optimal predictor, establishing a statistical separation from gradient-descent-based approaches including Transformers.

entry.title: CodeScaler: Scaling Code LLM Training and Test-Time Inference via Execution-Free Reward Models

author.name: Xiao Zhu, Xinyu Zhou, Boyu Zhu, Hanxu Hu, Mingzhe Du, Haotian Zhang, Huiming Wang, Zhijiang Guo

entry.summary: Proposes CodeScaler, an execution-free reward model for scaling RL training and test-time inference for code generation, trained on curated preference data with syntax-aware extraction and validity-preserving reward shaping. Shows +11.72 point improvement on coding benchmarks.

entry.title: UBio-MolFM: A Universal Molecular Foundation Model for Bio-Systems

author.name: Lin Huang, Arthur Jiang, XiaoLi Liu, Zion Wang, Jason Zhao, Chu Wang, HaoCheng Lu, ChengXiang Huang, JiaJun Cheng, YiYue Du and Jia Zhang

entry.summary: Presents UBio-MolFM, a universal molecular foundation model for biological systems that bridges quantum-mechanical accuracy and biological scale. Introduces a bio-specific dataset (UBio-Mol26), a linear-scaling equivariant transformer (E2Former-V2), and a multi-fidelity training strategy for molecular simulations up to 1,200 atoms.

entry.title: Turbo Connection: Reasoning as Information Flow from Higher to Lower Layers

author.name: Mohan Tang, Sidi Lu

entry.summary: Introduces Turbo Connection (TurboConn), which routes residual connections from higher-layer hidden states of token t to lower layers of token t+1, overcoming the fixed-depth computational constraint of transformers. Shows 0.9-10% accuracy gains on reasoning benchmarks.

entry.title: Perceived Political Bias in LLMs Reduces Persuasive Abilities

author.name: Matthew DiGiuseppe and Joshua Robison

entry.summary: Shows through a preregistered survey experiment (N=2144) that telling users an LLM is politically biased against their party reduces ChatGPT's persuasive effectiveness by 28%, with participants pushing back more during conversations.

entry.title: Improving Sampling for Masked Diffusion Models via Information Gain

author.name: Kaisen Yang, Jayden Teoh, Kaicheng Yang, Yitong Zhang, Alex Lamb

entry.summary: Proposes Info-Gain Sampler for Masked Diffusion Models that considers downstream impact of decoding choices rather than greedy local certainty. Addresses a fundamental limitation where greedy heuristics fail to minimize cumulative uncertainty by exploiting MDMs' non-causal nature.

entry.title: A Probabilistic Framework for LLM-Based Model Discovery

author.name: Stefan Wahl, Raphaela Schenk, Ali Farnoud, Jakob H. Macke, Daniel Gedon

entry.summary: Recasts LLM-based scientific model discovery as probabilistic inference—sampling from a distribution over mechanistic models that explain data. Provides a unified framework for model proposal, refinement, and selection, instantiated with an SMC-inspired sampler.

entry.title: On the "Induction Bias" in Sequence Models

author.name: M.Reza Ebrahimi, Micha\"el Defferrard, Sunny Panchal, Roland Memisevic

entry.summary: Conducts a large-scale study comparing data efficiency of transformers vs RNNs for state tracking, finding transformers require dramatically more data as state-space size grows. Shows transformers learn fundamentally different mechanisms than RNNs for state tracking.

entry.title: Dataset distillation for memorized data: Soft labels can leak held-out teacher knowledge

author.name: Freya Behrens, Lenka Zdeborov\'a

entry.summary: Shows that dataset distillation with soft labels can transfer memorized information from teacher to student networks, even on random i.i.d. data where generalization is impossible, revealing potential privacy leakage in distillation.

entry.title: Can LLM Safety Be Ensured by Constraining Parameter Regions?

author.name: Zongmin Li, Jian Su, Farah Benamara, Aixin Sun

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates four safety region identification methods across four LLM families, finding that identified safety regions show low-to-moderate overlap across methods and datasets, suggesting no stable, dataset-agnostic safety region exists.

entry.title: Neural Synchrony Between Socially Interacting Language Models

author.name: Zhining Zhang, Wentao Zhu, Chi Han, Yizhou Wang, Heng Ji

entry.summary: Explores whether socially interacting LLMs exhibit neural synchrony analogous to humans. Finds that LLM activations become synchronized during social simulations, proposing this as empirical evidence for analyzing the sociality of LLMs at the representation level.

entry.title: TFL: Targeted Bit-Flip Attack on Large Language Model

author.name: Jingkai Guo, Chaitali Chakrabarti, Deliang Fan

entry.summary: Presents TFL, a targeted bit-flip attack framework that enables precise manipulation of LLM outputs for selected prompts while maintaining performance on unrelated inputs. Exploits DRAM vulnerabilities to flip specific bits in model weights.

entry.title: Detecting Contextual Hallucinations in LLMs with Frequency-Aware Attention

author.name: Siya Qi, Yudong Chen, Runcong Zhao, Qinglin Zhu, Zhanghao Hu, Wei Liu, Yulan He, Zheng Yuan, Lin Gui

entry.summary: Introduces a frequency-aware approach to detecting contextual hallucinations in LLMs by analyzing high-frequency components of attention distributions during generation, finding that hallucinated tokens correlate with high-frequency attention energy.

entry.title: On the Adversarial Robustness of Discrete Image Tokenizers

author.name: Rishika Bhagwatkar, Irina Rish, Nicolas Flammarion, Francesco Croce

entry.summary: First study of adversarial robustness for discrete image tokenizers used in multimodal systems. Formulates efficient attacks that perturb extracted tokens, and proposes unsupervised adversarial training as defense. Attacks are effective across classification, retrieval, and captioning.

entry.title: Spectral Thresholds in Correlated Spiked Models and Fundamental Limits of Partial Least Squares

author.name: Pierre Mergny and Lenka Zdeborov\'a

entry.summary: Provides rigorous random matrix theory analysis of spiked cross-covariance models with partially aligned signals, establishing BBP-type phase transitions and characterizing fundamental limits of Partial Least Squares (PLS). Reveals a performance gap between PLS and Bayes-optimal estimation.

entry.title: Duality Models: An Embarrassingly Simple One-step Generation Paradigm

author.name: Peng Sun, Xinyi Shang, Tao Lin, Zhiqiang Shen

entry.summary: Proposes Duality Models, a one-step generation approach that produces both a local derivative and global integral prediction from a single input, eliminating the training budget partition problem in consistency-based generative models like MeanFlow.

entry.title: Tethered Reasoning: Decoupling Entropy from Hallucination in Quantized LLMs via Manifold Steering

author.name: Craig Atkinson

entry.summary: Presents HELIX, a geometric framework that decouples output entropy from hallucination in quantized LLMs by steering hidden-state trajectories toward a pre-computed truthfulness manifold, maintaining accuracy at very high sampling temperatures (T=3.0).

entry.title: GeneZip: Region-Aware Compression for Long Context DNA Modeling

author.name: Jianan Zhao, Xixian Liu, Zhihao Zhan, Xinyu Yuan, Hongyu Guo, Jian Tang

entry.summary: Introduces GeneZip, a DNA compression model that exploits the biological prior that genomic information density varies dramatically between coding (~2%) and non-coding regions. Uses HNet-style dynamic routing with region-aware compression ratios to achieve efficient genome-scale foundation model processing.

entry.title: Grassmannian Mixture-of-Experts: Concentration-Controlled Routing on Subspace Manifolds

author.name: Ibne Farabi Shihab, Sanjeda Akter, Anuj Sharma

entry.summary: Proposes Grassmannian MoE (GrMoE), a routing framework operating on the Grassmannian manifold of subspaces where gating weights arise from Matrix Bingham distribution concentration parameters. Provides a principled continuous control over routing sparsity replacing discrete top-k selection.

entry.title: The Token Games: Evaluating Language Model Reasoning with Puzzle Duels

author.name: Simon Henniger, Gabriel Poesia

entry.summary: Proposes The Token Games (TTG), an evaluation framework where LLMs challenge each other by creating programming puzzles, inspired by 16th-century mathematical duels. Uses Programming Puzzles format for verifiable solution checking.

entry.title: Condition-Gated Reasoning for Context-Dependent Biomedical Question Answering

author.name: Jash Rajesh Parekh, Wonbin Kweon, Joey Chan, Rezarta Islamaj, Robert Leaman, Pengcheng Jiang, Chih-Hsuan Wei, Zhizheng Wang, Zhiyong Lu, Jiawei Han

entry.summary: Proposes CondMedQA, the first benchmark for conditional biomedical QA where answers depend on patient-specific factors, and Condition-Gated Reasoning (CGR), a framework that selectively activates knowledge based on patient conditions.

entry.title: ROCKET: Residual-Oriented Multi-Layer Alignment for Spatially-Aware Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Guoheng Sun, Tingting Du, Kaixi Feng, Chenxiang Luo, Xingguo Ding, Zheyu Shen, Ziyao Wang, Yexiao He, Ang Li

entry.summary: Introduces ROCKET, a residual-oriented multi-layer alignment framework for Vision-Language-Action models that formulates alignment as matching residual streams between a VLA backbone and a 3D vision foundation model, addressing gradient interference in multi-layer alignment.

entry.title: Cross-Embodiment Offline Reinforcement Learning for Heterogeneous Robot Datasets

author.name: Haruki Abe, Takayuki Osa, Yusuke Mukuta, Tatsuya Harada

entry.summary: Combines offline RL with cross-embodiment learning to pre-train robot policies from heterogeneous datasets spanning 16 distinct robot platforms. Systematic analysis reveals strengths and limitations of this paradigm for locomotion.

entry.title: 3DMedAgent: Unified Perception-to-Understanding for 3D Medical Analysis

author.name: Ziyue Wang, Linghan Cai, Chang Han Low, Haofeng Liu, Junde Wu, Jingyu Wang, Rui Wang, Lei Song, Jiang Bian, Jingjing Fu, Yueming Jin

entry.summary: Proposes 3DMedAgent, a unified agent that enables 2D MLLMs to perform 3D CT analysis without 3D-specific fine-tuning by coordinating heterogeneous perception tools and accumulating perceptual evidence for reasoning.

entry.title: HiAER-Spike Software-Hardware Reconfigurable Platform for Event-Driven Neuromorphic Computing at Scale

author.name: Gwenevere Frank, Gopabandhu Hota, Keli Wang, Christopher Deng, Krish Arora, Diana Vins, Abhinav Uppal, Omowuyi Olajide, Kenneth Yoshimoto, Qingbo Wang, Mari Yamaoka, Johannes Leugering, Stephen Deiss, Leif Gibb, Gert Cauwenberghs

entry.summary: Presents HiAER-Spike, a neuromorphic computing platform capable of running spiking neural networks with up to 160 million neurons and 40 billion synapses (roughly twice a mouse brain) at faster than real-time.

entry.title: Neurosymbolic Language Reasoning as Satisfiability Modulo Theory

author.name: Hyunseok Oh, Sam Stern, Youngki Lee, Matthai Philipose

entry.summary: Introduces Logitext, a neurosymbolic language for representing documents as natural language text constraints, combined with SMT solving for joint textual-logical reasoning. Addresses the gap between fully formalizable tasks and natural documents.

entry.title: SeedFlood: A Step Toward Scalable Decentralized Training of LLMs

author.name: Jihun Kim, Namhoon Lee

entry.summary: Introduces SeedFlood, a decentralized training approach that exploits seed-reconstructible structure of zeroth-order updates to make communication overhead near-zero and independent of model size. Enables flooding messages across complex network topologies for global consensus.

entry.title: Thinking by Subtraction: Confidence-Driven Contrastive Decoding for LLM Reasoning

author.name: Lexiang Tang, Weihao Gao, Bingchen Zhao, Lu Ma, Qiao jin, Bang Yang, Yuexian Zou

entry.summary: Proposes Confidence-Driven Contrastive Decoding that identifies low-confidence tokens during LLM reasoning and intervenes selectively. Constructs contrastive references by replacing high-confidence tokens, improving reasoning reliability without uniform compute scaling.

entry.title: VeriSoftBench: Repository-Scale Formal Verification Benchmarks for Lean

author.name: Yutong Xin, Qiaochu Chen, Greg Durrett, I\c{s}il Dillig

entry.summary: Introduces VeriSoftBench, a benchmark of 500 Lean 4 proof obligations from software verification codebases (not Mathlib mathematics). Shows that Mathlib-tuned provers transfer poorly to repository-centric verification settings.

entry.title: Generated Reality: Human-centric World Simulation using Interactive Video Generation with Hand and Camera Control

author.name: Linxi Xie, Lisong C. Sun, Ashley Neall, Tong Wu, Shengqu Cai, Gordon Wetzstein

entry.summary: Introduces a human-centric video world model conditioned on head pose and hand poses for XR applications. Trains a bidirectional diffusion transformer and distills it into a causal interactive system for real-time egocentric generation.

entry.title: The Scalable Formal Oversight Research Program

author.name: Max von Hippel

entry.summary: Outlines the Scalable Formal Oversight (SFO) research program, which advocates using formal methods — property-based testing, interactive theorem proving, fuzzing, and refinement testing — to constrain and verify AI systems as they become more capable. Provides concrete research directions and argues this approach is critical for AI safety as the gap between generation and verification widens.

entry.title: Influence-Preserving Proxies for Gradient-Based Data Selection in LLM Fine-tuning

author.name: Sirui Chen, Yunzhe Qi, Mengting Ai, Yifan Sun, Ruizhong Qiu, Jiaru Zou, Jingrui He

entry.summary: Introduces Iprox, a two-stage framework for efficient gradient-based data selection in LLM fine-tuning. Derives small influence-preserving proxy models from the target LLM to approximate gradient-based influence at much lower cost.

entry.title: Anisotropic local law for non-separable sample covariance matrices

author.name: Zhou Fan, Renyuan Ma, Elliot Paquette, Zhichao Wang

entry.summary: Establishes optimal local laws for non-separable sample covariance matrices under concentration and cumulant tensor assumptions, extending beyond the standard separable model to handle dependent and nonlinearly transformed data.

entry.title: Trojans in Artificial Intelligence (TrojAI) Final Report

author.name: Kristopher W. Reese, Taylor Kulp-McDowall, Michael Majurski, Tim Blattner, Derek Juba, Peter Bajcsy, Antonio Cardone, Philippe Dessauw, Alden Dima, Anthony J. Kearsley, Melinda Kleczynski, Joel Vasanth, Walid Keyrouz, Chace Ashcraft, Neil Fendley, Ted Staley, Trevor Stout, Josh Carney, Greg Canal, Will Redman, Aurora Schmidt, Cameron Hickert, William Paul, Jared Markowitz, Nathan Drenkow, David Shriver, Marissa Connor, Keltin Grimes, Marco Christiani, Hayden Moore, Jordan Widjaja, Kasimir Gabert, Uma Balakrishnan, Satyanadh Gundimada, John Jacobellis, Sandya Lakkur, Vitus Leung, Jon Roose, Casey Battaglino, Farinaz Koushanfar, Greg Fields, Xihe Gu, Yaman Jandali, Xinqiao Zhang, Akash Vartak, Tim Oates, Ben Erichson, Michael Mahoney, Rauf Izmailov, Xiangyu Zhang, Guangyu Shen, Siyuan Cheng, Shiqing Ma, XiaoFeng Wang, Haixu Tang, Di Tang, Xiaoyi Chen, Zihao Wang, Rui Zhu, Susmit Jha, Xiao Lin, Manoj Acharya, Wenchao Li, Chao Chen

entry.summary: Final report of the IARPA TrojAI program synthesizing multi-year findings on detecting and mitigating AI trojans/backdoors, covering weight analysis, trigger inversion, and cross-domain detection methods.

entry.title: Lost Before Translation: Social Information Transmission and Survival in AI-AI Communication

author.name: Bijean Ghafouri, Emilio Ferrara

entry.summary: Studies information transformation in AI-to-AI communication chains (telephone game paradigm), finding three patterns: convergence toward moderate defaults, selective survival of narrative anchors over nuanced evidence, and competitive filtering of weaker arguments.

entry.title: AnCoder: Anchored Code Generation via Discrete Diffusion Models

author.name: Anton Xue, Litu Rout, Constantine Caramanis, Sanjay Shakkottai

entry.summary: Introduces AnCoder, which anchors discrete diffusion code generation using abstract syntax tree structure, prioritizing resolution of syntactically salient tokens (keywords, identifiers) to create a structural scaffold guiding remaining generation.

entry.title: Agentic Unlearning: When LLM Agent Meets Machine Unlearning

author.name: Bin Wang, Fan Wang, Pingping Wang, Jinyu Cong, Yang Yu, Yilong Yin, Zhongyi Han, and Benzheng Wei

entry.summary: Introduces agentic unlearning for LLM agents that removes information from both model parameters and persistent memory, addressing backflow between parametric and memory-based knowledge. Proposes Synchronized Backflow Unlearning (SBU) framework.

entry.title: Parallel Complex Diffusion for Scalable Time Series Generation

author.name: Rongyao Cai, Yuxi Wan, Kexin Zhang, Ming Jin, Zhiqiang Ge, Qingsong Wen, Yong Liu

entry.summary: Introduces PaCoDi, a spectral-native diffusion architecture for time series generation that operates in the frequency domain, achieving theoretical decorrelation of components and linear-time generation through parallel complex diffusion.

entry.title: VidEoMT: Your ViT is Secretly Also a Video Segmentation Model

author.name: Narges Norouzi, Idil Esen Zulfikar, Niccol`o Cavagnero, Tommie Kerssies, Bastian Leibe, Gijs Dubbelman, Daan de Geus

entry.summary: Proposes VidEoMT, an encoder-only video segmentation model that eliminates dedicated tracking modules by introducing lightweight query propagation within a plain ViT. Simplifies video segmentation architecture significantly.

entry.title: Calibrated Adaptation: Bayesian Stiefel Manifold Priors for Reliable Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning

author.name: Ibne Farabi Shihab, Sanjeda Akter, Anuj Sharma

entry.summary: Introduces Stiefel-Bayes Adapters (SBA), a Bayesian PEFT framework placing Matrix Langevin priors over orthonormal adapter factors on the Stiefel manifold. Provides calibrated uncertainty estimates for fine-tuned LLMs through tangent space Laplace approximation.

entry.title: JAX-Privacy: A library for differentially private machine learning

author.name: Ryan McKenna, Galen Andrew, Borja Balle, Vadym Doroshenko, Arun Ganesh, Weiwei Kong, Alex Kurakin, Brendan McMahan, Mikhail Pravilov

entry.summary: Introduces JAX-Privacy, a library for differentially private machine learning with verified, modular primitives for batch selection, gradient clipping, noise addition, accounting, and auditing. From Google researchers.

entry.title: ADAPT: Hybrid Prompt Optimization for LLM Feature Visualization

author.name: Jo\~ao N. Cardoso, Arlindo L. Oliveira, Bruno Martins

entry.summary: Introduces ADAPT, a hybrid prompt optimization method combining beam search with adaptive gradient-guided mutation for feature visualization in LLM activation spaces. Evaluates on Sparse Autoencoder latents from Gemma 2 2B.

entry.title: Understanding Unreliability of Steering Vectors in Language Models: Geometric Predictors and the Limits of Linear Approximations

author.name: Joschka Braun

entry.summary: Investigates why steering vectors are unreliable across behaviors, finding that cosine similarity between training activation differences and separation along the steering direction predict reliability. Shows different prompt variations produce directionally distinct but similarly performing vectors.

entry.title: From Lossy to Verified: A Provenance-Aware Tiered Memory for Agents

author.name: Qiming Zhu, Shunian Chen, Rui Yu, Zhehao Wu, Benyou Wang

entry.summary: Proposes TierMem, a provenance-linked memory framework for long-horizon agents that addresses the 'write-before-query barrier' where compression decisions are made before knowing what future queries will need. Uses tiered retrieval with provenance tracking.

entry.title: Tighter Regret Lower Bound for Gaussian Process Bandits with Squared Exponential Kernel in Hypersphere

author.name: Shogo Iwazaki

entry.summary: Proves a tighter regret lower bound for GP bandits with squared exponential kernel on hyperspherical domains, partially resolving an open question about dimension-dependent logarithmic factor gaps between upper and lower bounds.

entry.title: Decomposing Retrieval Failures in RAG for Long-Document Financial Question Answering

author.name: Amine Kobeissi, Philippe Langlais

entry.summary: Studies within-document retrieval failures in RAG for financial question answering, where the correct document is retrieved but the relevant page/chunk is missed. Introduces oracle-based analysis showing significant room for improvement.

entry.title: NIMMGen: Learning Neural-Integrated Mechanistic Digital Twins with LLMs

author.name: Zihan Guan, Rituparna Datta, Mengxuan Hu, Shunshun Liu, Aiying Zhang, Prasanna Balachandran, Sheng Li, Anil Vullikanti

entry.summary: Introduces NIMM evaluation framework for assessing LLM-generated mechanistic models under realistic conditions with partial observations, and proposes NIMMGen, an LLM agent that constructs neural-integrated mechanistic models.

entry.title: Flow Actor-Critic for Offline Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Jongseong Chae, Jongeui Park, Yongjae Shin, Gyeongmin Kim, Seungyul Han, Youngchul Sung

entry.summary: Proposes Flow Actor-Critic for offline RL, using flow models for both actor (expressive policy) and critic (conservative value estimation). Introduces a flow-based critic regularizer to prevent Q-value explosion in out-of-data regions.

entry.title: UAOR: Uncertainty-aware Observation Reinjection for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Jiabing Yang, Yixiang Chen, Yuan Xu, Peiyan Li, Xiangnan Wu, Zichen Wen, Bowen Fang, Tao Yu, Zhengbo Zhang, Yingda Li, Kai Wang, Jing Liu, Nianfeng Liu, Yan Huang, Liang Wang

entry.summary: Proposes UAOR, a training-free plug-and-play module for VLA models that reinjects observation information into FFN layers based on uncertainty estimation, leveraging the insight that FFN layers act as key-value memory.

entry.title: Towards More Standardized AI Evaluation: From Models to Agents

author.name: Ali El Filali and In\`es Bedar

entry.summary: Argues that AI evaluation must evolve from static benchmark-centric approaches to dynamic, system-level evaluation for compound, tool-using agents. Examines how current evaluation practices introduce silent failure modes.

entry.title: Dynamic Deception: When Pedestrians Team Up to Fool Autonomous Cars

author.name: Masoud Jamshidiyan Tehrani, Marco Gabriel, Jinhan Kim, Paolo Tonella

entry.summary: Introduces a system-level adversarial attack on autonomous driving where multiple pedestrians with coordinated adversarial patches can fool perception models. In CARLA simulation, coordinated attacks succeed in 8/10 runs vs 0/10 for single-pedestrian attacks.

entry.title: Cut Less, Fold More: Model Compression through the Lens of Projection Geometry

author.name: Olga Saukh, Dong Wang, Haris \v{S}iki\'c, Yun Cheng, Lothar Thiele

entry.summary: Studies calibration-free neural network compression through projection geometry, showing that model folding (low-rank projection via weight clustering) provably yields smaller reconstruction error than structured pruning (axis-aligned projection). Evaluates on >1000 checkpoints.

entry.title: Advection-Diffusion on Graphs: A Bakry-Emery Laplacian for Spectral Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Pierre-Gabriel Berlureau, Ali Hariri, Victor Kawasaki-Borruat, Mia Zosso, Pierre Vandergheynst

entry.summary: Introduces a Bakry-Emery graph Laplacian that integrates diffusion and advection through a learnable node-wise potential, enabling task-dependent propagation in spectral GNNs without modifying graph topology. Develops mu-ChebNet architecture.

entry.title: The Statistical Signature of LLMs

author.name: Ortal Hadad, Edoardo Loru, Jacopo Nudo, Niccol\`o Di Marco, Matteo Cinelli, Walter Quattrociocchi

entry.summary: Uses lossless compression as a model-agnostic measure to detect structural statistical signatures of LLM-generated text across controlled experiments, synthetic Wikipedia, and synthetic social media. Finds persistent compression-based differences.

entry.title: Generative Model via Quantile Assignment

author.name: Georgi Hrusanov, Oliver Y. Ch\'en, Julien S. Bodelet

entry.summary: Presents NeuroSQL, a generative model that eliminates auxiliary networks (encoders/discriminators) by learning latent representations via optimal transport quantile assignment. Avoids training instability of GANs and mode collapse.

entry.title: SimVLA: A Simple VLA Baseline for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Yuankai Luo, Woping Chen, Tong Liang, Baiqiao Wang, Zhenguo Li

entry.summary: Introduces SimVLA, a streamlined Vision-Language-Action baseline for robotic manipulation that decouples perception from control with a standard VL backbone and lightweight action head. Demonstrates competitive performance with minimal design choices.

entry.title: How Fast Can I Run My VLA? Demystifying VLA Inference Performance with VLA-Perf

author.name: Wenqi Jiang, Jason Clemons, Karu Sankaralingam, Christos Kozyrakis

entry.summary: Introduces VLA-Perf, an analytical performance model for VLA inference that enables systematic study of the VLA inference landscape across model architectures and systems. Identifies bottlenecks and design principles for real-time deployment.

entry.title: Multiple Independent Semantic Axes in Gemma 3 270M

author.name: CharlesL

entry.summary: Uses Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) from Gemma Scope 2 on Gemma 3 270M to decompose and validate semantic axes (e.g., abstract-social vs. concrete-physical) previously found in GPT-2's residual stream. Moves from showing the axis exists to understanding its feature-level composition, finding multiple independent semantic axes.

entry.title: Provable Adversarial Robustness in In-Context Learning

author.name: Di Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces a distributionally robust meta-learning framework providing worst-case performance guarantees for in-context learning under Wasserstein-based adversarial distribution shifts, with non-asymptotic bounds for linear self-attention Transformers.

entry.title: Conformal Tradeoffs: Guarantees Beyond Coverage

author.name: Petrus H. Zwart

entry.summary: Extends conformal prediction beyond marginal coverage to operational metrics like commit/defer rates and error exposure, providing small-sample corrections and a planning framework for real-world deployment.

entry.title: Curriculum Learning for Efficient Chain-of-Thought Distillation via Structure-Aware Masking and GRPO

author.name: Bowen Yu, Maolin Wang, Sheng Zhang, Binhao Wang, Yi Wen, Jingtong Gao, Bowen Liu, Zimo Zhao, Wanyu Wang, Xiangyu Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes a three-stage curriculum learning framework for chain-of-thought distillation into smaller models, using masked reconstruction, GRPO-based completion, and targeted failure remediation to address capacity mismatch between teacher and student.

entry.title: Inelastic Constitutive Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks: A generalized framework for automated discovery of interpretable inelastic material models

author.name: Chenyi Ji, Kian P. Abdolazizi, Hagen Holthusen, Christian J. Cyron, Kevin Linka

entry.summary: Introduces inelastic Constitutive Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (iCKANs) that can automatically discover symbolic constitutive laws for both elastic and inelastic material behavior. Demonstrated on synthetic data and experimental data from viscoelastic polymers.

entry.title: Market Games for Generative Models: Equilibria, Welfare, and Strategic Entry

author.name: Xiukun Wei, Min Shi, Xueru Zhang

entry.summary: Formalizes a three-layer market game model (model-platform-user) for generative model ecosystems and identifies conditions for Nash equilibrium existence. Analyzes how market structure depends on model performance characteristics and user preferences.

entry.title: Understanding the Fine-Grained Knowledge Capabilities of Vision-Language Models

author.name: Dhruba Ghosh, Yuhui Zhang, Ludwig Schmidt

entry.summary: Conducts extensive evaluation of VLMs on fine-grained image classification, finding that better LLM backbones improve all benchmarks equally while better vision encoders specifically help fine-grained tasks. Identifies a disconnect between VLM progress and fine-grained visual knowledge.

entry.title: Breaking the Correlation Plateau: On the Optimization and Capacity Limits of Attention-Based Regressors

author.name: Jingquan Yan, Yuwei Miao, Peiran Yu, Junzhou Huang

entry.summary: Provides first theoretical analysis of the PCC (Pearson correlation) plateau phenomenon in attention-based regression, revealing that MSE reduction can paradoxically suppress PCC gradients due to softmax attention mechanisms.

entry.title: Latent Diffeomorphic Co-Design of End-Effectors for Deformable and Fragile Object Manipulation

author.name: Kei Ikemura, Yifei Dong, Florian T. Pokorny

entry.summary: Presents first co-design framework jointly optimizing end-effector morphology and manipulation control for deformable/fragile objects. Introduces latent diffeomorphic shape parameterization, stress-aware optimization, and privileged-to-pointcloud policy distillation.

entry.title: Memory-Based Advantage Shaping for LLM-Guided Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Narjes Nourzad, Carlee Joe-Wong

entry.summary: Proposes a memory graph that encodes subgoals and trajectories from LLM guidance and successful rollouts to shape the advantage function in RL, reducing reliance on frequent LLM calls. This addresses scalability concerns of LLM-guided RL in sparse reward environments.

entry.title: In-Context Learning for Pure Exploration in Continuous Spaces

author.name: Alessio Russo, Yin-Ching Lee, Ryan Welch, Aldo Pacchiano

entry.summary: Studies in-context learning for pure exploration in continuous spaces, extending Chernoff's sequential testing to modern settings like continuous-armed bandits and region localization using transformer-based learners.

entry.title: WorkflowPerturb: Calibrated Stress Tests for Evaluating Multi-Agent Workflow Metrics

author.name: Madhav Kanda, Pedro Las-Casas, Alok Gautam Kumbhare, Rodrigo Fonseca, Sharad Agarwal

entry.summary: Introduces WorkflowPerturb, a benchmark for evaluating metrics that assess LLM-generated structured workflows. Contains 4,973 golden workflows with 44,757 perturbed variants at controlled severity levels.

entry.title: Mean-Field Reinforcement Learning without Synchrony

author.name: Shan Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a mean-field RL framework that handles asynchronous multi-agent settings by replacing the mean action (undefined when agents are idle) with the population distribution as the summary statistic.

entry.title: Continual-NExT: A Unified Comprehension And Generation Continual Learning Framework

author.name: Jingyang Qiao and Zhizhong Zhang and Xin Tan and Jingyu Gong and Yanyun Qu and Yuan Xie

entry.summary: Introduces Continual-NExT, the first continual learning framework for dual-to-dual multimodal LLMs (unified comprehension and generation), identifying challenges beyond catastrophic forgetting including hallucination and instruction unfollowing.

entry.title: Predict to Skip: Linear Multistep Feature Forecasting for Efficient Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Hanshuai Cui, Zhiqing Tang, Qianli Ma, Zhi Yao, Weijia Jia

entry.summary: Proposes PrediT, a training-free acceleration framework for Diffusion Transformers that predicts future features using linear multistep methods rather than naively reusing cached features, achieving significant speedups with maintained quality.

entry.title: Agentic Adversarial QA for Improving Domain-Specific LLMs

author.name: Vincent Grari, Ciprian Tomoiaga, Sylvain Lamprier, Tatsunori Hashimoto, Marcin Detyniecki

entry.summary: Proposes an agentic adversarial QA framework for improving domain-specific LLMs by generating interpretive reasoning data through adversarial question generation, addressing sample efficiency issues in synthetic data.

entry.title: GrandTour: A Legged Robotics Dataset in the Wild for Multi-Modal Perception and State Estimation

author.name: Jonas Frey, Turcan Tuna, Frank Fu, Katharine Patterson, Tianao Xu, Maurice Fallon, Cesar Cadena, Marco Hutter

entry.summary: Introduces GrandTour, a large-scale multi-modal legged robotics dataset collected across diverse outdoor/indoor environments using an ANYmal quadruped, covering alpine terrain, forests, demolished buildings, and urban areas.

entry.title: SOMtime the World Ain$'$t Fair: Violating Fairness Using Self-Organizing Maps

author.name: Joseph Bingham and Netanel Arussy and Dvir Aran

entry.summary: Demonstrates that unsupervised representations from Self-Organizing Maps can recover sensitive attributes (age, income) even when explicitly excluded from input, achieving Spearman correlations up to 0.85. Challenges the assumption that withholding attributes ensures fairness.

entry.title: Neural-HSS: Hierarchical Semi-Separable Neural PDE Solver

author.name: Pietro Sittoni, Emanuele Zangrando, Angelo A. Casulli, Nicola Guglielmi, Francesco Tudisco

entry.summary: Introduces Neural-HSS, a parameter-efficient PDE solver architecture based on Hierarchical Semi-Separable matrix structure. Proves data-efficiency and exactness properties for elliptic PDEs, with strong theoretical grounding in Green's functions.

entry.title: Diffusing to Coordinate: Efficient Online Multi-Agent Diffusion Policies

author.name: Zhuoran Li, Hai Zhong, Xun Wang, Qingxin Xia, Lihua Zhang, Longbo Huang

entry.summary: Proposes OMAD, among the first online off-policy MARL frameworks using diffusion policies for multi-agent coordination. Addresses intractable likelihoods of diffusion models that impede entropy-based exploration.

entry.title: Unifying approach to uniform expressivity of graph neural networks

author.name: Huan Luo, Jonni Virtema

entry.summary: Introduces Template GNNs (T-GNNs) that generalize GNN architectures incorporating substructural information, with corresponding logic (GML(T)) and generalized WL algorithms. Provides a unifying framework for expressivity analysis.

entry.title: SARAH: Spatially Aware Real-time Agentic Humans

author.name: Evonne Ng, Siwei Zhang, Zhang Chen, Michael Zollhoefer, Alexander Richard

entry.summary: Presents SARAH, the first real-time, fully causal method for spatially-aware conversational motion generation. Produces full-body motion oriented toward users based on position and audio, deployable on streaming VR headsets.

entry.title: Going Down Memory Lane: Scaling Tokens for Video Stream Understanding with Dynamic KV-Cache Memory

author.name: Vatsal Agarwal, Saksham Suri, Matthew Gwilliam, Pulkit Kumar, Abhinav Shrivastava

entry.summary: Proposes scaling the per-frame token budget in KV-cache-based video streaming models to improve fine-grained spatiotemporal understanding, identifying a bias toward later frames in existing methods and introducing an adaptive selection strategy to reduce token redundancy. This addresses a practical bottleneck in streaming video question answering where current methods lose visual detail by compressing too aggressively.

entry.title: Drift Estimation for Stochastic Differential Equations with Denoising Diffusion Models

author.name: Marcos Tapia Costa, Nikolas Kantas, George Deligiannidis

entry.summary: Reformulates drift estimation in multivariate SDEs as a denoising problem and proposes using conditional diffusion models for both estimation and trajectory simulation. Shows competitive performance with classical methods, especially in higher dimensions.

entry.title: On the Generalization and Robustness in Conditional Value-at-Risk

author.name: Dinesh Karthik Mulumudi, Piyushi Manupriya, Gholamali Aminian, Anant Raj

entry.summary: Develops learning-theoretic analysis of CVaR-based empirical risk minimization under heavy-tailed and contaminated data, establishing sharp generalization bounds and excess risk bounds under minimal assumptions, including extension to dependent data.

entry.title: LATMiX: Learnable Affine Transformations for Microscaling Quantization of LLMs

author.name: Ofir Gordon, Lior Dikstein, Arnon Netzer, Idan Achituve, Hai Victor Habi

entry.summary: Proposes LATMiX, a method using learnable affine transformations to improve post-training quantization of LLMs for the microscaling (MX) data format, going beyond rotation/Hadamard transformations with theoretical analysis of the transformation space.

entry.title: DesignAsCode: Bridging Structural Editability and Visual Fidelity in Graphic Design Generation

author.name: Ziyuan Liu, Shizhao Sun, Danqing Huang, Yingdong Shi, Meisheng Zhang, Ji Li, Jingsong Yu, Jiang Bian

entry.summary: Proposes DesignAsCode, a framework that generates graphic designs as HTML/CSS code through a Plan-Implement-Reflect pipeline, achieving both visual fidelity and structural editability—bridging the gap between raster synthesis and abstract layout generation.

entry.title: CLUTCH: Contextualized Language model for Unlocking Text-Conditioned Hand motion modelling in the wild

author.name: Balamurugan Thambiraja, Omid Taheri, Radek Danecek, Giorgio Becherini, Gerard Pons-Moll, Justus Thies

entry.summary: Introduces CLUTCH, an LLM-based hand animation system with a new 32K-sequence dataset (3D-HIW) of in-the-wild 3D hand motions with text alignments. Proposes SHIFT (VQ-VAE for hand motion tokenization) and geometric refinement for text-to-hand-motion generation.

entry.title: Learning Flow Distributions via Projection-Constrained Diffusion on Manifolds

author.name: Noah Trupin, Rahul Ghosh, Aadi Jangid

entry.summary: Presents a generative modeling framework for synthesizing physically feasible 2D incompressible flows using diffusion models with a projection-constrained reverse process that enforces exact incompressibility through a Helmholtz-Hodge operator.

entry.title: MePoly: Max Entropy Polynomial Policy Optimization

author.name: Hang Liu, Sangli Teng, Maani Ghaffari

entry.summary: Proposes MePoly, a policy parameterization using polynomial energy-based models that provides explicit, tractable probability density for multi-modal policy representation. Enables exact entropy maximization in maximum entropy RL and imitation learning.

entry.title: MantisV2: Closing the Zero-Shot Gap in Time Series Classification with Synthetic Data and Test-Time Strategies

author.name: Vasilii Feofanov, Songkang Wen, Jianfeng Zhang, Lujia Pan, Ievgen Redko

entry.summary: Introduces MantisV2, an improved foundation model for zero-shot time series classification using synthetic pre-training data, refined architecture, and enhanced test-time strategies leveraging intermediate layers.

entry.title: Distribution-Free Sequential Prediction with Abstentions

author.name: Jialin Yu and Mo\"ise Blanchard

entry.summary: Studies sequential prediction with abstentions in a semi-adversarial setting where the learner can abstain on corrupted instances. Shows that learning can be achieved for VC classes without knowing the clean distribution, bridging stochastic and adversarial settings.

entry.title: Understanding the Generalization of Bilevel Programming in Hyperparameter Optimization: A Tale of Bias-Variance Decomposition

author.name: Yubo Zhou, Jun Shu, Junmin Liu, Deyu Meng

entry.summary: Conducts a bias-variance decomposition of hypergradient estimation error in gradient-based hyperparameter optimization, providing new analysis of the variance term previously ignored. Offers comprehensive error bounds and practical insights.

entry.title: Bayesian Online Model Selection

author.name: Aida Afshar, Yuke Zhang, Aldo Pacchiano

entry.summary: Introduces a Bayesian algorithm for online model selection in stochastic bandits with an oracle-style regret guarantee. Proves O(d*M√T + √(MT)) Bayesian regret bound where M is number of base learners.

entry.title: Asynchronous Heavy-Tailed Optimization

author.name: Junfei Sun, Dixi Yao, Xuchen Gong, Tahseen Rabbani, Manzil Zaheer, Tian Li

entry.summary: Investigates asynchronous distributed optimization with heavy-tailed gradient noise, proposing delay-aware learning rate scheduling and delay compensation. Achieves convergence guarantees matching synchronous rates.

entry.title: MUOT_3M: A 3 Million Frame Multimodal Underwater Benchmark and the MUTrack Tracking Method

author.name: Ahsan Baidar Bakht, Mohamad Alansari, Muhayy Ud Din, Muzammal Naseer, Sajid Javed, Irfan Hussain, Jiri Matas, Arif Mahmood

entry.summary: Introduces MUOT_3M, the first pseudo-multimodal underwater object tracking benchmark with 3 million frames, 3,030 videos, and multiple modalities (RGB, depth, language). Also proposes MUTrack, a SAM-based multimodal tracker.

entry.title: Dual-Channel Attention Guidance for Training-Free Image Editing Control in Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Guandong Li, Mengxia Ye

entry.summary: Proposes DCAG, a training-free framework for controlling editing intensity in Diffusion Transformers by manipulating both Key and Value channels in attention layers. Reveals a bias-delta structure in DiT attention projections.

entry.title: Faster Training, Fewer Labels: Self-Supervised Pretraining for Fine-Grained BEV Segmentation

author.name: Daniel Busch, Christian Bohn, Thomas Kurbiel, Klaus Friedrichs, Richard Meyes, Tobias Meisen

entry.summary: Proposes a self-supervised pretraining strategy for BEV segmentation that uses reprojection-based pseudo-labels and temporal consistency, halving the required training data while outperforming supervised baselines.

entry.title: OODBench: Out-of-Distribution Benchmark for Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Ling Lin, Yang Bai, Heng Su, Congcong Zhu, Yaoxing Wang, Yang Zhou, Huazhu Fu, Jingrun Chen

entry.summary: Introduces OODBench, a predominantly automated method for constructing OOD benchmarks for Vision-Language Models, addressing the gap in evaluating VLM robustness to out-of-distribution data.

entry.title: Learning Long-Range Dependencies with Temporal Predictive Coding

author.name: Tom Potter, Oliver Rhodes

entry.summary: Combines Temporal Predictive Coding with approximate Real-Time Recurrent Learning for training RNNs on long-range temporal dependencies. Offers biologically plausible, energy-efficient alternative to BPTT.

entry.title: Unifying Formal Explanations: A Complexity-Theoretic Perspective

author.name: Shahaf Bassan, Xuanxiang Huang, Guy Katz

entry.summary: Introduces a unified framework for analyzing sufficient and contrastive explanations through minimization of a probabilistic value function, proving that computational complexity depends on three key properties of the value function.

entry.title: Self-Aware Object Detection via Degradation Manifolds

author.name: Stefan Becker and Simon Weiss and Wolfgang H\"ubner and Michael Arens

entry.summary: Introduces a degradation-aware self-awareness framework for object detectors using degradation manifolds that structure feature space by image degradation. Uses contrastive learning to enable detectors to recognize when input is outside their nominal operating regime.

entry.title: Benchmarking Graph Neural Networks in Solving Hard Constraint Satisfaction Problems

author.name: Geri Skenderi, Lorenzo Buffoni, Francesco D'Amico, David Machado, Raffaele Marino, Matteo Negri, Federico Ricci-Tersenghi, Carlo Lucibello, Maria Chiara Angelini

entry.summary: Proposes hard constraint satisfaction benchmarks from statistical physics for evaluating GNNs. Shows classical algorithms still outperform GNNs on truly hard random instances, challenging claims of GNN superiority.

entry.title: RVR: Retrieve-Verify-Retrieve for Comprehensive Question Answering

author.name: Deniz Qian, Hung-Ting Chen, Eunsol Choi
