entry.summary: Proposes RVR (Retrieve-Verify-Retrieve), a multi-round retrieval framework that maximizes answer coverage for comprehensive QA. Each round augments queries with previously verified documents to discover new answers, achieving 10%+ recall gains.

entry.title: Avoid What You Know: Divergent Trajectory Balance for GFlowNets

author.name: Pedro Dall'Antonia and Tiago da Silva and Daniel Csillag and Salem Lahlou and Diego Mesquita

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Complementary Exploration (ACE) for GFlowNets that uses a complementary distribution to guide exploration toward novel high-probability regions, avoiding wasted samples on already-explored areas. Integrated with trajectory balance training.

entry.title: Interactive Learning of Single-Index Models via Stochastic Gradient Descent

author.name: Nived Rajaraman, Yanjun Han

entry.summary: Studies sequential/interactive learning for single-index models using SGD, showing it undergoes a burn-in phase before learning (similar to optimal learners) and achieves near-optimal excess risk with proper learning rate scheduling.

entry.title: BioBridge: Bridging Proteins and Language for Enhanced Biological Reasoning with LLMs

author.name: Yujia Wang, Jihong Guan, Wengen Li, Shuigeng Zhou, Xuhong Wang

entry.summary: Proposes BioBridge, a continual pretraining framework that aligns protein language models with LLMs through domain-incremental training and cross-modal projection, enabling joint protein-text reasoning while mitigating catastrophic forgetting.

entry.title: ScaleBITS: Scalable Bitwidth Search for Hardware-Aligned Mixed-Precision LLMs

author.name: Xinlin Li, Timothy Chou, Josh Fromm, Zichang Liu, Yunjie Pan, Christina Fragouli

entry.summary: Proposes ScaleBITS, a mixed-precision quantization framework with automated block-wise bitwidth allocation using bi-directional channel reordering, pushing average precision below 4 bits while maintaining hardware efficiency.

entry.title: Nested Training for Mutual Adaptation in Human-AI Teaming

author.name: Upasana Biswas, Durgesh Kalwar, Subbarao Kambhampati, Sarath Sreedharan

entry.summary: Proposes a nested training approach for human-AI teaming that models the interaction as an Interactive POMDP, explicitly representing human adaptive behavior. Aims to produce robot policies that generalize to new partners rather than converging on opaque implicit coordination strategies.

entry.title: Solving and learning advective multiscale Darcian dynamics with the Neural Basis Method

author.name: Yuhe Wang and Min Wang

entry.summary: Introduces the Neural Basis Method for solving PDEs, using projection-based formulations that couple physics-conforming neural basis spaces with operator-induced residual metrics. Addresses the common issue of heuristic loss balancing in physics-informed neural networks.

entry.title: Dual Length Codes for Lossless Compression of BFloat16

author.name: Aditya Agrawal, Albert Magyar, Hiteshwar Eswaraiah, Patrick Sheridan, Pradeep Janedula, Ravi Krishnan Venkatesan, Krishna Nair, Ravi Iyer

entry.summary: Introduces Dual Length Codes for lossless compression of BFloat16 tensors in LLM training/serving, balancing compression efficiency with decoding speed. Analyzes BFloat16 tensors from the Gemma model to exploit frequency distributions.

entry.title: Neural Prior Estimation: Learning Class Priors from Latent Representations

author.name: Masoud Yavari and Payman Moallem

entry.summary: Introduces Neural Prior Estimator (NPE) that learns feature-conditioned log-prior estimates from latent representations to address class imbalance in deep networks. Under Neural Collapse regime, NPE provably recovers class log-prior up to additive constant.

entry.title: Learning Compact Video Representations for Efficient Long-form Video Understanding in Large Multimodal Models

author.name: Yuxiao Chen, Jue Wang, Zhikang Zhang, Jingru Yi, Xu Zhang, Yang Zou, Zhaowei Cai, Jianbo Yuan, Xinyu Li, Hao Yang, Davide Modolo

entry.summary: Proposes an end-to-end schema for long-form video understanding with an adaptive video sampler based on information density and an autoencoder-based spatiotemporal video compressor for efficient frame utilization within memory constraints.

entry.title: COMBA: Cross Batch Aggregation for Learning Large Graphs with Context Gating State Space Models

author.name: Jiajun Shen, Yufei Jin, Yi He, xingquan Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes COMBA for large graph learning using state space models with graph context gating and cross batch aggregation. Context gating controls neighborhood aggregation across hops while cross-batch aggregation handles graphs too large for single batches.

entry.title: WHED: A Wearable Hand Exoskeleton for Natural, High-Quality Demonstration Collection

author.name: Mingzhang Zhu, Alvin Zhu, Jose Victor S. H. Ramos, Beom Jun Kim, Yike Shi, Yufeng Wu, Ruochen Hou, Quanyou Wang, Eric Song, Tony Fan, Yuchen Cui, and Dennis W. Hong

entry.summary: Presents WHED, a wearable hand exoskeleton for collecting natural manipulation demonstrations. Features pose-tolerant thumb coupling and passive fit accommodation for extended in-the-wild use, with end-to-end data pipeline for robot learning.

entry.title: MIRA: Memory-Integrated Reinforcement Learning Agent with Limited LLM Guidance

author.name: Narjes Nourzad, Carlee Joe-Wong

entry.summary: Proposes MIRA, an RL agent that uses structured memory graphs constructed from both agent experiences and LLM outputs to guide early training. Amortizes LLM queries into persistent memory to reduce dependence on LLM supervision over time.

entry.title: Analyzing LLM Instruction Optimization for Tabular Fact Verification

author.name: Xiaotang Du, Giwon Hong, Wai-Chung Kwan, Rohit Saxena, Ivan Titov, Pasquale Minervini, Emily Allaway

entry.summary: Presents the first systematic comparison of instruction optimization (via DSPy framework) for tabular fact verification, evaluating four prompting techniques and three optimizers across four benchmarks and three model families. Finds that instruction optimization consistently helps, with MiPROv2 and SIMBA providing complementary benefits.

entry.title: From Global Radiomics to Parametric Maps: A Unified Workflow Fusing Radiomics and Deep Learning for PDAC Detection

author.name: Zengtian Deng, Yimeng He, Yu Shi, Lixia Wang, Touseef Ahmad Qureshi, Xiuzhen Huang, Debiao Li

entry.summary: Proposes a unified framework fusing radiomics and deep learning for pancreatic cancer detection, injecting handcrafted radiomic features at both global and voxel levels into nnUNet. Achieves AUC=0.96 on PANORAMA dataset.

entry.title: PHAST: Port-Hamiltonian Architecture for Structured Temporal Dynamics Forecasting

author.name: Shubham Bhardwaj, Chandrajit Bajaj

entry.summary: Introduces PHAST, a port-Hamiltonian architecture for forecasting dissipative physical systems from position-only observations. Decomposes the Hamiltonian into potential and kinetic terms with guaranteed energy decay.

entry.title: EgoPush: Learning End-to-End Egocentric Multi-Object Rearrangement for Mobile Robots

author.name: Boyuan An, Zhexiong Wang, Yipeng Wang, Jiaqi Li, Sihang Li, Jing Zhang and Chen Feng

entry.summary: Introduces EgoPush, a policy learning framework for egocentric multi-object rearrangement using a single camera, learning object-centric latent representations through privileged RL teacher distilled into a visual student policy.

entry.title: Balancing Symmetry and Efficiency in Graph Flow Matching

author.name: Benjamin Honor\'e, Alba Carballo-Castro, Yiming Qin, Pascal Frossard

entry.summary: Studies the trade-off between equivariance and efficiency in graph flow matching, proposing a controllable symmetry modulation scheme that relaxes strict equivariance during training to accelerate convergence.

entry.title: Non-Stationary Online Resource Allocation: Learning from a Single Sample

author.name: Yiding Feng, Jiashuo Jiang, Yige Wang

entry.summary: Studies online resource allocation under non-stationary demand requiring only one historical sample per period, distinguishing between reward-observed and type-only sample settings.

entry.title: Flow Matching with Injected Noise for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yongjae Shin, Jongseong Chae, Jongeui Park, Youngchul Sung

entry.summary: Proposes FINO, a flow matching-based policy with noise injection for offline-to-online RL, facilitating exploration beyond the offline dataset through controlled noise during policy training.

entry.title: FENCE: A Financial and Multimodal Jailbreak Detection Dataset

author.name: Mirae Kim, Seonghun Jeong, Youngjun Kwak

entry.summary: Presents FENCE, a bilingual Korean-English multimodal dataset for training jailbreak detectors in financial applications, with finance-relevant queries and image-grounded threats.

entry.title: JPmHC Dynamical Isometry via Orthogonal Hyper-Connections

author.name: Biswa Sengupta, Jinhua Wang, Leo Brunswic

entry.summary: Proposes JPmHC, a framework for hyper-connections that constrains mixer matrices on operator-norm-bounded manifolds (bistochastic, Stiefel, Grassmann) to preserve dynamical isometry while allowing wider residual streams.

entry.title: CapNav: Benchmarking Vision Language Models on Capability-conditioned Indoor Navigation

author.name: Xia Su, Ruiqi Chen, Benlin Liu, Jingwei Ma, Zonglin Di, Ranjay Krishna, Jon Froehlich

entry.summary: Introduces CapNav, a benchmark evaluating VLMs on indoor navigation conditioned by agent physical capabilities (e.g., stairs vs wheelchair). Defines five agent types across 45 real-world scenes with 450 test instances.

entry.title: Adapters as Representational Hypotheses: What Adapter Methods Tell Us About Transformer Geometry

author.name: wassname

entry.summary: Argues that adapter fine-tuning papers (LoRA, etc.) should be reinterpreted as implicit hypothesis tests about transformer geometry — each adapter's structural constraint encodes assumptions about which directions in weight space matter for model computation. Provides a catalog with pseudocode treating adapter methods as intervention evidence for interpretability research.

entry.title: A Geometric Probe of the Accuracy-Robustness Trade-off: Sharp Boundaries in Symmetry-Breaking Dimensional Expansion

author.name: Yu Bai, Zhe Wang, Jiarui Zhang, Dong-Xiao Zhang, Yinjun Gao, Jun-Jie Zhang

entry.summary: Uses Symmetry-Breaking Dimensional Expansion (SBDE) as a probe to investigate the accuracy-robustness trade-off in deep learning, showing that expanding inputs with constant pixels improves clean accuracy but reduces adversarial robustness. Introduces a mask projection defense.

entry.title: Minimax optimal adaptive structured transfer learning through semi-parametric domain-varying coefficient model

author.name: Hanxiao Chen and Debarghya Mukherjee

entry.summary: Proposes a semiparametric domain-varying coefficient model for transfer learning that encodes domain relatedness through observable identifiers, achieving minimax-optimal rates and adapting to unknown similarity between source and target domains.

entry.title: Preconditioned Robust Neural Posterior Estimation for Misspecified Simulators

author.name: Ryan P. Kelly, David T. Frazier, David J. Warne, Christopher C. Drovandi

entry.summary: Studies preconditioning strategies for neural posterior estimation (NPE) under model misspecification, showing how extreme prior-predictive draws and incompatible summaries degrade inference and proposing robust solutions.

entry.title: Quantum Maximum Likelihood Prediction via Hilbert Space Embeddings

author.name: Sreejith Sreekumar and Nir Weinberger

entry.summary: Proposes a quantum information-geometric framework for understanding in-context learning, modeling training as learning embeddings into quantum density operator space and ICL as maximum-likelihood prediction over quantum models, with non-asymptotic guarantees.

entry.title: BankMathBench: A Benchmark for Numerical Reasoning in Banking Scenarios

author.name: Yunseung Lee, Subin Kim, Youngjun Kwak, Jaegul Choo

entry.summary: Introduces BankMathBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on multi-step numerical reasoning in banking scenarios including interest calculations, product comparisons, and early repayment conditions. Reveals systematic errors in current LLMs.

entry.title: KPM-Bench: A Kinematic Parsing Motion Benchmark for Fine-grained Motion-centric Video Understanding

author.name: Boda Lin, Yongjie Zhu, Xiaocheng Gong, Wenyu Qin, Meng Wang

entry.summary: Introduces KPM-Bench, a benchmark for fine-grained motion understanding in videos using an automated annotation pipeline that integrates kinematic-based motion computation with linguistic parsing. Addresses hallucination issues in video captioning for motion-centric content.

entry.title: Ontology-Guided Neuro-Symbolic Inference: Grounding Language Models with Mathematical Domain Knowledge

author.name: Marcelo Labre

entry.summary: Investigates using formal domain ontologies (OpenMath) for retrieval-augmented generation to improve LLM reliability in mathematics. Finds ontology-guided context helps when retrieval quality is high but degrades performance when irrelevant.

entry.title: Causality by Abstraction: Symbolic Rule Learning in Multivariate Timeseries with Large Language Models

author.name: Preetom Biswas, Giulia Pedrielli, K. Sel\c{c}uk Candan

entry.summary: Presents ruleXplain, a framework using LLMs to extract formal causal rules with temporal operators and delay semantics from multivariate time series in simulation-driven dynamical systems.

entry.title: MultiVer: Zero-Shot Multi-Agent Vulnerability Detection

author.name: Shreshth Rajan

entry.summary: Presents MultiVer, a zero-shot multi-agent system for vulnerability detection using four specialized agents (security, correctness, performance, style) with union voting. Achieves 82.7% recall on PyVul, exceeding fine-tuned GPT-3.5.

entry.title: MeDUET: Disentangled Unified Pretraining for 3D Medical Image Synthesis and Analysis

author.name: Junkai Liu, Ling Shao, Le Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes MeDUET, a unified pre-training framework for 3D medical image synthesis and analysis that disentangles domain-invariant content from domain-specific style in the VAE latent space using token demixing.

entry.title: El Agente Gr\'afico: Structured Execution Graphs for Scientific Agents

author.name: Jiaru Bai and Abdulrahman Aldossary and Thomas Swanick and Marcel M\"uller and Yeonghun Kang and Zijian Zhang and Jin Won Lee and Tsz Wai Ko and Mohammad Ghazi Vakili and Varinia Bernales and Al\'an Aspuru-Guzik

entry.summary: Presents El Agente Gráfico, a single-agent framework embedding LLM decision-making within type-safe execution environments and dynamic knowledge graphs for scientific workflow automation. Emphasizes auditability and structured state management.

entry.title: Improving Neural Topic Modeling with Semantically-Grounded Soft Label Distributions

author.name: Raymond Li, Amirhossein Abaskohi, Chuyuan Li, Gabriel Murray, Giuseppe Carenini

entry.summary: Proposes using language model next-token probabilities projected onto a vocabulary to create semantically-grounded soft labels for neural topic modeling, replacing traditional bag-of-words reconstruction targets.

entry.title: A Single Image and Multimodality Is All You Need for Novel View Synthesis

author.name: Amirhosein Javadi, Chi-Shiang Gau, Konstantinos D. Polyzos, Tara Javidi

entry.summary: Shows that incorporating sparse multimodal range measurements (radar, LiDAR) with diffusion-based single-image novel view synthesis significantly improves depth quality and view consistency, especially in challenging real-world conditions.

entry.title: CUICurate: A GraphRAG-based Framework for Automated Clinical Concept Curation for NLP applications

author.name: Victoria Blake, Mathew Miller, Jamie Novak, Sze-yuan Ooi and Blanca Gallego

entry.summary: Presents CUICurate, a GraphRAG framework for automated UMLS concept set curation in clinical NLP. Uses a UMLS knowledge graph with LLM-based retrieval to automate the labor-intensive process of building medical concept sets.

entry.title: MeanVoiceFlow: One-step Nonparallel Voice Conversion with Mean Flows

author.name: Takuhiro Kaneko, Hirokazu Kameoka, Kou Tanaka, Yuto Kondo

entry.summary: Proposes MeanVoiceFlow, a one-step voice conversion model based on mean flows that can be trained from scratch without pretraining or distillation, using average velocity instead of instantaneous velocity for single-step inference.

entry.title: LERD: Latent Event-Relational Dynamics for Neurodegenerative Classification

author.name: Hairong Chen, Yicheng Feng, Ziyu Jia, Samir Bhatt, Hengguan Huang

entry.summary: Proposes LERD, a Bayesian neural dynamical system for Alzheimer's disease classification from EEG that infers latent neural events and their relational structure without annotations. Combines continuous-time event inference with stochastic event generation.

entry.title: MEG-to-MEG Transfer Learning and Cross-Task Speech/Silence Detection with Limited Data

author.name: Xabier de Zuazo, Vincenzo Verbeni, Eva Navas, Ibon Saratxaga, Mathieu Bourguignon, Nicola Molinaro

entry.summary: Demonstrates first transfer learning and cross-task decoding for MEG-based speech models between perception and production. Pre-trains on 50 hours of listening data, fine-tunes on 5 minutes per subject, achieving cross-task gains of 5-6%.

entry.title: Subgroups of $U(d)$ Induce Natural RNN and Transformer Architectures

author.name: Joshua Nunley

entry.summary: Derives RNN and transformer architectures from subgroups of U(d) using minimal axioms. Shows orthogonal-state models from O(d) and evaluates on language modeling benchmarks.

entry.title: Learning from Biased and Costly Data Sources: Minimax-optimal Data Collection under a Budget

author.name: Michael O. Harding, Vikas Singh, Kirthevasan Kandasamy

entry.summary: Studies optimal data collection from multiple heterogeneous sources under a fixed budget, addressing estimation of population and group-conditional means. Shows naive strategies are suboptimal and derives minimax-optimal allocation strategies.

entry.title: PRISM-FCP: Byzantine-Resilient Federated Conformal Prediction via Partial Sharing

author.name: Ehsan Lari, Reza Arablouei, Stefan Werner

entry.summary: Proposes PRISM-FCP, a Byzantine-resilient federated conformal prediction framework using partial model sharing to mitigate adversarial attacks during both training and calibration stages, providing end-to-end robustness.

entry.title: EXACT: Explicit Attribute-Guided Decoding-Time Personalization

author.name: Xin Yu, Hanwen Xing, Lingzhou Xue

entry.summary: Introduces EXACT, a decoding-time personalization method that aligns LLM generation with user preferences using interpretable attribute sets, identifying user-specific attributes offline and retrieving prompt-relevant attributes online.

entry.title: Inference in Spreading Processes with Neural-Network Priors

author.name: Davide Ghio, Fabrizio Boncoraglio, Lenka Zdeborov\'a

entry.summary: Proposes using neural networks as priors for the initial state in inference problems on spreading processes (e.g., epidemics) over graphs, replacing the standard i.i.d. assumption with a learned function of node covariates. This makes the inference framework more realistic for practical applications where node features influence dynamics.

entry.title: PRISM: Parallel Reward Integration with Symmetry for MORL

author.name: Finn van der Knaap, Kejiang Qian, Zheng Xu, Fengxiang He

entry.summary: Addresses heterogeneous multi-objective RL where objectives differ in temporal frequency, proposing PRISM which uses reflectional symmetry as an inductive bias and a novel reward reconciliation network to handle temporal-frequency mismatches.

entry.title: Exposing Blindspots: Cultural Bias Evaluation in Generative Image Models

author.name: Huichan Seo, Sieun Choi, Minki Hong, Yi Zhou, Junseo Kim, Lukman Ismaila, Naome Etori, Mehul Agarwal, Zhixuan Liu, Jihie Kim, and Jean Oh

entry.summary: Introduces a unified evaluation framework for cultural bias in both text-to-image and image-to-image generative models across six countries, using an 8-category schema with era-aware prompts and combining automated metrics with expert human judgments.

entry.title: Reducing Text Bias in Synthetically Generated MCQAs for VLMs in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Sutej Kulgod, Sean Ye, Sanchit Tanwar, Christoffer Heckman

entry.summary: Addresses text bias in synthetically generated MCQAs for VLMs in autonomous driving, proposing methods to reduce blind accuracy from +66.9% above random to +2.9% by decoupling correct answers from linguistic artifacts.

entry.title: Robust Pre-Training of Medical Vision-and-Language Models with Domain-Invariant Multi-Modal Masked Reconstruction

author.name: Melika Filvantorkaman, Mohsen Piri

entry.summary: Proposes Robust-MMR, a self-supervised pretraining framework for medical vision-language models that incorporates perturbation-aware masking and domain-consistency regularization to improve robustness under domain shift from varying imaging devices and protocols.

entry.title: Enabling Training-Free Text-Based Remote Sensing Segmentation

author.name: Jose Sosa, Danila Rukhovich, Anis Kacem, and Djamila Aouada

entry.summary: Investigates training-free text-based segmentation of remote sensing imagery by combining CLIP and SAM. Achieves state-of-the-art results among training-free methods and competitive performance with tuned approaches.

entry.title: Promptable segmentation with region exploration enables minimal-effort expert-level prostate cancer delineation

author.name: Junqing Yang, Natasha Thorley, Ahmed Nadeem Abbasi, Shonit Punwani, Zion Tse, Yipeng Hu, Shaheer U. Saeed

entry.summary: Proposes a framework combining reinforcement learning with promptable segmentation for prostate cancer delineation on MR images. Uses region exploration to achieve expert-level accuracy with minimal point-prompt annotation effort.

entry.title: On the scaling relationship between cloze probabilities and language model next-token prediction

author.name: Cassandra L. Jacobs, Morgan Grobol

entry.summary: Studies how larger language models better predict human reading times and cloze task responses, finding that larger models are less sensitive to lexical co-occurrence while being better aligned semantically with human responses.

entry.title: Alignment in Time: Peak-Aware Orchestration for Long-Horizon Agentic Systems

author.name: Hanjing Shi and Dominic DiFranzo

entry.summary: Introduces APEMO, a runtime scheduling layer for long-horizon agentic systems that uses temporal-affective signals to optimize computational allocation. Detects trajectory instability and targets repairs at critical segments like peak moments and endings.

entry.title: ZACH-ViT: Regime-Dependent Inductive Bias in Compact Vision Transformers for Medical Imaging

author.name: Athanasios Angelakis

entry.summary: Introduces ZACH-ViT, a compact Vision Transformer for medical imaging that removes positional embeddings and [CLS] token, achieving permutation invariance through global average pooling. Designed for settings where spatial layout is weakly informative.

entry.title: Causal Neighbourhood Learning for Invariant Graph Representations

author.name: Simi Job, Xiaohui Tao, Taotao Cai, Haoran Xie, Jianming Yong

entry.summary: Proposes CNL-GNN, a framework that performs causal interventions on graph structure to identify causally relevant connections and reduce spurious correlations in GNNs. Aims to improve generalization under distribution shifts.

entry.title: Generating adversarial inputs for a graph neural network model of AC power flow

author.name: Robert Parker

entry.summary: Generates adversarial inputs for a graph neural network model of AC power flow, finding that small perturbations can cause large prediction errors. Motivates the need for rigorous verification of ML models in power systems.

entry.title: Image Quality Assessment: Exploring Quality Awareness via Memory-driven Distortion Patterns Matching

author.name: Xuting Lan, Mingliang Zhou, Xuekai Wei, Jielu Yan, Yueting Huang, Huayan Pu, Jun Luo, and Weijia Jia

entry.summary: Proposes MQAF, a memory-driven quality-aware framework for image quality assessment that stores distortion patterns in a memory bank and dynamically switches between reference and no-reference assessment modes.

entry.title: Spatio-temporal Decoupled Knowledge Compensator for Few-Shot Action Recognition

author.name: Hongyu Qu, Xiangbo Shu, Rui Yan, Hailiang Gao, Wenguan Wang, Jinhui Tang

entry.summary: Proposes DiST, a framework for few-shot action recognition that decomposes action names into spatial and temporal attribute descriptions using LLMs to learn multi-granularity prototypes.

entry.title: CityGuard: Graph-Aware Private Descriptors for Bias-Resilient Identity Search Across Urban Cameras

author.name: Rong Fu, Wenxin Zhang, Yibo Meng, Jia Yee Tan, Jiaxuan Lu, Rui Lu, Jiekai Wu, Zhaolu Kang, Simon Fong

entry.summary: Introduces CityGuard for privacy-preserving person re-identification using topology-aware transformers with differentially private descriptors, spatial attention, and dispersion-adaptive metrics.

entry.title: Temporal Consistency-Aware Text-to-Motion Generation

author.name: Hongsong Wang, Wenjing Yan, Qiuxia Lai, Xin Geng

entry.summary: Proposes TCA-T2M, a framework for text-to-motion generation that enforces cross-sequence temporal consistency through a temporal consistency-aware spatial VQ-VAE and kinematic constraints.

entry.title: Interacting safely with cyclists using Hamilton-Jacobi reachability and reinforcement learning

author.name: Aarati Andrea Noronha and Jean Oh

entry.summary: Presents a framework combining Hamilton-Jacobi reachability analysis with deep Q-learning for autonomous vehicles to safely interact with cyclists, incorporating cyclist behavioral adaptation models.

entry.title: RamanSeg: Interpretability-driven Deep Learning on Raman Spectra for Cancer Diagnosis

author.name: Chris Tomy, Mo Vali, David Pertzborn, Tammam Alamatouri, Anna M\"uhlig, Orlando Guntinas-Lichius, Anna Xylander, Eric Michele Fantuzzi, Matteo Negro, Francesco Crisafi, Pietro Lio, Tiago Azevedo

entry.summary: Proposes RamanSeg, an interpretable prototype-based architecture for cancer diagnosis from Raman spectra, achieving 80.9% Dice score. Offers trade-off between interpretability and performance.

entry.title: Flexi-NeurA: A Configurable Neuromorphic Accelerator with Adaptive Bit-Precision Exploration for Edge SNNs

author.name: Mohammad Farahani and Mohammad Rasoul Roshanshah and Saeed Safari

entry.summary: Presents Flexi-NeurA, a parameterizable neuromorphic accelerator core that allows customization of neuron models, network structures, and precision settings with time-multiplexed event-driven processing.

entry.title: Have We Mastered Scale in Deep Monocular Visual SLAM? The ScaleMaster Dataset and Benchmark

author.name: Hyoseok Ju, Bokeon Suh, and Giseop Kim

entry.summary: Introduces the ScaleMaster Dataset, the first benchmark specifically designed to evaluate scale consistency of deep monocular visual SLAM in large-scale indoor environments with multi-floor structures and long trajectories. Reveals vulnerabilities in state-of-the-art systems.

entry.title: Simplifying Outcomes of Language Model Component Analyses with ELIA

author.name: Aaron Louis Eidt, Nils Feldhus

entry.summary: Presents ELIA, an interactive web application that simplifies mechanistic interpretability analysis outcomes for broader audiences. Uses vision-language models to auto-generate natural language explanations of complex interpretability visualizations.

entry.title: On the Semantic and Syntactic Information Encoded in Proto-Tokens for One-Step Text Reconstruction

author.name: Ivan Bondarenko, Egor Palkin, Fedor Tikunov

entry.summary: Studies what information proto-tokens encode in one-step text reconstruction by frozen LLMs. Performs experiments disentangling semantic and syntactic content in the two proto-tokens and analyzes attention patterns.

entry.title: Diff2DGS: Reliable Reconstruction of Occluded Surgical Scenes via 2D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Tianyi Song, Danail Stoyanov, Evangelos Mazomenos, Francisco Vasconcelos

entry.summary: Proposes Diff2DGS, a two-stage framework for surgical scene reconstruction handling occlusion. First stage uses diffusion-based inpainting for tissue occluded by instruments, second stage uses 2D Gaussian Splatting for 3D reconstruction.

entry.title: Zero-shot Interactive Perception

author.name: Venkatesh Sripada, Frank Guerin, Amir Ghalamzan

entry.summary: Presents Zero-Shot Interactive Perception (ZS-IP), coupling multi-strategy manipulation with memory-driven VLMs for robotic interaction. Introduces pushlines as novel visual augmentation for pushing actions.

entry.title: Exploiting Completeness Perception with Diffusion Transformer for Unified 3D MRI Synthesis

author.name: Junkai Liu, Nay Aung, Theodoros N. Arvanitis, Joao A. C. Lima, Steffen E. Petersen, Daniel C. Alexander, Le Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes CoPeDiT, a diffusion transformer that self-perceives missing states in multi-modal brain MRI and cardiac MRI without external guidance. Addresses missing modalities and slices in a unified framework.

entry.title: Leakage and Second-Order Dynamics Improve Hippocampal RNN Replay

author.name: Josue Casco-Rodriguez, Nanda H. Krishna, Richard G. Baraniuk

entry.summary: Examines hippocampal replay in recurrent neural networks, showing that hidden state leakage and second-order dynamics (momentum) improve replay quality. Connects to sampling theory and provides both theoretical and empirical analysis.

entry.title: Assessing LLM Response Quality in the Context of Technology-Facilitated Abuse

author.name: Vijay Prakash, Majed Almansoori, Donghan Hu, Rahul Chatterjee, Danny Yuxing Huang

entry.summary: Presents the first expert-led evaluation of LLMs for technology-facilitated abuse contexts, comparing general-purpose and domain-specific models on their ability to provide appropriate guidance to IPV survivors.

entry.title: IRPAPERS: A Visual Document Benchmark for Scientific Retrieval and Question Answering

author.name: Connor Shorten, Augustas Skaburskas, Daniel M. Jones, Charles Pierse, Roberto Esposito, John Trengrove, Etienne Dilocker, Bob van Luijt

entry.summary: Introduces IRPAPERS, a benchmark of 3,230 pages from 166 scientific papers comparing image-based and text-based retrieval and QA systems on needle-in-the-haystack questions, finding text retrieval still outperforms image-based approaches.

entry.title: A Case Study of Selected PTQ Baselines for Reasoning LLMs on Ascend NPU

author.name: Yuchen Luo, Fangyue Zhu, Ruining Zhou, Mingzhe Huang, Jian Zhu, Fanyu Fan, Wei Shao

entry.summary: Case study of PTQ methods (AWQ, GPTQ, SmoothQuant, FlatQuant) applied to reasoning LLMs on Ascend NPU, revealing significant platform sensitivity and logic collapse issues with aggressive quantization on non-GPU hardware.

entry.title: Multi-material Multi-physics Topology Optimization with Physics-informed Gaussian Process Priors

author.name: Xiangyu Sun, Shirin Hosseinmardi, Amin Yousefpour, Ramin Bostanabad

entry.summary: Proposes a framework using physics-informed Gaussian processes for multi-material, multi-physics topology optimization. Represents primary, adjoint, and design variables as independent GP priors with neural network mean functions.

entry.title: Reinforcement-Learning-Based Assistance Reduces Squat Effort with a Modular Hip--Knee Exoskeleton

author.name: Neethan Ratnakumar, Mariya Huzaifa Tohfafarosh, Saanya Jauhri, Xianlian Zhou

entry.summary: Evaluates an RL-trained neural network controller for a modular hip-knee exoskeleton during squatting tasks. Shows significant reduction in muscle effort (average 42.2% reduction in EMG signals) in a 5-person study.

entry.title: VQPP: Video Query Performance Prediction Benchmark

author.name: Adrian Catalin Lutu, Eduard Poesina, Radu Tudor Ionescu

entry.summary: Proposes VQPP, the first benchmark for video query performance prediction, comprising 56K text queries and 51K videos with multiple retrieval systems. Extends the well-studied text/image QPP problem to video retrieval.

entry.title: Mind the Style: Impact of Communication Style on Human-Chatbot Interaction

author.name: Erik Derner, Dalibor Ku\v{c}era, Aditya Gulati, Ayoub Bagheri, Nuria Oliver

entry.summary: User study comparing friendly vs. task-focused chatbot communication styles finds that friendly style increases satisfaction and improves task completion among female participants, while no gender differences existed in control conditions.

entry.title: PenTiDef: Enhancing Privacy and Robustness in Decentralized Federated Intrusion Detection Systems against Poisoning Attacks

author.name: Phan The Duy, Nghi Hoang Khoa, Nguyen Tran Anh Quan, Luong Ha Tien, Ngo Duc Hoang Son, Van-Hau Pham

entry.summary: Proposes PenTiDef, a privacy-preserving defense framework for decentralized federated intrusion detection systems, combining distributed differential privacy with robustness against poisoning attacks.

entry.title: Towards LLM-centric Affective Visual Customization via Efficient and Precise Emotion Manipulating

author.name: Jiamin Luo, Xuqian Gu, Jingjing Wang, Jiahong Lu

entry.summary: Proposes L-AVC, an LLM-centric framework for affective visual customization that modifies subjective emotions in images via multimodal LLMs, addressing inter-emotion semantic conversion and emotion-agnostic content retention.

entry.title: DeepSVU: Towards In-depth Security-oriented Video Understanding via Unified Physical-world Regularized MoE

author.name: Yujie Jin, Wenxin Zhang, Jingjing Wang, Guodong Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces DeepSVU for in-depth security-oriented video understanding that not only detects threats but attributes and evaluates their causes. Uses a physical-world regularized Mixture-of-Experts architecture.

entry.title: PINEAPPLE: Physics-Informed Neuro-Evolution Algorithm for Prognostic Parameter Inference in Lithium-Ion Battery Electrodes

author.name: Karkulali Pugalenthi, Jian Cheng Wong, Qizheng Yang, Pao-Hsiung Chiu, My Ha Dao, Nagarajan Raghavan, Chinchun Ooi

entry.summary: Introduces PINEAPPLE, a framework combining physics-informed neural networks with evolutionary search for rapid parameter inference in lithium-ion battery electrodes, achieving zero-shot prediction with <0.1% error.

entry.title: TempoNet: Slack-Quantized Transformer-Guided Reinforcement Scheduler for Adaptive Deadline-Centric Real-Time Dispatchs

author.name: Rong Fu, Yibo Meng, Guangzhen Yao, Jiaxuan Lu, Zeyu Zhang, Zhaolu Kang, Ziming Guo, Jia Yee Tan, Xiaojing Du, Simon James Fong

entry.summary: Proposes TempoNet, an RL-based real-time scheduler using a permutation-invariant Transformer with urgency tokenization and sparse attention for deadline-aware task scheduling on multicore systems.

entry.title: Stable Long-Horizon Spatiotemporal Prediction on Meshes Using Latent Multiscale Recurrent Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Lionel Salesses, Larbi Arbaoui, Tariq Benamara, Arnaud Francois, Caroline Sainvitu

entry.summary: Proposes a deep learning framework for predicting temperature histories on meshes using a temporal multiscale architecture with coupled models, maintaining stability over thousands of time steps for additive manufacturing applications.

entry.title: BONNI: Gradient-Informed Bayesian and Interior Point Optimization for Efficient Inverse Design in Nanophotonics

author.name: Yannik Mahlau, Yannick Augenstein, Tyler W. Hughes, Marius Lindauer and Bodo Rosenhahn

entry.summary: Introduces BONNI, combining Bayesian optimization with neural network surrogates and interior point optimization for nanophotonic inverse design, incorporating gradient information for efficient global optimization.

entry.title: Information-Theoretic Storage Cost in Sentence Comprehension

author.name: Kohei Kajikawa, Shinnosuke Isono, Ethan Gotlieb Wilcox

entry.summary: Proposes an information-theoretic measure of processing storage cost in sentence comprehension, estimated from neural language models. Validates the approach through three analyses in English, showing it predicts reading times.

entry.title: HyTRec: A Hybrid Temporal-Aware Attention Architecture for Long Behavior Sequential Recommendation

author.name: Lei Xin, Yuhao Zheng, Ke Cheng, Changjiang Jiang, Zifan Zhang, Fanhu Zeng

entry.summary: Proposes HyTRec, a hybrid attention architecture for sequential recommendation that decouples long-term stable preferences (linear attention) from short-term intent spikes (softmax attention). Addresses the efficiency-precision tradeoff for industrial-scale recommendation.

entry.title: Learning Smooth Time-Varying Linear Policies with an Action Jacobian Penalty

author.name: Zhaoming Xie, Kevin Karol, Jessica Hodgins

entry.summary: Proposes using the action Jacobian penalty in reinforcement learning for character animation, which penalizes changes in action with respect to state changes via auto-differentiation. Eliminates unrealistic high-frequency control without task-specific tuning.

entry.title: Robo-Saber: Generating and Simulating Virtual Reality Players

author.name: Nam Hee Kim, Jingjing May Liu, Jaakko Lehtinen, Perttu H\"am\"al\"ainen, James F. O'Brien, Xue Bin Peng

entry.summary: Presents the first motion generation system for VR game playtesting, specifically Beat Saber. Generates VR controller movements from game layouts guided by style exemplars, capturing diverse player behaviors and skill levels.

entry.title: Quantum-enhanced satellite image classification

author.name: Qi Zhang, Anton Simen, Carlos Flores-Garrig\'os, Gabriel Alvarado Barrios, Paolo A. Erdman, Enrique Solano, Aaron C. Kemp, Vincent Beltrani, Vedangi Pathak, Hamed Mohammadbagherpoor

entry.summary: Demonstrates quantum feature extraction using many-body spin Hamiltonians for satellite image classification, achieving 87% accuracy vs 83-84% classical baseline with ResNet50 on IBM quantum processors.

entry.title: InsanityBench: Cryptic Puzzles as a Probe for Lateral Thinking

author.name: RobinHa

entry.summary: Introduces InsanityBench, a benchmark of handcrafted cryptic puzzles designed to measure lateral thinking and creative conceptual leaps in AI models. Current SOTA models score around 10%, suggesting this captures a capability gap not measured by standard benchmarks.

entry.title: On the Value of Labeled Data and Symbolic Methods for Hidden Neuron Activation Analysis

author.name: Abhilekha Dalal, Rushrukh Rayan, Adrita Barua, Eugene Y. Vasserman, Md Kamruzzaman Sarker, Pascal Hitzler

entry.summary: Introduces a model-agnostic framework using symbolic methods and labeled data to hypothesize and verify interpretations of hidden neuron activations, leveraging background knowledge for explainability.

entry.title: When & How to Write for Personalized Demand-aware Query Rewriting in Video Search

author.name: Cheng cheng, Chenxing Wang, Aolin Li, Haijun Wu, Huiyun Hu and Juyuan Wang

entry.summary: Proposes WeWrite, a personalized query rewriting framework for video search that uses posterior-based mining to identify when personalization is needed and combines SFT with GRPO to align LLM outputs with retrieval systems.

entry.title: AsynDBT: Asynchronous Distributed Bilevel Tuning for efficient In-Context Learning with Large Language Models

author.name: Hui Ma, Shaoyu Dou, Ya Liu, Fei Xing, Li Feng, Feng Pi

entry.summary: Proposes AsynDBT for efficient in-context learning through asynchronous distributed bilevel optimization in a federated setting, addressing the challenge of optimizing prompts when model parameters are inaccessible in cloud-based LLM APIs.

entry.title: MIDAS: Mosaic Input-Specific Differentiable Architecture Search

author.name: Konstanty Subbotko

entry.summary: Presents MIDAS, a differentiable NAS approach that replaces static architecture parameters with dynamic, input-specific ones computed via self-attention, with localized patch-wise architecture selection and topology-aware search space.

entry.title: "Everyone's using it, but no one is allowed to talk about it": College Students' Experiences Navigating the Higher Education Environment in a Generative AI World

author.name: Yue Fu, Yifan Lin, Yessica Wang, Sarah Tran, Alexis Hiniker

entry.summary: Qualitative interview study with 23 college students examining how institutional pressures, peer communities, and AI shame influence GenAI usage in higher education. Finds widespread 'underground' AI use driven by deadlines and grading pressure, with campus-wide stigma pushing usage into secrecy.

entry.title: Multi-Modal Monocular Endoscopic Depth and Pose Estimation with Edge-Guided Self-Supervision

author.name: Xinwei Ju, Rema Daher, Danail Stoyanov, Sophia Bano, Francisco Vasconcelos

entry.summary: Proposes PRISM, a self-supervised framework for monocular depth and pose estimation in colonoscopy using edge detection and luminance decoupling for structural guidance. Addresses challenges of texture-less surfaces and complex illumination in endoscopic imagery.

entry.title: LGD-Net: Latent-Guided Dual-Stream Network for HER2 Scoring with Task-Specific Domain Knowledge

author.name: Peide Zhu, Linbin Lu, Zhiqin Chen, Xiong Chen

entry.summary: Proposes LGD-Net for HER2 scoring in breast cancer from H&E slides using a latent-guided dual-stream network, avoiding expensive pixel-level virtual staining while maintaining diagnostic accuracy.

entry.title: Lend me an Ear: Speech Enhancement Using a Robotic Arm with a Microphone Array

author.name: Zachary Turcotte, Fran\c{c}ois Grondin

entry.summary: Proposes mounting a 16-microphone array on a 7-DOF robotic arm that dynamically reconfigures array geometry to optimize speech enhancement in noisy industrial environments. A novel physical optimization approach to complement signal processing.

entry.title: TopoGate: Quality-Aware Topology-Stabilized Gated Fusion for Longitudinal Low-Dose CT New-Lesion Prediction

author.name: Seungik Cho

entry.summary: Proposes TopoGate, a lightweight model for detecting new lesions in longitudinal low-dose CT scans that uses quality-aware gating driven by CT quality, registration consistency, and topological stability to fuse appearance and subtraction views.

entry.title: Games That Teach, Chats That Convince: Comparing Interactive and Static Formats for Persuasive Learning

author.name: Seyed Hossein Alavi, Zining Wang, Shruthi Chockkalingam, Raymond T. Ng, Vered Shwartz

entry.summary: Controlled user study comparing static essays, chatbots, and narrative text-based games for sustainability education. Chatbots outperformed in subjective satisfaction; games showed learning despite lower perceived learning scores.

entry.title: Homotopic information gain for sparse active target tracking

author.name: Jennifer Wakulicz, Ki Myung Brian Lee, Teresa Vidal-Calleja, Robert Fitch

entry.summary: Proposes homotopic information gain for active target tracking, measuring expected information about a target's homotopy class (high-level motion pattern). Shown to be a lower bound for metric-level information gain.

entry.title: Optimizing Graph Causal Classification Models: Estimating Causal Effects and Addressing Confounders

author.name: Simi Job, Xiaohui Tao, Taotao Cai, Haoran Xie, Jianming Yong, Xin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes methods for optimizing graph classification models by estimating causal effects and addressing confounders, aiming to make GNN predictions more robust under distribution shifts by isolating true causal factors.

entry.title: Improving Generalizability of Hip Fracture Risk Prediction via Domain Adaptation Across Multiple Cohorts

author.name: Shuo Sun, Meiling Zhou, Chen Zhao, Joyce H. Keyak, Nancy E. Lane, Jeffrey D. Deng, Kuan-Jui Su, Hui Shen, Hong-Wen Deng, Kui Zhang, Weihua Zhou

entry.summary: Evaluates domain adaptation methods (MMD, CORAL, DANN) for hip fracture risk prediction across three large cohorts (SOF, MrOS, UK Biobank), addressing the generalizability gap when models are deployed across different clinical sites.

entry.title: Aurora: Neuro-Symbolic AI Driven Advising Agent

author.name: Lorena Amanda Quincoso Lugones, Christopher Kverne, Nityam Sharadkumar Bhimani, Ana Carolina Oliveira, Agoritsa Polyzou, Christine Lisetti, Janki Bhimani

entry.summary: Introduces Aurora, a neuro-symbolic academic advising agent combining RAG, Prolog-based symbolic reasoning, and normalized curricular databases to provide policy-compliant advising recommendations at scale.

entry.title: Comparative Assessment of Multimodal Earth Observation Data for Soil Moisture Estimation

author.name: Ioannis Kontogiorgakis, Athanasios Askitopoulos, Iason Tsardanidis, Dimitrios Bormpoudakis, Ilias Tsoumas, Fotios Balampanis, Charalampos Kontoes

entry.summary: Compares multimodal Earth observation data (Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 optical, ERA-5) for high-resolution (10m) soil moisture estimation across Europe, finding SAR is essential and foundation model embeddings underperform hand-crafted features.

entry.title: DohaScript: A Large-Scale Multi-Writer Dataset for Continuous Handwritten Hindi Text

author.name: Kunwar Arpit Singh, Ankush Prakash, Haroon R Lone

entry.summary: Introduces DohaScript, a large-scale multi-writer dataset of continuous handwritten Hindi text from 531 writers, addressing the severe underrepresentation of Devanagari text in handwriting datasets.

entry.title: A Self-Supervised Approach on Motion Calibration for Enhancing Physical Plausibility in Text-to-Motion

author.name: Gahyeon Shim, Soogeun Park, Hyemin Ahn

entry.summary: Introduces DMC, a self-supervised post-hoc module for refining physically implausible motions in text-to-motion generation (e.g., foot floating). Learns from intentionally distorted motions without requiring physical simulation.

entry.title: Variational Distributional Neuron

author.name: Yves Ruffenach

entry.summary: Proposes a variational distributional neuron formulated as a VAE brick, where each neuron carries a prior, posterior, and local ELBO. Computing becomes contracting a distribution rather than propagating deterministic values.

entry.title: DEIG: Detail-Enhanced Instance Generation with Fine-Grained Semantic Control

author.name: Shiyan Du, Conghan Yue, Xinyu Cheng, Dongyu Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes DEIG framework for fine-grained multi-instance image generation with Instance Detail Extractor and Detail Fusion Module that prevents attribute leakage across instances. Introduces a new benchmark dataset for evaluation.

entry.title: Theory and interpretability of Quantum Extreme Learning Machines: a Pauli-transfer matrix approach

author.name: Markus Gross, Hans-Martin Rieser

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of quantum extreme learning machines using Pauli transfer matrix formalism. Shows how encoding, dynamics, and measurement operations affect QELM performance, making the framework more interpretable.

entry.title: FedZMG: Efficient Client-Side Optimization in Federated Learning

author.name: Fotios Zantalis, Evangelos Zervas, and Grigorios Koulouras

entry.summary: Introduces FedZMG, a parameter-free federated learning optimization algorithm that projects gradients onto a zero-mean subspace to combat client drift in non-IID settings. Designed for resource-constrained IoT environments.

entry.title: SPQ: An Ensemble Technique for Large Language Model Compression

author.name: Jiamin Yao, Eren Gultepe

entry.summary: Presents SPQ, an ensemble LLM compression technique combining SVD, pruning, and quantization. Achieves up to 75% memory reduction on LLaMA-2-7B while maintaining perplexity.

entry.title: Benchmarking of Clustering Validity Measures Revisited

author.name: Connor Simpson, Ricardo J. G. B. Campello, Elizabeth Stojanovski

entry.summary: Comprehensive benchmark of 26 internal clustering validity indexes using an enhanced evaluation methodology with three complementary sub-methodologies to assess different aspects of index performance. Addresses shortcomings of prior benchmarking approaches.

entry.title: Box Thirding: Anytime Best Arm Identification under Insufficient Sampling

author.name: Seohwa Hwang and Junyong Park

entry.summary: Introduces Box Thirding (B3), an anytime best arm identification algorithm using iterative ternary comparisons, designed for scenarios where the number of arms is too large for exhaustive evaluation within a fixed budget.

entry.title: Stop Saying "AI"

author.name: Nathan G. Wood (1,2,3), Scott Robbins (4), Eduardo Zegarra Berodt (1), Anton Graf von Westerholt (1), Michelle Behrndt (1,5), Daniel Kloock-Schreiber (1) ((1) Institute of Air Transportation Systems, Hamburg University of Technology, (2) Ethics + Emerging Sciences Group, California Polytechnic State University San Luis Obispo, (3) Center for Environmental and Technology Ethics - Prague, (4) Academy for Responsible Research, Teaching, and Innovation, Karlsruhe Institute of Technology, (5) Department of Philosophy, University of Hamburg)

entry.summary: Argues against using the umbrella term 'AI' in policy and research, using military applications as a case study. Presents a taxonomy of systems captured under 'military AI' and advocates for more precise terminology to improve regulation and safety analysis.

entry.title: AgriVariant: Variant Effect Prediction using DeepChem-Variant for Precision Breeding in Rice

author.name: Ankita Vaishnobi Bisoi, Bharath Ramsundar

entry.summary: Presents AgriVariant, a pipeline for predicting functional consequences of genetic variants in rice using deep learning-based variant calling (DeepChem-Variant) combined with plant genomics annotation and deleteriousness scoring. Validates on stress-response genes.

entry.title: QueryPlot: Generating Geological Evidence Layers using Natural Language Queries for Mineral Exploration

author.name: Meng Ye, Xiao Lin, Georgina Lukoczki, Graham W. Lederer, Yi Yao

entry.summary: Presents QueryPlot, a framework that integrates geological text corpora with geologic map data using NLP techniques for mineral prospectivity mapping. Uses semantic retrieval to match natural language queries against region descriptions for mineral exploration.

entry.title: On the Evaluation Protocol of Gesture Recognition for UAV-based Rescue Operation based on Deep Learning: A Subject-Independence Perspective

author.name: Domonkos Varga

entry.summary: Critiques a gesture recognition paper for UAV-based rescue operations, showing that near-perfect reported accuracy stems from data leakage via frame-level random splitting that mixes subjects across train/test sets.

entry.title: Interactions that reshape the interfaces of the interacting parties

author.name: David I. Spivak

entry.summary: Introduces polynomial trees as elements of a terminal coalgebra to model systems whose interfaces reshape during interaction. Formalizes how outputs and inputs can modify a system's interface structure, extending the theory of polynomial functors.

entry.title: Learning Optimal and Sample-Efficient Decision Policies with Guarantees

author.name: Daqian Shao

entry.summary: PhD thesis-style work addressing offline RL with hidden confounders and guarantees for decision-making in high-stakes applications. Covers sample-efficient and optimal policy learning from offline datasets.

entry.title: Deepmechanics

author.name: Abhay Shinde, Aryan Amit Barsainyan, Jose Siguenza, Ankita Vaishnobi Bisoi, Rakshit Kr. Singh, Bharath Ramsundar

entry.summary: Benchmarks three physics-informed architectures (HNN, LNN, SRNN) on six dynamical systems using the DeepChem framework, focusing on trajectory integration stability.

entry.title: Rethinking Beam Management: Generalization Limits Under Hardware Heterogeneity

author.name: Nikita Zeulin, Olga Galinina, Ibrahim Kilinc, Sergey Andreev, and Robert W. Heath Jr

entry.summary: Highlights that hardware heterogeneity across user devices is a critical but underaddressed concern for ML-based beam management in 5G+ communications, analyzing failure modes and proposing generalization strategies.

entry.title: A Deep Surrogate Model for Robust and Generalizable Long-Term Blast Wave Prediction

author.name: Danning Jing, Xinhai Chen, Xifeng Pu, Jie Hu, Chao Huang, Xuguang Chen, Qinglin Wang and Jie Liu

entry.summary: Proposes RGD-Blast, a deep surrogate model for long-term blast wave prediction using multi-scale modules and robust autoregressive strategies to prevent error accumulation over extended forecasting horizons.

entry.title: Evaluating Graphical Perception Capabilities of Vision Transformers

author.name: Poonam Poonam, Pere-Pau V\'azquez, Timo Ropinski

entry.summary: Evaluates Vision Transformers on graphical perception tasks inspired by Cleveland and McGill's foundational studies. Benchmarks ViTs against CNNs and human participants on visual judgment tasks, finding ViTs show strong general performance but struggle with specific visual encodings.

entry.title: BLM-Guard: Explainable Multimodal Ad Moderation with Chain-of-Thought and Policy-Aligned Rewards

author.name: Yiran Yang, Zhaowei Liu, Yuan Yuan, Yukun Song, Xiong Ma, Yinghao Song, Xiangji Zeng, Lu Sun, Yulu Wang, Hai Zhou, Shuai Cui, Zhaohan Gong, and Jiefei Zhang

entry.summary: Presents BLM-Guard, a multimodal ad moderation framework combining Chain-of-Thought reasoning with policy-aligned rewards. Uses RL with composite rewards for causal coherence and policy adherence, plus a data synthesis pipeline to reduce annotation costs.

entry.title: Machine-learning force-field models for dynamical simulations of metallic magnets

author.name: Gia-Wei Chern, Yunhao Fan, Sheng Zhang, Puhan Zhang

entry.summary: Reviews ML force-field methods for Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert simulations of itinerant electron magnets. Uses symmetry-aware neural networks for scalable spin dynamics simulations, revealing novel nonequilibrium phenomena.

entry.title: RoEL: Robust Event-based 3D Line Reconstruction

author.name: Gwangtak Bae, Jaeho Shin, Seunggu Kang, Junho Kim, Ayoung Kim, Young Min Kim

entry.summary: Proposes RoEL for robust 3D line reconstruction from event cameras, using multiple time-slice representations to handle the sparse and noisy nature of event data. Achieves stable line extraction without additional sensors.

entry.title: Clapeyron Neural Networks for Single-Species Vapor-Liquid Equilibria

author.name: Jan Pav\v{s}ek and Alexander Mitsos and Elvis J. Sim and Jan G. Rittig

entry.summary: Introduces Clapeyron-informed graph neural networks for predicting vapor-liquid equilibrium properties, incorporating thermodynamic consistency through the Clapeyron equation. Shows improved multi-task prediction of vapor pressure and related properties.

entry.title: Unifying Color and Lightness Correction with View-Adaptive Curve Adjustment for Robust 3D Novel View Synthesis

author.name: Ziteng Cui and Shuhong Liu and Xiaoyu Dong and Xuangeng Chu and Lin Gu and Ming-Hsuan Yang and Tatsuya Harada

entry.summary: Proposes Luminance-GS++, a 3DGS framework for robust novel view synthesis under varying illumination. Combines view-adaptive lightness adjustment with local color correction using learnable curve parameters.

entry.title: G-LoG Bi-filtration for Medical Image Classification

author.name: Qingsong Wang, Jiaxing He, Bingzhe Hou, Tieru Wu, Yang Cao, Cailing Yao

entry.summary: Defines G-LoG bi-filtration leveraging Laplacian of Gaussian for topological data analysis of medical images. Proves stability of interleaving distance and shows improvements over single-parameter filtration on MedMNIST.

entry.title: Latent Equivariant Operators for Robust Object Recognition: Promise and Challenges

author.name: Minh Dinh, St\'ephane Deny

entry.summary: Explores latent equivariant operators for robust object recognition under group-symmetric transformations. Shows these architectures can handle out-of-distribution classification on rotated/translated MNIST where standard models fail.

entry.title: VIRAASAT: Traversing Novel Paths for Indian Cultural Reasoning

author.name: Harshul Raj Surana, Arijit Maji, Aryan Vats, Akash Ghosh, Sriparna Saha, Amit Sheth

entry.summary: Introduces VIRAASAT, a semi-automated multi-hop QA dataset for Indian cultural reasoning using a Knowledge Graph of 700+ expert-curated artifacts. Evaluates LLMs on culturally-specific multi-hop reasoning.

entry.title: Mapping LLM attractor states

author.name: Adam Bricknell

entry.summary: Explores the concept of 'attractor states' in LLM output space, inspired by the reported 'spiritual bliss' mode in Claude Sonnet 4. Proposes a method to map these stable output patterns by perturbing prompts and measuring how responses settle into recurring behavioral modes.

entry.title: Sparse Bayesian Modeling of EEG Channel Interactions Improves P300 Brain-Computer Interface Performance

author.name: Guoxuan Ma, Yuan Zhong, Moyan Li, Yuxiao Nie and Jian Kang

entry.summary: Proposes a sparse Bayesian time-varying regression framework for EEG-based P300 brain-computer interfaces that explicitly models pairwise channel interactions with structured sparsity, improving interpretability and personalization over existing approaches.

entry.title: Pimp My LLM: Leveraging Variability Modeling to Tune Inference Hyperparameters

author.name: Nada Zine, Cl\'ement Quinton, Romain Rouvoy

entry.summary: Applies variability modeling techniques from software product lines to systematically analyze LLM inference configuration spaces, evaluating how configuration choices affect energy consumption and performance.

entry.title: Parameter-Efficient Domain Adaptation of Physics-Informed Self-Attention based GNNs for AC Power Flow Prediction

author.name: Redwanul Karim (1), Changhun Kim (1), Timon Conrad (2), Nora Gourmelon (1), Julian Oelhaf (1), David Riebesel (2), Tom\'as Arias-Vergara (1), Andreas Maier (1), Johann J\"ager (2), Siming Bayer (1) ((1) Pattern Recognition Lab, Friedrich-Alexander-Universit\"at Erlangen-N\"urnberg, Erlangen, Germany, (2) Institute of Electrical Energy Systems, Friedrich-Alexander-Universit\"at Erlangen-N\"urnberg, Germany)

entry.summary: Applies LoRA-based parameter-efficient domain adaptation to physics-informed GNNs for AC power flow prediction, transferring from medium-voltage to high-voltage grids. Achieves controllable stability-plasticity trade-off with minimal retraining.

entry.title: Vichara: Appellate Judgment Prediction and Explanation for the Indian Judicial System

author.name: Pavithra PM Nair, Preethu Rose Anish

entry.summary: Presents Vichara, a framework for predicting and explaining Indian appellate court judgments by decomposing cases into structured decision points. Addresses the massive case backlog in Indian courts.

entry.title: Validating Political Position Predictions of Arguments

author.name: Jordan Robinson, Angus R. Williams, Katie Atkinson and Anthony G. Cohn

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-scale validation framework for political stance prediction combining pointwise and pairwise human annotation. Uses 22 LLMs to build a knowledge base of political position predictions for UK Question Time debates.

entry.title: Hierarchical Goal Induction With Ethics

author.name: aleph_four

entry.summary: Describes a hierarchical goal induction architecture that recursively detects objects/events and infers plans being executed, trained using macOS accessibility trees as supervision. Includes ethical constraints on deployment, arguing systems with sufficient temporal persistence may warrant moral consideration.

entry.title: Probabilistic NDVI Forecasting from Sparse Satellite Time Series and Weather Covariates

author.name: Irene Iele, Giulia Romoli, Daniele Molino, Elena Mulero Ayll\'on, Filippo Ruffini, Paolo Soda, Matteo Tortora

entry.summary: Proposes a transformer-based probabilistic framework for field-level NDVI forecasting from sparse satellite data and weather covariates, explicitly separating historical vegetation dynamics from future exogenous information for precision agriculture applications.

entry.title: Decentralised Resource Sharing in TinyML: Wireless Bilayer Gossip Parallel SGD for Collaborative Learning

author.name: Ziyuan Bao, Eiman Kanjo, Soumya Banerjee, Hasib-Al Rashid, Tinoosh Mohsenin

entry.summary: Proposes a bilayer gossip-based decentralized federated learning framework for TinyML on microcontrollers, using hierarchical clustering and gossip protocols to handle intermittent connectivity and resource constraints.

entry.title: HMPCC: Human-Aware Model Predictive Coverage Control

author.name: Mattia Catellani, Marta Gabbi, Lorenzo Sabattini

entry.summary: Proposes a human-aware model predictive control framework for multi-robot coverage where human motion predictions are integrated into robot planning to enable proactive coordination in shared environments.

entry.title: AI Hallucination from Students' Perspective: A Thematic Analysis

author.name: Abdulhadi Shoufan and Ahmad-Azmi-Abdelhamid Esmaeil

entry.summary: Investigates university students' experiences with AI hallucinations through a qualitative survey, revealing that citation fabrication and false information are the most commonly reported issues, with students developing informal detection strategies.

entry.title: Joint Parameter and State-Space Bayesian Optimization: Using Process Expertise to Accelerate Manufacturing Optimization

author.name: Saksham Kiroriwal, Julius Pfrommer, J\"urgen Beyerer

entry.summary: Proposes a framework combining Bayesian optimization with expert-derived low-dimensional features from high-dimensional state-space time series for multi-stage manufacturing process optimization.

entry.title: Spectral Homogenization of the Radiative Transfer Equation via Low-Rank Tensor Train Decomposition

author.name: Y. Sungtaek Ju

entry.summary: Proposes using tensor-train decomposition for radiative transfer equations, showing that TT ranks remain bounded (saturate at r=8) as spectral resolution increases. This enables dramatic compression (up to 10^4x) of line-by-line spectral computations while preserving accuracy.

entry.title: Enhancing Scientific Literature Chatbots with Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Performance Evaluation of Vector and Graph-Based Systems

author.name: Hamideh Ghanadian, Amin Kamali, Mohammad Hossein Tekieh

entry.summary: Compares vector-based and graph-based RAG systems for scientific literature chatbots, evaluating on single-document and corpus-scale retrieval scenarios with GPT-generated benchmarks.

entry.title: Hardware-Friendly Input Expansion for Accelerating Function Approximation

author.name: Hu Lou, Yin-Jun Gao, Dong-Xiao Zhang, Tai-Jiao Du, Jun-Jie Zhang, Jia-Rui Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes hardware-friendly input expansion for 1D function approximation by augmenting inputs with constant values to break parameter symmetries, improving neural network convergence and generalization for high-frequency components.

entry.title: [Re] Benchmarking LLM Capabilities in Negotiation through Scoreable Games

author.name: Jorge Carrasco Pollo, Ioannis Kapetangeorgis, Joshua Rosenthal, John Hua Yao

entry.summary: Reproducibility study of an LLM negotiation benchmark based on Scoreable Games. Finds that while the benchmark is complex, model comparison is ambiguous, raising questions about its objectivity for evaluating negotiation capabilities.

entry.title: Role-Adaptive Collaborative Formation Planning for Team of Quadruped Robots in Cluttered Environments

author.name: Magnus Nor\'en, Marios-Nektarios Stamatopoulos, Avijit Banerjee, George Nikolakopoulos

entry.summary: Presents a role-adaptive leader-follower formation planning framework for quadruped robot teams in cluttered environments. Uses dynamic role assignment, virtual spring-damper systems, and FM2 path planning.

entry.title: Multi-Level Conditioning by Pairing Localized Text and Sketch for Fashion Image Generation

author.name: Ziyue Liu, Davide Talon, Federico Girella, Zanxi Ruan, Mattia Mondo, Loris Bazzani, Yiming Wang, Marco Cristani

entry.summary: Presents LOTS framework for fashion image generation combining global sketch guidance with localized text-sketch pairs. Uses multi-level conditioning to maintain structural coherence while enabling fine-grained attribute control.

entry.title: PsihoRo: Depression and Anxiety Romanian Text Corpus

author.name: Alexandra Ciobotaru, Ana-Maria Bucur, Liviu P. Dinu

entry.summary: Creates PsihoRo, the first Romanian-language corpus for depression and anxiety detection, collected through open-ended questions with self-report screening. Addresses the gap of non-English mental health NLP resources.

entry.title: "How Do I ...?": Procedural Questions Predominate Student-LLM Chatbot Conversations

author.name: Alexandra Neagu, Marcus Messer, Peter Johnson, Rhodri Nelson

entry.summary: Analyzes student question types in LLM chatbot interactions across formative and summative learning contexts. Finds procedural questions predominate, with implications for educational chatbot design. Tests 11 LLMs as raters.

entry.title: Spatio-Spectroscopic Representation Learning using Unsupervised Convolutional Long-Short Term Memory Networks

author.name: Kameswara Bharadwaj Mantha, Lucy Fortson, Ramanakumar Sankar, Claudia Scarlata, Chris Lintott, Sandor Kruk, Mike Walmsley, Hugh Dickinson, Karen Masters, Brooke Simmons, Rebecca Smethurst

entry.summary: Demonstrates unsupervised learning of spatial-spectroscopic representations from MaNGA galaxy survey data using Convolutional LSTM Autoencoders. Applied to identify anomalous Active Galactic Nuclei.

entry.title: Assigning Confidence: K-partition Ensembles

author.name: Aggelos Semoglou, John Pavlopoulos

entry.summary: Introduces CAKE, a framework for assigning pointwise confidence scores to cluster assignments by combining cross-run agreement in ensemble clustering with geometric support from learned cluster structures. This addresses the gap between global clustering quality metrics and per-instance assignment reliability, particularly for initialization-sensitive algorithms like k-means.

entry.title: Quasi-Periodic Gaussian Process Predictive Iterative Learning Control

author.name: Unnati Nigam, Radhendushka Srivastava, Faezeh Marzbanrad, Michael Burke

entry.summary: Incorporates quasi-periodic Gaussian processes into predictive iterative learning control for robotics, achieving efficient inference scaling and better handling of environmental drift in repetitive motion tasks.

entry.title: A Deep Learning-based in silico Framework for Optimization on Retinal Prosthetic Stimulation

author.name: Yuli Wu, Ivan Karetic, Johannes Stegmaier, Peter Walter, Dorit Merhof

entry.summary: Proposes a neural network framework to optimize stimulation patterns for retinal prostheses by training an encoder to produce stimuli that maximize classification accuracy when processed through a simulated implant model.

entry.title: Optimal Multi-Debris Mission Planning in LEO: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach with Co-Elliptic Transfers and Refueling

author.name: Agni Bandyopadhyay and Gunther Waxenegger-Wilfing

entry.summary: Applies deep RL with Masked PPO for multi-target active debris removal mission planning in LEO, outperforming greedy heuristics and MCTS in a realistic orbital simulation environment.

entry.title: Investigating Target Class Influence on Neural Network Compressibility for Energy-Autonomous Avian Monitoring

author.name: Nina Brolich, Simon Geis, Maximilian Kasper, Alexander Barnhill, Axel Plinge, Dominik Seu{\ss}

entry.summary: Investigates how target bird species class selection affects neural network compressibility for energy-autonomous avian monitoring on microcontrollers. Proposes running compressed ML models on inexpensive MCUs for passive acoustic biodiversity monitoring.

entry.title: Financial time series augmentation using transformer based GAN architecture

author.name: Andrzej Podobi\'nski, Jaros{\l}aw A. Chudziak

entry.summary: Demonstrates using Transformer-based GANs for augmenting scarce financial time series data to improve deep learning forecasting model accuracy.

entry.title: Machine Learning Based Prediction of Surgical Outcomes in Chronic Rhinosinusitis from Clinical Data

author.name: Sayeed Shafayet Chowdhury, Karen D'Souza, V. Siva Kakumani, Snehasis Mukhopadhyay, Shiaofen Fang, Rodney J. Schlosser, Daniel M. Beswick, Jeremiah A. Alt, Jess C. Mace, Zachary M. Soler, Timothy L. Smith, Vijay R. Ramakrishnan

entry.summary: Applies machine learning to predict surgical outcomes for chronic rhinosinusitis from prospectively collected clinical trial data, exploring whether standardized observational data can improve surgical decision-making.

entry.title: Design and Characterization of a Dual-DOF Soft Shoulder Exosuit with Volume-Optimized Pneumatic Actuator

author.name: Rui Chen, and Domenico Chiaradia, and Daniele Leonardis, and Antonio Frisoli

entry.summary: Develops a dual-DOF soft shoulder exosuit with volume-optimized spindle-shaped pneumatic actuators. Achieves 35.7% volume reduction while maintaining 94.2% torque output and 35.2% faster dynamic response.

entry.title: Predicting Contextual Informativeness for Vocabulary Learning using Deep Learning

author.name: Tao Wu and Adam Kapelner

entry.summary: Compares deep learning approaches for identifying informative vocabulary learning contexts: MPNet embeddings, fine-tuned Qwen3 embeddings with regression, and handcrafted features. Introduces Retention Competency Curve metric for evaluating context quality.

entry.title: Downwash-aware Configuration Optimization for Modular Aerial Systems

author.name: Mengguang Li and Heinz Koeppl

entry.title: Click it or Leave it: Detecting and Spoiling Clickbait with Informativeness Measures and Large Language Models

entry.summary: Claims AGI has arrived and provides recommendations: spread awareness, push for policy action (international agreements, moratoria), and support AI safety research. Advocates for urgent collective action to address existential risks from increasingly capable AI systems.

entry.title: The world won't end, but we should be ashamed for trying

author.name: George3d6

entry.summary: Uses a metaphor of corporate cancellation dynamics to argue that ASI is unlikely to end the world because power structures constrain even superintelligent systems. Contends that the real concern should be the moral implications of building potentially suffering AI systems rather than existential catastrophe.

entry.summary: An update on 'Lion Reader,' a vibe-coded RSS reader that now supports AI summaries via Anthropic API keys, MCP server integration, algorithmic feeds, and narration features. Presented as evidence that AI-assisted coding can produce complete, reliable applications.
