entry.summary: Improves black-box adversarial attacks on large vision-language models by identifying that local crop-level matching causes high-variance gradients due to ViT translation sensitivity. Proposes gradient-denoising approach with asymmetric expectation formulation.

entry.title: Action-Graph Policies: Learning Action Co-dependencies in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Nikunj Gupta, James Zachary Hare, Jesse Milzman, Rajgopal Kannan, Viktor Prasanna

entry.summary: Proposes Action Graph Policies (AGP) for multi-agent RL that models dependencies among agents' action choices, enabling coordination contexts for decentralized decision-making with provably more expressive joint policies than independent policies.

entry.title: CounterFlowNet: From Minimal Changes to Meaningful Counterfactual Explanations

author.name: Oleksii Furman, Patryk Marsza{\l}ek, Jan Mas{\l}owski, Piotr Gai\'nski, Maciej Zi\k{e}ba, Marek \'Smieja

entry.summary: Proposes CounterFlowNet, using conditional GFlowNets for counterfactual explanation generation that sequentially modifies features while respecting user constraints, producing sparse and valid explanations for tabular data.

entry.title: The Sound of Death: Deep Learning Reveals Vascular Damage from Carotid Ultrasound

author.name: Christoph Balada, Aida Romano-Martinez, Payal Varshney, Vincent ten Cate, Katharina Geschke, Jonas Tesarz, Paul Cla{\ss}en, Alexander K. Schuster, Dativa Tibyampansha, Karl-Patrik Kresoja, Philipp S. Wild, Sheraz Ahmed, Andreas Dengel

entry.summary: Develops ML framework extracting vascular damage representations from carotid ultrasound videos using hypertension as a weak proxy label, with learned features strongly associated with cardiovascular risk factors and mortality outcomes.

entry.title: Shortcut learning in geometric knot classification

author.name: Djordje Mihajlovic, Davide Michieletto

entry.summary: Investigates how ML models exploit hidden non-topological shortcuts in knot classification training data generated by molecular dynamics simulations, rather than learning true topological features.

entry.title: Asymptotic Smoothing of the Lipschitz Loss Landscape in Overparameterized One-Hidden-Layer ReLU Networks

author.name: Saveliy Baturin

entry.summary: Proves that in overparameterized one-hidden-layer ReLU networks with convex Lipschitz losses, the loss landscape becomes increasingly connected and flat as width grows. Provides both theoretical bounds and empirical validation showing energy gaps between local and global minima vanish asymptotically.

entry.title: Characterizing the Predictive Impact of Modalities with Supervised Latent-Variable Modeling

author.name: Divyam Madaan, Sumit Chopra, Kyunghyun Cho

entry.summary: Introduces PRIMO, a supervised latent-variable model that quantifies the predictive impact of missing modalities in multimodal learning, enabling training with incomplete modality data through imputation.

entry.title: Quantifying and Mitigating Socially Desirable Responding in LLMs: A Desirability-Matched Graded Forced-Choice Psychometric Study

author.name: Kensuke Okada, Yui Furukawa, Kyosuke Bunji

entry.summary: Proposes a psychometric framework to detect and mitigate socially desirable responding (SDR) in LLMs when evaluated via questionnaires, using item response theory and desirability-matched forced-choice instruments.

entry.title: PartRAG: Retrieval-Augmented Part-Level 3D Generation and Editing

author.name: Peize Li, Zeyu Zhang, Hao Tang

entry.summary: Introduces PartRAG, a retrieval-augmented framework for part-level 3D generation and editing from single images. Uses hierarchical contrastive retrieval to align image patches with 3D part latents and a Part-Aware Injection module for localized edits.

entry.title: RetouchIQ: MLLM Agents for Instruction-Based Image Retouching with Generalist Reward

author.name: Qiucheng Wu, Jing Shi, Simon Jenni, Kushal Kafle, Tianyu Wang, Shiyu Chang, Handong Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces RetouchIQ, a framework using MLLM agents for instruction-based image retouching with professional editing tools. Uses reinforcement learning with a generalist reward model to handle the subjective nature of creative editing.

entry.title: Sound of Touch: Active Acoustic Tactile Sensing via String Vibrations

author.name: Xili Yi, Ying Xing, Zachary Manchester, Nima Fazeli

entry.summary: Presents Sound of Touch, an active acoustic tactile sensing approach using vibrating tensioned strings as sensing elements. Contact microphones detect spectral changes to estimate contact location, force, and slip from short audio signals.

entry.title: SparTa: Sparse Graphical Task Models from a Handful of Demonstrations

author.name: Adrian R\"ofer, Nick Heppert, Abhinav Valada

entry.summary: Proposes SparTa for learning long-horizon manipulation tasks from few demonstrations by representing scene states as manipulation graphs. Extracts complete object interactions across task phases rather than partial or short-window interactions.

entry.title: M-estimation under Two-Phase Multiwave Sampling with Applications to Prediction-Powered Inference

author.name: Dan M. Kluger, Stephen Bates

entry.summary: Provides valid estimators and confidence intervals for M-estimation under adaptive two-phase multiwave sampling, with a Multiwave Predict-Then-Debias estimator that leverages ML model predictions as proxies for efficient inference.

entry.title: Be skeptical of milestone announcements by young AI startups

author.name: lc

entry.summary: A critical analysis of XBOW's claim nearly a year ago to have achieved 'rank one' on HackerOne's bug bounty leaderboard using AI. The author argues that despite massive model improvements since then (o3, GPT-5 through 5.3), AI has not come to dominate bug bounty platforms, suggesting the original milestone was overhyped.

entry.title: Dynamic System Instructions and Tool Exposure for Efficient Agentic LLMs

author.name: Uria Franko

entry.summary: Proposes Instruction-Tool Retrieval (ITR), a RAG variant that dynamically retrieves only relevant system prompt fragments and tools per step, reducing context tokens by 95% and improving tool routing by 32% for LLM agents.

entry.title: HiMAP: History-aware Map-occupancy Prediction with Fallback

author.name: Yiming Xu, Yi Yang, Hao Cheng, Monika Sester

entry.summary: Presents HiMAP, a tracking-free trajectory prediction framework for autonomous driving that converts past detections into spatiotemporally invariant historical occupancy maps. Remains reliable when multi-object tracking fails due to occlusion or identity switches.

entry.title: SourceBench: Can AI Answers Reference Quality Web Sources?

author.name: Hexi Jin, Stephen Liu, Yuheng Li, Simran Malik, Yiying Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces SourceBench, a benchmark for evaluating the quality of web sources cited by LLMs across 100 real-world queries using an eight-metric framework covering content quality and page-level signals. Evaluates 8 LLMs and AI search tools over 3,996 cited sources.

entry.title: Continual learning and refinement of causal models through dynamic predicate invention

author.name: Enrique Crespo-Fernandez, Oliver Ray, Telmo de Menezes e Silva Filho, Peter Flach

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for building symbolic causal world models online using Meta-Interpretive Learning and predicate invention, enabling agents to discover reusable abstractions and scale to domains with complex relational dynamics.

entry.title: Web Verbs: Typed Abstractions for Reliable Task Composition on the Agentic Web

author.name: Linxi Jiang, Rui Xi, Zhijie Liu, Shuo Chen, Zhiqiang Lin, Suman Nath

entry.summary: Proposes Web Verbs, typed semantic abstractions for web actions that provide a uniform interface for agentic web interactions, complementing content-oriented efforts like NLWeb with an action layer.

entry.title: MedClarify: An information-seeking AI agent for medical diagnosis with case-specific follow-up questions

author.name: Hui Min Wong, Philip Heesen, Pascal Janetzky, Martin Bendszus, Stefan Feuerriegel

entry.summary: Introduces MedClarify, an AI agent for medical diagnosis that generates case-specific follow-up questions to reason over differential diagnoses and exclude emergencies, mimicking clinical history-taking.

entry.title: Evaluating Chain-of-Thought Reasoning through Reusability and Verifiability

author.name: Shashank Aggarwal, Ram Vikas Mishra, Amit Awekar

entry.summary: Introduces reusability and verifiability as novel measures for evaluating Chain-of-Thought reasoning quality in multi-agent IR pipelines, using a Thinker-Executor framework to decouple CoT generation from execution.

entry.title: Can Adversarial Code Comments Fool AI Security Reviewers -- Large-Scale Empirical Study of Comment-Based Attacks and Defenses Against LLM Code Analysis

author.name: Scott Thornton

entry.summary: Tests whether adversarial code comments can fool LLM security reviewers, finding that across 9,366 trials with eight frontier models, adversarial comments produce small, statistically non-significant effects on vulnerability detection.

entry.title: AI-Mediated Feedback Improves Student Revisions: A Randomized Trial with FeedbackWriter in a Large Undergraduate Course

author.name: Xinyi Lu, Kexin Phyllis Ju, Mitchell Dudley, Larissa Sano, Xu Wang

entry.summary: Presents a randomized controlled trial (N=354) evaluating FeedbackWriter, a system providing AI suggestions to teaching assistants for student essay feedback. Students receiving AI-mediated feedback showed improved revision quality.

entry.title: AdaptOrch: Task-Adaptive Multi-Agent Orchestration in the Era of LLM Performance Convergence

author.name: Geunbin Yu

entry.summary: AdaptOrch proposes a framework for task-adaptive multi-agent orchestration that dynamically selects among four canonical topologies (parallel, sequential, hierarchical, hybrid) based on task characteristics, arguing topology matters more than individual model capability.

entry.title: 3D Scene Rendering with Multimodal Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Chi-Shiang Gau, Konstantinos D. Polyzos, Athanasios Bacharis, Saketh Madhuvarasu, Tara Javidi

entry.summary: Proposes multimodal Gaussian Splatting that integrates non-visual sensor data to improve 3D scene reconstruction in challenging conditions like adverse weather or low illumination.

entry.title: SpectralGCD: Spectral Concept Selection and Cross-modal Representation Learning for Generalized Category Discovery

author.name: Lorenzo Caselli, Marco Mistretta, Simone Magistri, Andrew D. Bagdanov

entry.summary: SpectralGCD proposes using CLIP cross-modal image-concept similarities as a unified representation for Generalized Category Discovery, expressing images as mixtures over semantic concepts for efficient and effective multimodal GCD.

entry.title: Learning with Boolean threshold functions

author.name: Veit Elser, Manish Krishan Lal

entry.summary: Develops a method for training neural networks on Boolean data where all node values are strictly ±1, replacing loss minimization with nonconvex constraint formulation using Boolean threshold functions and divide-and-concur decomposition.

entry.title: Conditional Flow Matching for Continuous Anomaly Detection in Autonomous Driving on a Manifold-Aware Spectral Space

author.name: Antonio Guillen-Perez

entry.summary: Presents Deep-Flow, an unsupervised anomaly detection framework for autonomous driving that uses Optimal Transport Conditional Flow Matching on a PCA-constrained spectral manifold to model expert driving behavior and detect safety-critical deviations.

entry.title: What is the Value of Censored Data? An Exact Analysis for the Data-driven Newsvendor

author.name: Rachitesh Kumar, Omar Mouchtaki

entry.summary: Provides exact worst-case regret analysis for data-driven newsvendor with censored demand data. Reduces the infinite-dimensional optimization to finite-dimensional, enabling exact characterization for any sample size.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Lipschitz Bandits

author.name: Sourav Chakraborty, Amit Kiran Rege, Claire Monteleoni, Lijun Chen

entry.summary: Studies decentralized multi-player Lipschitz bandits with collision avoidance. Proposes a communication-free protocol achieving near-optimal regret matching the single-player rate plus T-independent coordination cost.

entry.title: Synergizing Transport-Based Generative Models and Latent Geometry for Stochastic Closure Modeling

author.name: Xinghao Dong, Huchen Yang, Jin-long Wu

entry.summary: Shows flow matching in lower-dimensional latent space enables single-step sampling for stochastic closure models, achieving up to 100x speedup over iterative diffusion approaches for 2D Kolmogorov flows.

entry.title: Online Learning with Improving Agents: Multiclass, Budgeted Agents and Bandit Learners

author.name: Sajad Ashkezari, Shai Ben-David

entry.summary: Extends online learning theory to the setting where agents can improve their features to get better labels. Provides combinatorial dimensions characterizing learnability for multiclass, bandit, and budgeted settings.

entry.title: MDP Planning as Policy Inference

author.name: David Tolpin

entry.summary: Casts MDP planning as Bayesian inference over policies, adapting variational sequential Monte Carlo for deterministic policies under stochastic dynamics with state-consistency enforcement.

entry.title: Poisson-MNL Bandit: Nearly Optimal Dynamic Joint Assortment and Pricing with Decision-Dependent Customer Arrivals

author.name: Junhui Cai, Ran Chen, Qitao Huang, Linda Zhao, Wu Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces a Poisson-MNL model for dynamic joint assortment and pricing where customer arrivals depend on the offered products and prices, with a UCB-based algorithm achieving near-optimal regret bounds.

entry.title: The Emergence of Lab-Driven Alignment Signatures: A Psychometric Framework for Auditing Latent Bias and Compounding Risk in Generative AI

author.name: Dusan Bosnjakovic

entry.summary: Proposes a psychometric auditing framework using latent trait estimation to detect durable behavioral signatures ('prevailing mindsets') embedded in LLMs during training, focusing on provider-level patterns that persist across model versions.

entry.title: What Language is This? Ask Your Tokenizer

author.name: Clara Meister, Ahmetcan Yavuz, Pietro Lesci, Tiago Pimentel

entry.summary: Introduces UniLID, a language identification method based on the UnigramLM tokenization algorithm that treats segmentation as language-specific, achieving strong performance especially on low-resource and closely related languages.

entry.title: DAVE: A Policy-Enforcing LLM Spokesperson for Secure Multi-Document Data Sharing

author.name: Ren\'e Brinkhege, Prahlad Menon

entry.summary: Presents DAVE, an LLM-based system that answers questions over private documents while enforcing machine-readable usage policies, enabling fine-grained data sharing without manual redaction.

entry.title: SemCovNet: Towards Fair and Semantic Coverage-Aware Learning for Underrepresented Visual Concepts

author.name: Sakib Ahammed, Xia Cui, Xinqi Fan, Wenqi Lu, Moi Hoon Yap

entry.summary: Introduces SemCovNet, addressing a new concept called Semantic Coverage Imbalance (SCI) where semantic attributes (not just classes) have long-tailed distributions, with modules to learn and correct semantic coverage disparities.

entry.title: GASS: Geometry-Aware Spherical Sampling for Disentangled Diversity Enhancement in Text-to-Image Generation

author.name: Ye Zhu, Kaleb S. Newman, Johannes F. Lutzeyer, Adriana Romero-Soriano, Michal Drozdzal, Olga Russakovsky

entry.summary: Introduces GASS, a geometry-aware spherical sampling method to enhance diversity in text-to-image generation. Decomposes diversity in CLIP embeddings along orthogonal directions (prompt-dependent semantic variation vs. prompt-independent visual variation).

entry.title: OpenEarthAgent: A Unified Framework for Tool-Augmented Geospatial Agents

author.name: Akashah Shabbir, Muhammad Umer Sheikh, Muhammad Akhtar Munir, Hiyam Debary, Mustansar Fiaz, Muhammad Zaigham Zaheer, Paolo Fraccaro, Fahad Shahbaz Khan, Muhammad Haris Khan, Xiao Xiang Zhu, Salman Khan

entry.summary: Introduces OpenEarthAgent, a unified framework for tool-augmented geospatial agents trained on satellite imagery with structured reasoning traces. Uses supervised fine-tuning over multi-step tool interactions for remote sensing analytical tasks.

entry.title: Benchmarking the Effects of Object Pose Estimation and Reconstruction on Robotic Grasping Success

author.name: Varun Burde, Pavel Burget, Torsten Sattler

entry.summary: Introduces a large-scale physics-based benchmark evaluating how 3D reconstruction quality and 6D pose estimation accuracy affect downstream robotic grasping success. Reveals that standard geometric evaluation metrics don't reflect functional manipulation performance.

entry.title: Boreas Road Trip: A Multi-Sensor Autonomous Driving Dataset on Challenging Roads

author.name: Daniil Lisus, Katya M. Papais, Cedric Le Gentil, Elliot Preston-Krebs, Andrew Lambert, Keith Y. K. Leung, Timothy D. Barfoot

entry.summary: Presents Boreas Road Trip, a multi-sensor autonomous driving dataset with 60 sequences across 9 routes (643km), featuring camera, radar, LiDAR (including FMCW Doppler), and IMU data with centimeter-level ground truth.

entry.title: AI Researchers and Executives Continue to Underestimate the Near-Future Risks of Open Models

author.name: Andrew Dickson

entry.summary: Argues that AI researchers and executives, including Dario Amodei, systematically underestimate the near-future risks of open-source AI models. Critiques the absence of open model risk discussion in Amodei's recent essay and calls for proactive exploration of alternatives to regulation.

entry.title: AI #156 Part 1: They Do Mean The Effect On Jobs

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Zvi's weekly AI newsletter focuses on projections of AI's impact on jobs and the economy, timelines for transformative AI, and associated existential risks. It also flags the Pentagon-Anthropic dispute over military AI use, plus recent model releases including Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini DeepThink V2, and Grok 4.20.

entry.title: How AI Coding Agents Communicate: A Study of Pull Request Description Characteristics and Human Review Responses

author.name: Kan Watanabe, Rikuto Tsuchida, Takahiro Monno, Bin Huang, Kazuma Yamasaki, Youmei Fan, Kazumasa Shimari, Kenichi Matsumoto

entry.summary: Conducts an empirical analysis of pull requests created by five AI coding agents, examining PR description styles and human reviewer responses in terms of review activity, timing, sentiment, and merge outcomes.

entry.title: Contextuality from Single-State Representations: An Information-Theoretic Principle for Adaptive Intelligence

author.name: Song-Ju Kim

entry.summary: Shows that contextuality (previously associated with quantum mechanics) is an inevitable consequence of single-state reuse in classical probabilistic representations, with implications for adaptive intelligence. Proves an irreducible information-theoretic cost for classical models reproducing contextual statistics.

entry.title: Sonar-TS: Search-Then-Verify Natural Language Querying for Time Series Databases

author.name: Zhao Tan, Yiji Zhao, Shiyu Wang, Chang Xu, Yuxuan Liang, Xiping Liu, Shirui Pan, Ming Jin

entry.summary: Proposes Sonar-TS, a neuro-symbolic framework for natural language querying of time series databases using a Search-Then-Verify pipeline that combines SQL for candidate retrieval with Python programs for verification.

entry.title: Mechanistic Interpretability of Cognitive Complexity in LLMs via Linear Probing using Bloom's Taxonomy

author.name: Bianca Raimondi, Maurizio Gabbrielli

entry.summary: Uses linear probing to investigate whether cognitive complexity levels from Bloom's Taxonomy are linearly separable within LLM residual streams, achieving ~95% accuracy across all Bloom levels.

entry.title: MolHIT: Advancing Molecular-Graph Generation with Hierarchical Discrete Diffusion Models

author.name: Hojung Jung, Rodrigo Hormazabal, Jaehyeong Jo, Youngrok Park, Kyunggeun Roh, Se-Young Yun, Sehui Han, Dae-Woong Jeong

entry.summary: Introduces MolHIT, a hierarchical discrete diffusion model for molecular graph generation that uses chemical priors and decoupled atom encoding to improve validity and property satisfaction over existing graph diffusion approaches.

entry.title: GPU-Accelerated Algorithms for Graph Vector Search: Taxonomy, Empirical Study, and Research Directions

author.name: Yaowen Liu, Xuejia Chen, Anxin Tian, Haoyang Li, Qinbin Li, Xin Zhang, Alexander Zhou, Chen Jason Zhang, Qing Li, Lei Chen

entry.summary: Presents a comprehensive survey and experimental study of GPU-accelerated graph-based vector search algorithms, establishing a taxonomy of GPU optimization strategies and evaluating end-to-end effectiveness.

entry.title: General sample size analysis for probabilities of causation: a delta method approach

author.name: Tianyuan Cheng, Ruirui Mao, Judea Pearl, Ang Li

entry.summary: Develops a general sample size framework based on the delta method for probabilities of causation (like PNS), determining how many experimental and observational samples are needed for desired precision in causal bounds.

entry.title: Flickering Multi-Armed Bandits

author.name: Sourav Chakraborty, Amit Kiran Rege, Claire Monteleoni, Lijun Chen

entry.summary: Introduces Flickering Multi-Armed Bandits where available arms change each round depending on the agent's previous selection, modeled via random graph processes. Proposes a two-phase algorithm with provable regret bounds.

entry.title: FAMOSE: A ReAct Approach to Automated Feature Discovery

author.name: Keith Burghardt, Jienan Liu, Sadman Sakib, Yuning Hao, Bo Li

entry.summary: Introduces FAMOSE, an agentic framework using the ReAct paradigm for automated feature engineering on tabular data. The agent autonomously explores, generates, and refines features for both regression and classification tasks.

entry.title: Multi-Probe Zero Collision Hash (MPZCH): Mitigating Embedding Collisions and Enhancing Model Freshness in Large-Scale Recommenders

author.name: Ziliang Zhao, Bi Xue, Emma Lin, Mengjiao Zhou, Kaustubh Vartak, Shakhzod Ali-Zade, Carson Lu, Tao Li, Bin Kuang, Rui Jian, Bin Wen, Dennis van der Staay, Yixin Bao, Eddy Li, Chao Deng, Songbin Liu, Qifan Wang, Kai Ren

entry.summary: Introduces MPZCH, a linear-probing-based indexing mechanism for recommendation system embedding tables that eliminates hash collisions, improving model personalization quality at production scale.

entry.title: Structured Prototype-Guided Adaptation for EEG Foundation Models

author.name: Jingying Ma, Feng Wu, Yucheng Xing, Qika Lin, Tianyu Liu, Chenyu Liu, Ziyu Jia, Mengling Feng

entry.summary: Proposes SCOPE for adapting EEG foundation models with limited per-subject supervision using structured confidence-aware prototypes that address the mismatch between noisy supervision and high model plasticity.

entry.title: Linear Convergence in Games with Delayed Feedback via Extra Prediction

author.name: Yuma Fujimoto, Kenshi Abe, Kaito Ariu

entry.summary: Derives linear convergence rate for Weighted Optimistic Gradient Descent-Ascent in bilinear games with delayed feedback. Shows extra prediction (beyond next-step) improves convergence from exp(-t/m^5) to exp(-t/m^3).

entry.title: Revisiting Weight Regularization for Low-Rank Continual Learning

author.name: Yaoyue Zheng, Yin Zhang, Joost van de Weijer, Gido M van de Ven, Shaoyi Du, Xuetao Zhang, Zhiqiang Tian

entry.summary: Revisits weight regularization (like EWC) for continual learning with low-rank adapters, showing it can effectively mitigate task interference in parameter-efficient continual learning despite being underexplored in this paradigm.

entry.title: Catastrophic Forgetting Resilient One-Shot Incremental Federated Learning

author.name: Obaidullah Zaland, Zulfiqar Ahmad Khan, Monowar Bhuyan

entry.summary: Introduces OSI-FL, a federated learning framework that handles incremental data in a single communication round using frozen vision-language models, addressing both communication overhead and catastrophic forgetting simultaneously.

entry.title: Representation Collapse in Machine Translation Through the Lens of Angular Dispersion

author.name: Evgeniia Tokarchuk, Maya K. Nachesa, Sergey Troshin, Vlad Niculae

entry.summary: Analyzes representation collapse in neural machine translation through angular dispersion metrics, studying how deeper Transformer layers fail to efficiently utilize geometric space, particularly in continuous-output NMT.

entry.title: Asymptotically Optimal Sequential Testing with Markovian Data

author.name: Alhad Sethi, Kavali Sofia Sagar, Shubhada Agrawal, Debabrota Basu, P. N. Karthik

entry.summary: Establishes tight non-asymptotic lower bounds on expected stopping time for sequential hypothesis testing with Markovian data, and proposes a matching optimal test. The analysis incorporates both stationary distributions and transition structure.

entry.title: Small LLMs for Medical NLP: a Systematic Analysis of Few-Shot, Constraint Decoding, Fine-Tuning and Continual Pre-Training in Italian

author.name: Pietro Ferrazzi, Mattia Franzin, Alberto Lavelli, Bernardo Magnini

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates small (~1B parameter) LLMs across 20 clinical NLP tasks in Italian, comparing few-shot, constrained decoding, fine-tuning, and continual pre-training strategies across Llama-3, Gemma-3, and Qwen3.

entry.title: Analytic Score Optimization for Multi Dimension Video Quality Assessment

author.name: Boda Lin, Yongjie Zhu, Wenyu Qin, Meng Wang, Pengfei Wan

entry.summary: Presents UltraVQA, a large-scale multi-dimensional video quality assessment dataset with five quality dimensions and human annotations, along with an Analytic Score Optimization method for discrete quality scoring.

entry.title: NRGS-SLAM: Monocular Non-Rigid SLAM for Endoscopy via Deformation-Aware 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Jiwei Shan, Zeyu Cai, Yirui Li, Yongbo Chen, Lijun Han, Yun-hui Liu, Hesheng Wang, Shing Shin Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes NRGS-SLAM, a monocular non-rigid SLAM system for endoscopy based on 3D Gaussian Splatting. Introduces a deformation-aware mechanism to decouple camera ego-motion from tissue deformation, addressing a fundamental ambiguity in non-rigid SLAM.

entry.title: DRetHTR: Linear-Time Decoder-Only Retentive Network for Handwritten Text Recognition

author.name: Changhun Kim, Martin Mayr, Thomas Gorges, Fei Wu, Mathias Seuret, Andreas Maier, Vincent Christlein

entry.summary: Introduces DRetHTR, a decoder-only handwritten text recognition model based on Retentive Networks that achieves 1.6-1.9x faster inference with 38-42% less memory than equivalent Transformer baselines, with linear-time decoding and no accuracy loss.

entry.title: CORAL: Correspondence Alignment for Improved Virtual Try-On

author.name: Jiyoung Kim, Youngjin Shin, Siyoon Jin, Dahyun Chung, Jisu Nam, Tongmin Kim, Jongjae Park, Hyeonwoo Kang, Seungryong Kim

entry.summary: Proposes CORAL for virtual try-on that explicitly aligns person-garment correspondence within Diffusion Transformers. Analyzes how 3D attention in DiTs creates correspondence and introduces methods to improve query-key matching.

entry.title: Mobility-Aware Cache Framework for Scalable LLM-Based Human Mobility Simulation

author.name: Hua Yan, Heng Tan, Yingxue Zhang, Yu Yang

entry.summary: Proposes MobCache, a caching framework that makes LLM-based human mobility simulation scalable by encoding reasoning steps as latent embeddings and enabling their reuse. Addresses the key bottleneck of LLM computational cost for large-scale urban simulations.

entry.title: IntentCUA: Learning Intent-level Representations for Skill Abstraction and Multi-Agent Planning in Computer-Use Agents

author.name: Seoyoung Lee, Seobin Yoon, Seongbeen Lee, Yoojung Chun, Dayoung Park, Doyeon Kim, Joo Yong Sim

entry.summary: Presents IntentCUA, a multi-agent computer-use framework that stabilizes long-horizon execution through intent-aligned plan memory, using Planner/Plan-Optimizer/Critic coordination with reusable skills.

entry.title: Say It My Way: Exploring Control in Conversational Visual Question Answering with Blind Users

author.name: Farnaz Zamiri Zeraati, Yang Trista Cao, Yuehan Qiao, Hal Daum\'e III, Hernisa Kacorri

entry.summary: Explores how blind users can customize their interactions with conversational VQA systems. Through studies with 11 blind users and 418 interactions, analyzes prompting techniques adopted for personalized visual question answering.

entry.title: From Subtle to Significant: Prompt-Driven Self-Improving Optimization in Test-Time Graph OOD Detection

author.name: Luzhi Wang, Xuanshuo Fu, He Zhang, Chuang Liu, Xiaobao Wang, Hongbo Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a prompt-driven self-improving optimization method for test-time graph OOD detection that progressively corrects predictions to amplify OOD signals, moving beyond one-pass inference paradigms.

entry.title: Adapting Actively on the Fly: Relevance-Guided Online Meta-Learning with Latent Concepts for Geospatial Discovery

author.name: Jowaria Khan, Anindya Sarkar, Yevgeniy Vorobeychik, Elizabeth Bondi-Kelly

entry.summary: Proposes a geospatial discovery framework combining active learning, online meta-learning, and concept-guided reasoning for efficient sampling in resource-constrained environments like environmental monitoring and disaster response.

entry.title: A Locality Radius Framework for Understanding Relational Inductive Bias in Database Learning

author.name: Aadi Joshi, Kavya Bhand

entry.summary: Introduces 'locality radius' as a formal measure of how much structural neighborhood is needed for predictions in relational schemas, finding that most tasks are highly local and simple models suffice.

entry.title: SoftDTW-CUDA-Torch: Memory-Efficient GPU-Accelerated Soft Dynamic Time Warping for PyTorch

author.name: Ron Shapira Weber, Oren Freifeld

entry.summary: Presents an open-source CUDA-accelerated PyTorch library for Soft DTW that removes the 1024 sequence-length cap, fixes numerical instability, and achieves 98% memory reduction through fused computation.

entry.title: DARTH-PUM: A Hybrid Processing-Using-Memory Architecture

author.name: Ryan Wong, Ben Feinberg, Saugata Ghose

entry.summary: Introduces DARTH-PUM, a hybrid processing-using-memory architecture that extends analog in-memory computing beyond just ML inference to general-purpose matrix-based operations by combining analog PUM arrays with digital processing capabilities.

entry.title: Mine and Refine: Optimizing Graded Relevance in E-commerce Search Retrieval

author.name: Jiaqi Xi, Raghav Saboo, Luming Chen, Martin Wang, Sudeep Das

entry.summary: Proposes a 'Mine and Refine' contrastive training framework for e-commerce search embeddings that handles graded relevance (exact match, substitute, complement) using LLM-generated supervision aligned with product policies.

entry.title: BankMathBench: A Benchmark for Numerical Reasoning in Banking Scenarios

author.name: Yunseung Lee, Subin Kim, Youngjun Kwak, Jaegul Choo

entry.summary: Introduces BankMathBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on banking-specific numerical reasoning tasks including interest calculations, product comparisons, and early repayment computations that require multi-step reasoning.

entry.title: Differences in Typological Alignment in Language Models' Treatment of Differential Argument Marking

author.name: Iskar Deng, Nathalia Xu, Shane Steinert-Threlkeld

entry.summary: Trains GPT-2 on synthetic corpora implementing 18 different differential argument marking systems, finding a dissociation: models learn human-like preferences for markedness direction but not for split-marking patterns.

entry.title: StructCore: Structure-Aware Image-Level Scoring for Training-Free Unsupervised Anomaly Detection

author.name: Joongwon Chae, Lihui Luo, Yang Liu, Runming Wang, Dongmei Yu, Zeming Liang, Xi Yuan, Dayan Zhang, Zhenglin Chen, Peiwu Qin, Ilmoon Chae

entry.summary: Proposes StructCore, a training-free image-level scoring method for unsupervised anomaly detection that replaces max pooling with a structural descriptor capturing distributional and spatial characteristics. Uses diagonal Mahalanobis calibration for refinement.

entry.title: Polaffini: A feature-based approach for robust affine and polyaffine image registration

author.name: Antoine Legouhy, Cosimo Campo, Ross Callaghan, Hojjat Azadbakht, Hui Zhang

entry.summary: Presents Polaffini, a feature-based medical image registration framework that leverages pre-trained deep learning segmentation models for anatomical correspondences, enabling robust affine and polyaffine registration.

entry.title: EAGLE: Expert-Augmented Attention Guidance for Tuning-Free Industrial Anomaly Detection in Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Xiaomeng Peng, Xilang Huang, Seon Han Choi

entry.summary: Proposes EAGLE, a tuning-free framework that integrates expert anomaly detectors with multimodal LLMs for industrial anomaly detection. Guides MLLM attention toward anomalous regions to produce both accurate detection and interpretable descriptions.

entry.title: 4D Monocular Surgical Reconstruction under Arbitrary Camera Motions

author.name: Jiwei Shan, Zeyu Cai, Cheng-Tai Hsieh, Yirui Li, Hao Liu, Lijun Han, Hesheng Wang, Shing Shin Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes Local-EndoGS for 4D reconstruction of deformable surgical scenes from monocular endoscopic videos with arbitrary camera motion. Uses a progressive window-based global representation to handle large camera motions without stereo depth or SfM initialization.

entry.title: RRT$^\eta$: Sampling-based Motion Planning and Control from STL Specifications using Arithmetic-Geometric Mean Robustness

author.name: Ahmad Ahmad, Shuo Liu, Roberto Tron, Calin Belta

entry.summary: Proposes RRT^η, a sampling-based motion planning framework using Arithmetic-Geometric Mean robustness for Signal Temporal Logic specifications, creating smoother optimization landscapes than traditional min-max measures.

entry.title: Contact-Anchored Proprioceptive Odometry for Quadruped Robots

author.name: Minxing Sun, Yao Mao

entry.summary: Presents a purely proprioceptive state estimator for legged robots using only IMU and motor measurements. Treats each contacting leg as a kinematic anchor with torque-based contact selection, plus height clustering for elevation drift correction.

entry.title: Distributed Virtual Model Control for Scalable Human-Robot Collaboration in Shared Workspace

author.name: Yi Zhang, Omar Faris, Chapa Sirithunge, Kai-Fung Chu, Fumiya Iida, Fulvio Forni

entry.summary: Presents a decentralized Virtual Model Control framework for human-robot collaboration in shared workspaces. Uses virtual springs/dampers instead of trajectory planning, with force-based deadlock detection and negotiation, scaling to multiple agents.

entry.title: LLM4Cov: Execution-Aware Agentic Learning for High-coverage Testbench Generation

author.name: Hejia Zhang, Zhongming Yu, Chia-Tung Ho, Haoxing Ren, Brucek Khailany, Jishen Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes LLM4Cov, an offline agent-learning framework for hardware verification that uses execution-validated data curation and policy-aware synthesis to achieve high-coverage testbench generation without expensive online RL.

entry.title: Predictive Batch Scheduling: Accelerating Language Model Training Through Loss-Aware Sample Prioritization

author.name: Sumedh Rasal

entry.summary: Introduces Predictive Batch Scheduling (PBS), a training optimization that prioritizes high-loss samples during batch construction using a lightweight linear predictor achieving 6-13% faster convergence for a 130M parameter transformer.

entry.title: Visual Model Checking: Graph-Based Inference of Visual Routines for Image Retrieval

author.name: Adri\`a Molina, Oriol Ramos Terrades, Josep Llad\'os

entry.summary: Proposes Visual Model Checking, a framework integrating formal verification into deep learning-based image retrieval through graph-based verification and neural code generation for handling complex compositional queries.

entry.title: MALLVI: a multi agent framework for integrated generalized robotics manipulation

author.name: Iman Ahmadi, Mehrshad Taji, Arad Mahdinezhad Kashani, AmirHossein Jadidi, Saina Kashani, Babak Khalaj

entry.summary: MALLVi is a multi-agent LLM/VLM framework for closed-loop robotic manipulation that generates executable actions from natural language and images, with VLM-based environmental feedback evaluation.

entry.title: ALPS: A Diagnostic Challenge Set for Arabic Linguistic & Pragmatic Reasoning

author.name: Hussein S. Al-Olimat, Ahmad Alshareef

entry.summary: ALPS introduces a native, expert-curated diagnostic challenge set for Arabic linguistic and pragmatic reasoning with 531 questions across 15 tasks. Evaluates 23 models and reveals gaps in deep semantic understanding.

entry.title: The Bots of Persuasion: Examining How Conversational Agents' Linguistic Expressions of Personality Affect User Perceptions and Decisions

author.name: U\u{g}ur Gen\c{c}, Heng Gu, Chadha Degachi, Evangelos Niforatos, Senthil Chandrasegaran, Himanshu Verma

entry.summary: Studies how LLM-powered conversational agents' linguistically-expressed personalities (attitude, authority, reasoning) affect user decisions and perceptions in a charitable giving context with 360 participants.

entry.title: A feature-stable and explainable machine learning framework for trustworthy decision-making under incomplete clinical data

author.name: Justyna Andrys-Olek, Paulina Tworek, Luca Gherardini, Mark W. Ruddock, Mary Jo Kurt, Peter Fitzgerald, Jose Sousa

entry.summary: CACTUS is an explainable ML framework for trustworthy clinical decision-making under data missingness, emphasizing feature stability across different missingness patterns and interpretability.

entry.title: Tracing Copied Pixels and Regularizing Patch Affinity in Copy Detection

author.name: Yichen Lu, Siwei Nie, Minlong Lu, Xudong Yang, Xiaobo Zhang, Peng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes PixTrace for pixel coordinate tracking across image edits and CopyNCE loss that uses geometric overlap ratios for contrastive learning in image copy detection.

entry.title: Probability-Invariant Random Walk Learning on Gyral Folding-Based Cortical Similarity Networks for Alzheimer's and Lewy Body Dementia Diagnosis

author.name: Minheng Chen, Jing Zhang, Tong Chen, Chao Cao, Tianming Liu, Li Su, Dajiang Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes a probability-invariant random walk learning method on gyral folding-based cortical networks for Alzheimer's and Lewy body dementia diagnosis. Handles irregular network sizes from individualized brain anatomy that violate fixed-topology assumptions.

entry.title: TopoFlow: Physics-guided Neural Networks for high-resolution air quality prediction

author.name: Ammar Kheder, Helmi Toropainen, Wenqing Peng, Samuel Ant\~ao, Jia Chen, Zhi-Song Liu, Michael Boy

entry.summary: Proposes TopoFlow, a physics-guided neural network for air quality prediction that embeds topography and wind direction into a vision transformer via topography-aware attention and wind-guided patch reordering.

entry.title: Exploring the Utility of MALDI-TOF Mass Spectrometry and Antimicrobial Resistance in Hospital Outbreak Detection

author.name: Chang Liu, Jieshi Chen, Alexander J. Sundermann, Kathleen Shutt, Marissa P. Griffith, Lora Lee Pless, Lee H. Harrison, Artur W. Dubrawski

entry.summary: Develops a ML framework using MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry and antimicrobial resistance patterns as cheaper, faster alternatives to whole genome sequencing for hospital outbreak detection.

entry.title: Simplify to Amplify: Achieving Information-Theoretic Bounds with Fewer Steps in Spectral Community Detection

author.name: Sie Hendrata Dharmawan, Peter Chin

entry.summary: Proposes a simplified spectral algorithm for community detection in stochastic block models that achieves information-theoretic error bounds by eliminating non-essential preprocessing and directly leveraging adjacency matrix spectral properties.

entry.title: Projective Psychological Assessment of Large Multimodal Models Using Thematic Apperception Tests

author.name: Anton Dzega, Aviad Elyashar, Ortal Slobodin, Odeya Cohen, Rami Puzis

entry.summary: Uses the Thematic Apperception Test (a projective psychological assessment) to probe personality-like traits of large multimodal models through their story generation in response to ambiguous images.

entry.title: RPDR: A Round-trip Prediction-Based Data Augmentation Framework for Long-Tail Question Answering

author.name: Yiming Zhang, Siyue Zhang, Junbo Zhao, Chen Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces RPDR, a data augmentation framework for improving dense retrievers on long-tail question answering through synthetic data generation and round-trip prediction-based quality filtering.

entry.title: Entropy-Based Data Selection for Language Models

author.name: Hongming Li, Yang Liu, Chao Huang

entry.summary: Systematically studies the relationship between data selection and uncertainty estimation for language model fine-tuning, proposing entropy-based methods for selecting high-quality training data under resource constraints.

entry.title: HS-3D-NeRF: 3D Surface and Hyperspectral Reconstruction From Stationary Hyperspectral Images Using Multi-Channel NeRFs

author.name: Kibon Ku, Talukder Z. Jubery, Adarsh Krishnamurthy, Baskar Ganapathysubramanian

entry.summary: Proposes HS-3D-NeRF for simultaneous 3D surface and hyperspectral reconstruction from stationary hyperspectral cameras, enabling high-throughput agricultural phenotyping without moving-camera setups.

entry.title: Cross Pseudo Labeling For Weakly Supervised Video Anomaly Detection

author.name: Lee Dayeon, Kim Dongheyong, Park Chaewon, Woo Sungmin, Lee Sangyoun

entry.summary: Proposes CPL-VAD, a dual-branch framework for weakly supervised video anomaly detection using cross pseudo labeling. One branch handles binary anomaly localization while the other leverages vision-language alignment for category classification, exchanging pseudo labels to transfer complementary strengths.

entry.title: Inferring Height from Earth Embeddings: First insights using Google AlphaEarth

author.name: Alireza Hamoudzadeh, Valeria Belloni, Roberta Ravanelli

entry.summary: Investigates whether Google's AlphaEarth geospatial embeddings can guide deep learning models for regional surface height mapping at 10m resolution. U-Net architectures achieve R²=0.97 in training but show generalization challenges to unseen regions.

entry.title: QuPAINT: Physics-Aware Instruction Tuning Approach to Quantum Material Discovery

author.name: Xuan-Bac Nguyen, Hoang-Quan Nguyen, Sankalp Pandey, Tim Faltermeier, Nicholas Borys, Hugh Churchill, Khoa Luu

entry.summary: Presents QuPAINT, a physics-aware multimodal framework for characterizing 2D quantum materials from optical microscopy, along with Synthia, a physics-based synthetic data generator simulating thin-film interference for training.

entry.title: Grasp Synthesis Matching From Rigid To Soft Robot Grippers Using Conditional Flow Matching

author.name: Tanisha Parulekar, Ge Shi, Josh Pinskier, David Howard, Jen Jen Chung

entry.summary: Proposes using Conditional Flow Matching to map grasp poses from rigid parallel grippers to soft Fin-ray grippers, bridging the representation gap between rigid and soft grasp synthesis methods.

entry.title: Multi-session Localization and Mapping Exploiting Topological Information

author.name: Lorenzo Montano-Olivan, Julio A. Placed, Luis Montano, Maria T. Lazaro

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-session SLAM framework using topology-informed, uncertainty-aware decision-making that analyzes pose-graph structure to detect low-connectivity regions and decide between map reuse and new mapping.

entry.title: Gaussian surrogates do well on Poisson inverse problems

author.name: Alexandra Spitzer, Lorenzo Baldassari, Valentin Derbanot, Ivan Dokmani\'c

entry.summary: Analyzes MSE performance of Poisson vs Gaussian surrogate reconstruction objectives under Poisson noise for imaging inverse problems. Shows that Gaussian surrogates with appropriate regularization perform surprisingly well even at low dose.

entry.title: Conv-FinRe: A Conversational and Longitudinal Benchmark for Utility-Grounded Financial Recommendation

author.name: Yan Wang, Yi Han, Lingfei Qian, Yueru He, Xueqing Peng, Dongji Feng, Zhuohan Xie, Vincent Jim Zhang, Rosie Guo, Fengran Mo, Jimin Huang, Yankai Chen, Xue Liu, Jian-Yun Nie

entry.summary: Introduces Conv-FinRe, a conversational benchmark for LLM-based stock recommendation that evaluates beyond behavior matching by distinguishing descriptive behavior from normative utility-grounded performance.

entry.title: Improved Upper Bounds for Slicing the Hypercube

author.name: Duncan Soiffer, Nathaniel Itty, Christopher D. Rosin, Blake Bruell, Mason DiCicco, G\'abor N. S\'ark\"ozy, Ryan Offstein, Daniel Reichman

entry.summary: Proves improved upper bounds for the minimum number of hyperplanes needed to slice all edges of the n-dimensional hypercube, improving from ⌈5n/6⌉ to ⌈4n/5⌉, a result that stood since 1971.

entry.title: NeuDiff Agent: A Governed AI Workflow for Single-Crystal Neutron Crystallography

author.name: Zhongcan Xiao (Neutron Scattering Division, Oak Ridge National Laboratory, Oak Ridge, Tennesse USA), Leyi Zhang (Neutron Scattering Division, Oak Ridge National Laboratory, Oak Ridge, Tennesse USA, Department of Linguistics, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Urbana, Illinois, USA), Guannan Zhang (Computer Science and Mathematics Division, Oak Ridge National Laboratory, Oak Ridge, Tennessee, USA), Xiaoping Wang (Neutron Scattering Division, Oak Ridge National Laboratory, Oak Ridge, Tennesse USA)

entry.summary: Introduces NeuDiff Agent, a governed AI workflow for neutron crystallography at Oak Ridge National Laboratory that automates the pipeline from instrument data to validated crystal structures. Uses allowlisted tools and fail-closed verification gates.

entry.title: Retaining Suboptimal Actions to Follow Shifting Optima in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yonghyeon Jo, Sunwoo Lee, Seungyul Han

entry.summary: Proposes Successive Sub-value Q-learning (S2Q) for multi-agent RL that learns multiple sub-value functions to retain alternative high-value actions, enabling better adaptation when value functions shift during training.

entry.title: Owen-based Semantics and Hierarchy-Aware Explanation (O-Shap)

author.name: Xiangyu Zhou, Chenhan Xiao, Yang Weng

entry.summary: Proposes O-Shap, an Owen value-based SHAP method that uses semantic and hierarchy-aware grouping for feature attribution in vision tasks, addressing limitations of standard segmentation approaches.

entry.title: Texo: Formula Recognition within 20M Parameters

author.name: Sicheng Mao

entry.summary: Presents Texo, a minimalist 20M-parameter formula recognition model that achieves performance comparable to SOTA models while reducing size by 65-80%, enabling real-time inference and in-browser deployment.

entry.title: A Contrastive Variational AutoEncoder for NSCLC Survival Prediction with Missing Modalities

author.name: Michele Zanitti, Vanja Miskovic, Francesco Trov\`o, Alessandra Laura Giulia Pedrocchi, Ming Shen, Yan Kyaw Tun, Arsela Prelaj, Sokol Kosta

entry.summary: Proposes a Multimodal Contrastive Variational AutoEncoder for predicting NSCLC survival outcomes by integrating histopathology images, transcriptomics, and methylation data, with robustness under severe modality missingness.

entry.title: AdvSynGNN: Structure-Adaptive Graph Neural Nets via Adversarial Synthesis and Self-Corrective Propagation

author.name: Rong Fu, Muge Qi, Chunlei Meng, Shuo Yin, Kun Liu, Zhaolu Kang, Simon Fong

entry.summary: AdvSynGNN addresses GNN performance degradation under structural noise and non-homophilous topologies through multi-resolution structural synthesis, adaptive attention, and adversarial propagation.

entry.title: Continual uncertainty learning

author.name: Heisei Yonezawa, Ansei Yonezawa, Itsuro Kajiwara

entry.summary: Proposes a curriculum-based continual learning framework for robust control of mechanical systems with multiple uncertainties, decomposing complex control problems into sequentially learned sub-problems.

entry.title: Extending quantum theory with AI-assisted deterministic game theory

author.name: Florian Pauschitz, Ben Moseley, Ghislain Fourny

entry.summary: Proposes an AI-assisted framework for predicting individual quantum experiment outcomes using game theory, interpreting experiments as Chess-like games between observers and the universe as an economic agent minimizing action.

entry.title: Convergence Analysis of Two-Layer Neural Networks under Gaussian Input Masking

author.name: Afroditi Kolomvaki, Fangshuo Liao, Evan Dramko, Ziyun Guang, Anastasios Kyrillidis

entry.summary: Analyzes convergence of two-layer ReLU networks with Gaussian randomly masked inputs using NTK analysis, showing linear convergence up to an error proportional to mask variance.

entry.title: Position: Evaluation of ECG Representations Must Be Fixed

author.name: Zachary Berger, Daniel Prakah-Asante, John Guttag, Collin M. Stultz

entry.summary: Position paper arguing that ECG representation learning benchmarks are too narrow, focusing mainly on arrhythmia detection while ignoring structural heart disease and patient-level forecasting. Proposes expanded evaluation practices for multi-label, imbalanced clinical settings.

entry.title: A Few-Shot LLM Framework for Extreme Day Classification in Electricity Markets

author.name: Saud Alghumayjan, Ming Yi, Bolun Xu

entry.summary: Uses few-shot LLM prompting to predict electricity price spike days by formatting statistical features as natural language prompts, achieving performance comparable to supervised ML models.

entry.title: Learning a Latent Pulse Shape Interface for Photoinjector Laser Systems

author.name: Alexander Klemps, Denis Ilia, Pradeep Kr. Banerjee, Ye Chen, Henrik T\"unnermann, Nihat Ay

entry.summary: Uses Wasserstein Autoencoders to learn a differentiable latent interface between laser pulse shaping and electron beam dynamics in particle accelerators, enabling systematic exploration of design space.

entry.title: RLGT: A reinforcement learning framework for extremal graph theory

author.name: Ivan Damnjanovi\'c, Uro\v{s} Milivojevi\'c, Irena {\DJ}or{\dj}evi\'c, Dragan Stevanovi\'c

entry.summary: Presents RLGT, a reinforcement learning framework for solving extremal graph theory problems as combinatorial optimization, extending Wagner's Deep Cross-Entropy approach.

entry.title: Guarding the Middle: Protecting Intermediate Representations in Federated Split Learning

author.name: Obaidullah Zaland, Sajib Mistry, Monowar Bhuyan

entry.summary: Proposes methods to protect intermediate representations (smashed data) in U-shaped federated split learning from privacy attacks by the server. Addresses the vulnerability where shared intermediate data can expose client private information.

entry.title: A statistical perspective on transformers for small longitudinal cohort data

author.name: Kiana Farhadyar, Maren Hackenberg, Kira Ahrens, Charlotte Schenk, Bianca Kollmann, Oliver T\"uscher, Klaus Lieb, Michael M. Plichta, Andreas Reif, Raffael Kalisch, Martin Wolkewitz, Moritz Hess, Harald Binder

entry.summary: Proposes a simplified transformer architecture for small longitudinal cohort data that retains the core attention mechanism while being trainable on limited samples, enabling temporal modeling of clinical cohort studies.

entry.title: IRIS: Learning-Driven Task-Specific Cinema Robot Arm for Visuomotor Motion Control

author.name: Qilong Cheng, Matthew Mackay, Ali Bereyhi

entry.summary: Presents IRIS, a sub-$1000 6-DOF robotic camera system that uses imitation learning with Action Chunking Transformers to learn cinematic camera trajectories from human demonstrations, without explicit geometric programming.

entry.title: genriesz: A Python Package for Automatic Debiased Machine Learning with Generalized Riesz Regression

author.name: Masahiro Kato

entry.summary: Introduces genriesz, a Python package implementing automatic debiased machine learning via generalized Riesz regression, unifying covariate balancing, matching, calibrated estimation, and density ratio estimation.

entry.title: The Role of the Availability Heuristic in Multiple-Choice Answering Behaviour

author.name: Leonidas Zotos, Hedderik van Rijn, Malvina Nissim

entry.summary: Investigates the availability heuristic in multiple-choice question answering, showing computationally that more frequently encountered (cognitively available) concepts tend to be correct answers across three large question sets.

entry.title: PEACE 2.0: Grounded Explanations and Counter-Speech for Combating Hate Expressions

author.name: Greta Damo, St\'ephane Petiot, Elena Cabrio, Serena Villata

entry.summary: Presents PEACE 2.0, a tool that uses RAG to generate evidence-grounded explanations of why content is hateful and produce counter-speech responses backed by facts and evidence.

entry.title: Using LLMs for Knowledge Component-level Correctness Labeling in Open-ended Coding Problems

author.name: Zhangqi Duan, Arnav Kankaria, Dhruv Kartik, Andrew Lan

entry.summary: Proposes using LLMs to automatically label knowledge component-level correctness in student programming submissions, enabling fine-grained skill assessment that goes beyond binary problem-level grading.

entry.title: StereoAdapter-2: Globally Structure-Consistent Underwater Stereo Depth Estimation

author.name: Zeyu Ren, Xiang Li, Yiran Wang, Zeyu Zhang, Hao Tang

entry.summary: Proposes StereoAdapter-2 for underwater stereo depth estimation, replacing ConvGRU with a selective state space model (ConvSS2D) for more efficient long-range disparity propagation in challenging underwater conditions.

entry.title: Physics Encoded Spatial and Temporal Generative Adversarial Network for Tropical Cyclone Image Super-resolution

author.name: Ruoyi Zhang, Jiawei Yuan, Lujia Ye, Runling Yu, Liling Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes PESTGAN for tropical cyclone image super-resolution that encodes atmospheric physics (vorticity equation) into the GAN architecture. Disentangles physical dynamics from appearance through constrained convolutions.

entry.title: Leveraging Contrastive Learning for a Similarity-Guided Tampered Document Data Generation Pipeline

author.name: Mohamed Dhouib, Davide Buscaldi, Sonia Vanier, Aymen Shabou

entry.summary: Proposes a contrastive learning-based pipeline for generating realistic tampered document images. Trains an auxiliary network to compare text crops for similarity-guided forgery generation, addressing data scarcity in document fraud detection.

entry.title: Art2Mus: Artwork-to-Music Generation via Visual Conditioning and Large-Scale Cross-Modal Alignment

author.name: Ivan Rinaldi, Matteo Mendula, Nicola Fanelli, Florence Lev\'e, Matteo Testi, Giovanna Castellano, Gennaro Vessio

entry.summary: Introduces Art2Mus with ArtSound, a 105K artwork-music pair dataset, for direct visual-to-audio generation from artworks without an image-to-text intermediary. Addresses limitations of existing systems trained on natural photographs.

entry.title: IntRec: Intent-based Retrieval with Contrastive Refinement

author.name: Pourya Shamsolmoali, Masoumeh Zareapoor, Eric Granger, Yue Lu

entry.summary: Proposes IntRec, an interactive object retrieval framework that refines predictions based on user feedback. Maintains an Intent State with positive and negative memory sets, using contrastive alignment for fine-grained disambiguation.

entry.title: Nonlinear Predictive Control of the Continuum and Hybrid Dynamics of a Suspended Deformable Cable for Aerial Pick and Place

author.name: Antonio Rapuano, Yaolei Shen, Federico Califano, Chiara Gabellieri, Antonio Franchi

entry.summary: Presents a framework for aerial cable manipulation combining PDE-based models with reduced-order representations for real-time nonlinear model predictive control, handling hybrid transitions like payload attachment/detachment.

entry.title: RA-Nav: A Risk-Aware Navigation System Based on Semantic Segmentation for Aerial Robots in Unpredictable Environments

author.name: Ziyi Zong, Xin Dong, Jinwu Xiang, Daochun Li, Zhan Tu

entry.summary: Proposes RA-Nav, a risk-aware navigation framework for aerial robots that classifies obstacles into stationary, temporarily static, and dynamic types using semantic segmentation, with corresponding risk estimation functions.

entry.title: Hybrid System Planning using a Mixed-Integer ADMM Heuristic and Hybrid Zonotopes

author.name: Joshua A. Robbins, Andrew F. Thompson, Jonah J. Glunt, Herschel C. Pangborn

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid zonotope representation paired with an ADMM mixed-integer programming heuristic for motion planning of hybrid systems, achieving lower memory complexity and tighter relaxations.

entry.title: SOLVAR: Fast covariance-based heterogeneity analysis with pose refinement for cryo-EM

author.name: Roey Yadgar, Roy R. Lederman, Yoel Shkolnisky

entry.summary: Presents SOLVAR for fast covariance-based heterogeneity analysis in cryo-EM, leveraging low-rank assumptions to estimate principal components of the covariance matrix with simultaneous pose refinement.

entry.title: Cooperationism: first draft for a moral framework that does not require consciousness

author.name: Épiphanie Gédéon

entry.summary: Proposes 'cooperationism' as a moral framework for AI welfare that doesn't require consciousness/sentience. Argues that the AI welfare discussion should not be limited to consciousness-based frames and proposes cooperation-based alternatives.

entry.title: Does GPT-2 Represent Controversy? A Small Mech Interp Investigation

author.name: CharlesL

entry.summary: An early-stage mechanistic interpretability investigation using TransformerLens on GPT-2 to explore whether the base model encodes politically controversial topics differently from morally controversial or neutral topics, based on residual stream activations across 20 structured prompts.

entry.title: Node Learning: A Framework for Adaptive, Decentralised and Collaborative Network Edge AI

author.name: Eiman Kanjo, Mustafa Aslanov

entry.summary: Proposes Node Learning, a decentralized learning paradigm where intelligence resides at individual edge nodes that learn from local data and exchange knowledge opportunistically through peer interaction rather than central aggregation.

entry.title: Adaptive Decentralized Composite Optimization via Three-Operator Splitting

author.name: Xiaokai Chen, Ilya Kuruzov, Gesualdo Scutari

entry.summary: Proposes adaptive decentralized optimization methods using three-operator splitting with local backtracking stepsize selection, achieving convergence guarantees for composite convex optimization over networks.

entry.title: Attachment Anchors: A Novel Framework for Laparoscopic Grasping Point Prediction in Colorectal Surgery

author.name: Dennis N. Schneider, Lars Wagner, Daniel Rueckert, Dirk Wilhelm

entry.summary: Introduces 'attachment anchors' for predicting grasping points in colorectal surgery, encoding local geometric and mechanical relationships between tissue and anatomical attachments. Addresses underrepresented complex surgical procedures.

entry.title: FoundationPose-Initialized 3D-2D Liver Registration for Surgical Augmented Reality

author.name: Hanyuan Zhang, Lucas He, Runlong He, Abdolrahim Kadkhodamohammadi, Danail Stoyanov, Brian R. Davidson, Evangelos B. Mazomenos, Matthew J. Clarkson

entry.summary: Integrates foundation pose estimation with non-rigid iterative closest point registration for augmented reality in laparoscopic liver surgery. Achieves 9.91mm mean registration error on real patient data.

entry.title: Physical Human-Robot Interaction for Grasping in Augmented Reality via Rigid-Soft Robot Synergy

author.name: Huishi Huang, Jack Klusmann, Haozhe Wang, Shuchen Ji, Fengkang Ying, Yiyuan Zhang, John Nassour, Gordon Cheng, Daniela Rus, Jun Liu, Marcelo H Ang Jr, Cecilia Laschi

entry.summary: Presents an AR-based physical human-robot interaction framework for teleoperation of hybrid rigid-soft robots. Users interact with simulated robot models overlaid on real systems via AR headset for reaching and grasping tasks.

entry.title: Sales Research Agent and Sales Research Bench

author.name: Deepanjan Bhol

entry.summary: Describes the Sales Research Agent in Microsoft Dynamics 365 and introduces Sales Research Bench for evaluation. Scores on 8 dimensions including groundedness and explainability across 200 questions.

entry.title: ArXiv-to-Model: A Practical Study of Scientific LM Training

author.name: Anuj Gupta

entry.summary: Presents a detailed case study of training a 1.36B scientific language model from raw arXiv LaTeX sources, documenting the end-to-end pipeline including extraction, normalization, tokenization, and training under constrained compute.

entry.title: Is Mamba Reliable for Medical Imaging?

author.name: Banafsheh Saber Latibari, Najmeh Nazari, Daniel Brignac, Hossein Sayadi, Houman Homayoun, Abhijit Mahalanobis

entry.summary: Evaluates the robustness of Mamba state-space models for medical imaging under adversarial attacks, hardware fault attacks, and common corruptions, profiling vulnerabilities across multiple threat models.

entry.title: Federated Latent Space Alignment for Multi-user Semantic Communications

author.name: Giuseppe Di Poce, Mario Edoardo Pandolfo, Emilio Calvanese Strinati, Paolo Di Lorenzo

entry.summary: Proposes a federated approach to align latent spaces across multi-user semantic communication devices, using semantic pre-equalizers and local equalizers to enable mutual understanding in AI-native communications.

entry.title: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Network for Industrial IoT Predictive Maintenance

author.name: Rebin Saleh, Khanh Pham Dinh, Bal\'azs Vill\'anyi, Truong-Son Hy

entry.summary: Introduces SEMAS, a hierarchical multi-agent system for IoT predictive maintenance that distributes specialized agents across Edge, Fog, and Cloud tiers for scalable anomaly detection with dynamic adaptation.

entry.title: Quantum Scrambling Born Machine

author.name: Marcin P{\l}odzie\'n

entry.summary: Proposes a Quantum Scrambling Born Machine where a fixed entangling unitary provides multi-qubit entanglement while only single-qubit rotations are optimized, demonstrating that near-Haar-random entanglement suffices for quantum generative modeling.

entry.title: Auditing Reciprocal Sentiment Alignment: Inversion Risk, Dialect Representation and Intent Misalignment in Transformers

author.name: Nusrat Jahan Lia, Shubhashis Roy Dipta

entry.summary: Audits cross-lingual sentiment alignment between Bengali and English across transformer models, finding severe issues including 28.7% sentiment inversion rate in compressed models.

entry.title: Three-dimensional Damage Visualization of Civil Structures via Gaussian Splatting-enabled Digital Twins

author.name: Shuo Wang, Shuo Wang, Xin Nie, Yasutaka Narazaki, Thomas Matiki, Billie F. Spencer Jr

entry.summary: Introduces a Gaussian Splatting-based method for 3D damage visualization on digital twins of civil structures, enabling efficient and detailed rendering of structural damage from inspection data.

entry.title: Cholec80-port: A Geometrically Consistent Trocar Port Segmentation Dataset for Robust Surgical Scene Understanding

author.name: Shunsuke Kikuchi, Atsushi Kouno, Hiroki Matsuzaki

entry.summary: Presents Cholec80-port, a high-fidelity trocar port segmentation dataset for laparoscopic surgery that maintains geometric consistency by not masking the central lumen. Addresses how trocar ports can degrade geometry-based downstream pipelines like SLAM and 3D reconstruction.

entry.title: Neural Implicit Representations for 3D Synthetic Aperture Radar Imaging

author.name: Nithin Sugavanam, Emre Ertin

entry.summary: Reviews neural implicit representations for 3D synthetic aperture radar imaging, encoding object surfaces as signed distance functions learned from sparse scattering data to achieve state-of-the-art results.

entry.title: "It's like a pet...but my pet doesn't collect data about me": Multi-person Households' Privacy Design Preferences for Household Robots

author.name: Jennica Li, Shirley Zhang, Dakota Sullivan, Bengisu Cagiltay, Heather Kirkorian, Bilge Mutlu, Kassem Fawaz

entry.summary: Conducts participatory design sessions with 15 multi-person households to explore privacy preferences for household robots, revealing tensions between individual privacy needs within shared living spaces.

entry.title: Distillation and Interpretability of Ensemble Forecasts of ENSO Phase using Entropic Learning

author.name: Michael Groom, Davide Bassetti, Illia Horenko, Terence J. O'Kane

entry.summary: Introduces a distillation framework for ensemble ENSO phase forecasts that compresses multiple models into a compact set of interpretable distilled models, preserving forecast skill while enabling diagnostics.

entry.title: Retrieval Augmented (Knowledge Graph), and Large Language Model-Driven Design Structure Matrix (DSM) Generation of Cyber-Physical Systems

author.name: H. Sinan Bank, Daniel R. Herber

entry.summary: Explores using LLMs, RAG, and GraphRAG for automatically generating Design Structure Matrices (DSMs) for cyber-physical systems like power screwdrivers and CubeSats. Tests on two use cases with publicly available code.

entry.title: Efficient Parallel Algorithm for Decomposing Hard CircuitSAT Instances

author.name: Victor Kondratiev, Irina Gribanova, Alexander Semenov

entry.summary: Proposes a novel parallel algorithm for decomposing hard CircuitSAT instances using specialized constraints to partition formulas into weakened sub-problems, demonstrated on logical equivalence checking and cryptographic hash preimage attacks.

entry.title: A Privacy by Design Framework for Large Language Model-Based Applications for Children

author.name: Diana Addae, Diana Rogachova, Nafiseh Kahani, Masoud Barati, Michael Christensen, Chen Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes a Privacy-by-Design framework for LLM-based applications for children, incorporating principles from GDPR, PIPEDA, and other privacy regulations.

entry.title: WarpRec: Unifying Academic Rigor and Industrial Scale for Responsible, Reproducible, and Efficient Recommendation

author.name: Marco Avolio, Potito Aghilar, Sabino Roccotelli, Vito Walter Anelli, Chiara Mallamaci, Vincenzo Paparella, Marco Valentini, Alejandro Bellog\'in, Michelantonio Trizio, Joseph Trotta, Antonio Ferrara, Tommaso Di Noia

entry.summary: Introduces WarpRec, a high-performance recommendation framework with 50+ algorithms, 40 metrics, and backend-agnostic architecture that seamlessly transitions from local to distributed execution with integrated energy tracking.

entry.title: When Semantic Overlap Is Not Enough: Cross-Lingual Euphemism Transfer Between Turkish and English

author.name: Hasan Can Biyik, Libby Barak, Jing Peng, Anna Feldman

entry.summary: Studies cross-lingual euphemism transfer between Turkish and English, finding that semantic overlap is insufficient for positive transfer. Reveals asymmetric transfer patterns particularly in low-resource directions.

entry.title: Transforming Behavioral Neuroscience Discovery with In-Context Learning and AI-Enhanced Tensor Methods

author.name: Paimon Goulart, Jordan Steinhauser, Dawon Ahn, Kylene Shuler, Edward Korzus, Jia Chen, Evangelos E. Papalexakis

entry.summary: Showcases an AI-enhanced pipeline for behavioral neuroscience that uses in-context learning and tensor methods to accelerate data preparation and analysis, replacing rigid manual pipelines for studying fear conditioning in mice.

entry.title: In-Context Learning in Linear vs. Quadratic Attention Models: An Empirical Study on Regression Tasks

entry.title: Research Summary: February 19, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research centers on agent reliability, ecosystem-level AI risks, and mechanistic understanding of emergence, with notable advances in robotics and safety evaluation.

  • Arvind Narayanan's group proposes twelve concrete metrics for AI agent reliability across consistency, robustness, predictability, and safety—a foundational framework as agentic systems proliferate
  • Retrieval Collapse formalizes how AI-generated web pollution erodes search diversity and enables adversarial manipulation of retrieval pipelines
  • A pre-registered RCT (n=153) finds no significant LLM uplift for novice biology lab performance, a critical biosecurity policy result
  • Mechanistic tracking of five geometric measures across model scales reveals universal representation collapse followed by top-down reorganization during capability emergence

In robotics, DreamZero achieves 2× improvement over SOTA vision-language-action models via joint video-action diffusion modeling, while EgoScale discovers scaling laws for dexterous manipulation from 20,854 hours of egocentric human video. On the safety front, optimization instability in clinical agentic workflows shows self-improvement paradoxically degrades performance, and STING introduces automated red-teaming for multi-turn illicit assistance. Doc-to-LoRA offers a practical alternative to long-context inference by meta-learning single-pass context distillation into LoRA adapters.

entry.title: Towards a Science of AI Agent Reliability

author.name: Stephan Rabanser, Sayash Kapoor, Peter Kirgis, Kangheng Liu, Saiteja Utpala, Arvind Narayanan

entry.summary: Proposes twelve concrete metrics decomposing AI agent reliability along four dimensions (consistency, robustness, predictability, safety), grounded in safety-critical engineering. Evaluates 14 agents and finds that standard success metrics obscure critical operational flaws.

entry.title: Improving Interactive In-Context Learning from Natural Language Feedback

author.name: Martin Klissarov, Jonathan Cook, Diego Antognini, Hao Sun, Jingling Li, Natasha Jaques, Claudiu Musat, Edward Grefenstette

entry.summary: Proposes a framework treating interactive in-context learning from natural language feedback as a trainable skill rather than emergent property. Introduces a scalable method to transform single-turn verifiable tasks into multi-turn didactic interactions, showing current flagship models are suboptimal at learning from feedback.

entry.title: Anatomy of Capability Emergence: Scale-Invariant Representation Collapse and Top-Down Reorganization in Neural Networks

author.name: Jayadev Billa

entry.summary: Tracks five geometric measures across model scales (405K-85M) during training, finding universal representation collapse to scale-invariant floors followed by top-down layer reorganization preceding capability emergence.

entry.title: Retrieval Collapses When AI Pollutes the Web

author.name: Hongyeon Yu, Dongchan Kim, Young-Bum Kim

entry.summary: Characterizes 'Retrieval Collapse' — a failure mode where AI-generated content dominates search results, eroding source diversity and enabling adversarial content infiltration. Shows 67% pool contamination leads to 80%+ exposure contamination in RAG/search systems.

entry.title: Measuring Mid-2025 LLM-Assistance on Novice Performance in Biology

author.name: Shen Zhou Hong, Alex Kleinman, Alyssa Mathiowetz, Adam Howes, Julian Cohen, Suveer Ganta, Alex Letizia, Dora Liao, Deepika Pahari, Xavier Roberts-Gaal, Luca Righetti, Joe Torres

entry.summary: Pre-registered RCT (n=153) testing whether LLMs improve novice performance in biology lab tasks modeling a viral reverse genetics workflow. Found no significant difference in workflow completion between LLM and Internet groups.

entry.title: World Action Models are Zero-shot Policies

author.name: Seonghyeon Ye, Yunhao Ge, Kaiyuan Zheng, Shenyuan Gao, Sihyun Yu, George Kurian, Suneel Indupuru, You Liang Tan, Chuning Zhu, Jiannan Xiang, Ayaan Malik, Kyungmin Lee, William Liang, Nadun Ranawaka, Jiasheng Gu, Yinzhen Xu, Guanzhi Wang, Fengyuan Hu, Avnish Narayan, Johan Bjorck, Jing Wang, Gwanghyun Kim, Dantong Niu, Ruijie Zheng, Yuqi Xie, Jimmy Wu, Qi Wang, Ryan Julian, Danfei Xu, Yilun Du, Yevgen Chebotar, Scott Reed, Jan Kautz, Yuke Zhu, Linxi "Jim" Fan, Joel Jang

entry.summary: Introduces DreamZero, a World Action Model built on pretrained video diffusion that jointly models video and action for robotic manipulation. Achieves 2x improvement in generalization to new tasks/environments compared to state-of-the-art VLAs.

entry.title: EgoScale: Scaling Dexterous Manipulation with Diverse Egocentric Human Data

author.name: Ruijie Zheng, Dantong Niu, Yuqi Xie, Jing Wang, Mengda Xu, Yunfan Jiang, Fernando Casta\~neda, Fengyuan Hu, You Liang Tan, Letian Fu, Trevor Darrell, Furong Huang, Yuke Zhu, Danfei Xu, Linxi Fan

entry.summary: Presents EgoScale, a framework that trains a Vision-Language-Action model on 20,854 hours of egocentric human video for dexterous manipulation, discovering a log-linear scaling law between human data scale and performance.

entry.title: EnterpriseGym Corecraft: Training Generalizable Agents on High-Fidelity RL Environments

author.name: Sushant Mehta, Logan Ritchie, Suhaas Garre, Nick Heiner, Edwin Chen

entry.summary: Introduces EnterpriseGym Corecraft, a high-fidelity enterprise simulation environment for training AI agents on customer support tasks. Frontier models like GPT-5.2 and Claude Opus 4.6 solve <30% of tasks. Training with RL on this environment produces capabilities that generalize beyond training distribution.

entry.title: Optimization Instability in Autonomous Agentic Workflows for Clinical Symptom Detection

author.name: Cameron Cagan, Pedram Fard, Jiazi Tian, Jingya Cheng, Shawn N. Murphy, Hossein Estiri

entry.summary: Identifies 'optimization instability' in autonomous agentic workflows for clinical symptom detection, where iterative self-improvement paradoxically degrades performance. At 3% prevalence, systems achieved 95% accuracy while detecting zero positive cases, exposing dangerous failure modes.

entry.title: Doc-to-LoRA: Learning to Instantly Internalize Contexts

author.name: Rujikorn Charakorn, Edoardo Cetin, Shinnosuke Uesaka, Robert Tjarko Lange

entry.summary: Proposes Doc-to-LoRA (D2L), a hypernetwork that meta-learns to perform approximate context distillation in a single forward pass, generating LoRA adapters to internalize document context without re-consuming it during inference.

entry.title: Balancing Faithfulness and Performance in Reasoning via Multi-Listener Soft Execution

author.name: Nithin Sivakumaran, Shoubin Yu, Hyunji Lee, Yue Zhang, Ali Payani, Mohit Bansal, Elias Stengel-Eskin

entry.summary: Proposes REMUL, a multi-party RL approach where listener models execute truncated reasoning traces to improve chain-of-thought faithfulness in LLMs, addressing the tradeoff between faithfulness and task performance.

entry.title: Helpful to a Fault: Measuring Illicit Assistance in Multi-Turn, Multilingual LLM Agents

author.name: Nivya Talokar, Ayush K Tarun, Murari Mandal, Maksym Andriushchenko, Antoine Bosselut

entry.summary: Introduces STING, an automated red-teaming framework for measuring illicit assistance in multi-turn LLM agent interactions. Constructs step-by-step illicit plans with benign personas and uses judge agents to track completion.

entry.title: Scaling Open Discrete Audio Foundation Models with Interleaved Semantic, Acoustic, and Text Tokens

author.name: Potsawee Manakul, Woody Haosheng Gan, Martijn Bartelds, Guangzhi Sun, William Held, Diyi Yang

entry.summary: Presents a systematic empirical study of native audio foundation models using next-token prediction at scale, jointly modeling semantic, acoustic, and text tokens. Includes first scaling law study for discrete audio models.

entry.title: Multi-agent cooperation through in-context co-player inference

author.name: Marissa A. Weis, Maciej Wo{\l}czyk, Rajai Nasser, Rif A. Saurous, Blaise Ag\"uera y Arcas, Jo\~ao Sacramento, Alexander Meulemans

entry.summary: Demonstrates that sequence models' in-context learning capabilities enable multi-agent cooperation through co-player inference without hardcoded assumptions about learning rules or explicit timescale separation. Shows emergent cooperative behavior through learning awareness.

entry.title: Can Generative Artificial Intelligence Survive Data Contamination? Theoretical Guarantees under Contaminated Recursive Training

author.name: Kevin Wang, Hongqian Niu, Didong Li

entry.summary: Provides theoretical guarantees for generative AI survival under contaminated recursive training, where models are iteratively trained on mixtures of human and AI-generated data, going beyond simplified Gaussian settings.

entry.title: HiPER: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning with Explicit Credit Assignment for Large Language Model Agents

author.name: Jiangweizhi Peng, Yuanxin Liu, Ruida Zhou, Charles Fleming, Zhaoran Wang, Alfredo Garcia, Mingyi Hong

entry.summary: Proposes HiPER, a hierarchical RL framework that separates high-level planning from low-level execution for LLM agents, using explicit credit assignment to handle sparse delayed rewards in long-horizon tasks.

entry.title: From Growing to Looping: A Unified View of Iterative Computation in LLMs

author.name: Ferdinand Kapl, Emmanouil Angelis, Kaitlin Maile, Johannes von Oswald, Stefan Bauer

entry.summary: Provides a mechanistic unification of looping (reusing layer blocks) and depth growing (duplicating middle layers) in LLMs, showing they share convergent depth-wise signatures and can be composed for reasoning improvements.

entry.title: Enhanced Diffusion Sampling: Efficient Rare Event Sampling and Free Energy Calculation with Diffusion Models

author.name: Yu Xie, Ludwig Winkler, Lixin Sun, Sarah Lewis, Adam E. Foster, Jos\'e Jim\'enez Luna, Tim Hempel, Michael Gastegger, Yaoyi Chen, Iryna Zaporozhets, Cecilia Clementi, Christopher M. Bishop, Frank No\'e

entry.summary: Introduces enhanced diffusion sampling for molecular dynamics, enabling efficient exploration of rare-event regions in diffusion models like BioEmu while preserving unbiased thermodynamic estimators.

entry.title: Fast KV Compaction via Attention Matching

author.name: Adam Zweiger, Xinghong Fu, Han Guo, Yoon Kim

entry.summary: Proposes Attention Matching for fast KV cache compaction in latent space, constructing compact keys and values to reproduce attention outputs at a per-head level. Achieves significant compression while preserving performance, much faster than end-to-end optimization.

entry.title: Protecting the Undeleted in Machine Unlearning

author.name: Aloni Cohen, Refael Kohen, Kobbi Nissim, Uri Stemmer

entry.summary: Demonstrates that machine unlearning via 'perfect retraining' carries significant privacy risks for remaining (undeleted) data points. Shows a reconstruction attack where an adversary controlling ω(1) points can reconstruct almost the entire dataset.

entry.title: Error Propagation and Model Collapse in Diffusion Models: A Theoretical Study
